Working at Atlassian

We are building the future of work with a strong point of view on how people, teams, and AI can work better together. In Strategy Collection at Atlassian, that means creating an enterprise-grade product that helps organizations connect strategy to execution, align teams around priorities, track progress, and make better decisions at scale.

  • We value open collaboration, clear thinking, and practical innovation that solves real customer problems.
  • We invest in thoughtful, trustworthy AI experiences that improve decisions and reduce friction without sacrificing transparency or control.
  • We give product leaders meaningful ownership, strong cross-functional partners, and the chance to shape products used by modern organizations at scale.

Atlassians can choose where they work whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

We're looking for an experienced, results-driven Principal Product Manager to help lead core jobs to be done in the Focus app within Atlassian's Strategy Collection product management team. Strategy Collection is Atlassian's "roof of the house" for the Atlassian System of Work, aligning company strategy to execution. This role will shape how Focus helps leaders and teams define priorities, connect work to outcomes, understand progress, and make high-quality decisions across the organization.

You will define product strategy, roadmap priorities, and an operating cadence for core Focus capabilities across planning, goal-setting, reporting, insights, collaboration, administration, and integrations. This is a hands-on, highly cross-functional role that requires strong product judgment, customer empathy, enterprise SaaS depth, and the ability to influence product, engineering, design, platform, data, GTM, and executive stakeholders. This role reports directly to the Head of Product of Strategy Collection.

Responsibilities

  • Define and own the Focus product vision, roadmap, and operating plan for the relevant jobs to be done within Strategy Collection, translating customer, market, and business needs into clear priorities and shipped outcomes.
  • Lead AI-native product building for Focus by applying AI across discovery, synthesis, prototyping, experimentation, evaluation, launch planning, and post-launch learning.
  • Identify and prioritize high-impact AI and automation opportunities across Focus workflows, including insights, recommendations, progress monitoring, workflow assistance, and decision support.
  • Prioritize work based on customer impact, adoption, revenue growth, strategic differentiation, product quality, and long-term value for teams and organizations using Focus.
  • Drive critical cross-functional initiatives with engineering, design, platform, data, research, GTM, support, and partner teams to improve how Focus helps customers align strategy, goals, teams, programs, and execution.
  • Translate complex customer and business needs into pragmatic product decisions that balance near-term adoption with scale, usability, trust, extensibility, and admin control.
  • Apply AI fluency and product judgment to define quality bars for AI-powered experiences, including evals, human-in-the-loop workflows, trust mechanisms, permissions, transparency, and responsible governance.
  • Use customer evidence, market feedback, account data, product telemetry, competitive insights, and AI-assisted analysis to size opportunities, make tradeoffs, and communicate investment decisions.
  • Create clear executive-ready narratives on current state, top opportunities, roadmap choices, and progress against outcomes; proactively escalate risks to custome

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Data Cloud and Connectors
jobs.loc: Flexible / Remote, Salt Lake City, UT
jobs.desc:
Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

About DX

DX is the developer intelligence platform. We help engineering leaders understand how work gets done, improve developer experience, and make better decisions about productivity and AI. DX combines self-reported insights from developers with data from the systems where software work happens, then turns those signals into insights teams can act on.

The role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead DX's data platform and connector portfolio.

The data platform is the foundation beneath every DX insight. It connects to the tools our customers use, ingests and organizes their data, protects its integrity, and makes it available to the rest of the DX product. You will own the product direction and outcomes for Data Cloud, our connector ecosystem, core data integrity, and the data infrastructure behind our demo environment.

This is a deeply technical product role. You do not need to be an engineer, but you must be able to reason credibly about connectors, APIs, data models, database design, data lakes, reliability, enterprise data requirements, and data privacy/security. You will turn that understanding into a data platform that customers and internal product teams can trust.

What you'll do

  • Set the vision, strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for DX's Data Cloud and connector ecosystem.
  • Prioritize connector investments using customer demand, market context, strategic leverage, and the needs of downstream DX products.
  • Improve the end-to-end connector experience, including setup, authentication, configuration, data mapping, sync health, and troubleshooting.
  • Define product requirements for data quality, freshness, completeness, reliability, and transparency.
  • Partner closely with Engineering on the evolution of DX's unified data layer while maintaining a clear boundary between product direction and technical design.
  • Own the product capabilities that keep DX's demo environment representative, reliable, and useful.
  • Build a deep understanding of enterprise data environments, security constraints, integration patterns, and the teams responsible for them.
  • Shape ambiguous opportunities with lightweight specs, prototypes, and clear written context before the team commits to a solution.
  • Know how the platform is performing across connector adoption, time to value, reliability, and customer satisfaction; investigate problems and drive the right improvements.
  • Partner with customer-facing and go-to-market teams on connector discovery, pilots, launches, documentation, and positioning.

jobs.desc:
At Koalafi, we believe in a world where no one has to put an important purchase on hold. That’s why we’re making it easier for more people to pay for big purchases over time.

Retailers across the country rely on us to offer flexible lease-to-own financing to their non-prime consumers, while increasing sales and strengthening customer loyalty. Their 2M+ customers love us because we provide a flexible way for them to make payments and give them an opportunity to improve their credit. Our 200+ Koalafi teammates enjoy inspiring and challenging work that accelerates their careers.

Interested in learning more about how we’re transforming the financing experience and joining our team?

About The Role 

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to lead and evolve Koalafi’s Originations product and drive growth across our end-to-end apply & checkout experiences. that serve as the front door to financing for every customer. This is a high-impact role at the center of Koalafi’s strategy to accelerate growth by making it easier, faster, and more intuitive for consumers to finance their purchases across both online and in-store channels.  

This role is ideal for a product manager who thrives working at the intersection of strategy, execution, and deep cross-functional collaboration. You’ll set the direction for Originations by aligning diverse partners, from Risk and Compliance to Marketing and Sales, around a cohesive strategy that accelerates growth while maintaining a unified vision. 

What You’ll Do 

Define and drive the Originations roadmap 

  • Lead product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for the Originations product as an engine for growth
  • Develop the product strategy for apply & checkout flows that are reusable across diverse merchant and consumer contexts – such as a consumer’s mobile phone to a store owner’s point-of-sale system or e-commerce checkout integration 

Grow and optimize the Originations funnel 

  • Drive continuous funnel optimization by identifying conversion opportunities using quantitative data and qualitative insights to ship rapid improvements while balancing profitability and compliance
  • Grow Koalafi’s distribution across channels by partnering with cross-functional teams to design and ship frictionless experiences that work for both merchants and consumers 

Shape the product for rapid insight generation and experimentation 

  • Partner with analytics and engineering to instrument the funnel, generate actionable insights, and run A/B tests to validate hypotheses and measure outcomes
  • Mentor other PMs and establish best practices for experimentation and funnel analysis across the broader organization 

Champion the customer experience 

  • Champion the customer, bringing curiosity and empathy to every decision to ensure the application experience meets real customer needs
  • Conduct user research and map consumer and merchant journeys to uncover usability gaps and unmet needs

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Search & Evaluate - StreetEasy
jobs.desc:
About the team

StreetEasy is the most-used local real estate platform in New York City - the place where millions of buyers and renters begin, conduct, and ultimately make one of the highest-stakes decisions of their lives. Unlike when searching for everyday items, our users aren't just looking for quick, easy results. They're navigating a complex market defined by co-op boards, neighborhood nuance, and inventory that moves fast and unevenly. Search & Evaluate sits at the center of that experience, where users spend the most time and where the most critical intent signals are generated.
This role owns the core shopping experience - search, browse, compare, evaluate - and the data and signals it produces that power personalization, agent matching, and growth across the platform.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior PM who has managed search tools for a marketplace. You understand that searching for a home is a long, thoughtful process, which is very different from searching for simple, everyday products or just browsing general content.You've lived the tension between relevance and monetization, between exploration and conversion, and between what users say they want and what behavioral data tells you they actually do.
This is a pivotal role where you'll elevate the product to the next level. There is massive potential to innovate through AI-assisted discovery, intent-aware personalization, and advanced agentic flows. You'll have the opportunity to define this roadmap and lead the team in building a more personalized decision-making journey for our users.

You Will Get To

  • Define and drive the search and shopping experience across web, iOS, and Android, from initial query through listing and building detail, saving and comparing.
  • Rethink how we personalize the process of finding a home-a high-stakes, infrequent decision. User intent shifts over months, so our sparse signals have to do more heavy lifting than in typical search contexts.
  • Partner with engineering and data science to lead the evolution of our search strategy, prioritizing high-impact AI-native opportunities that will transform how users navigate the market.
  • Own the property evaluation pages and experience, helping users navigate NYC-specific nuances like co-op policies and pricing.

jobs.desc:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a defining opportunity for a Senior Product Manager to own how every Samsara device comes to life.

Samsara ships hundreds of thousands of devices a year to fleets, construction sites, and depots worldwide. A single customer rollout can exceed 50,000 devices, where every minute saved per install compounds into weeks of deployment time. Each device has a five-minute window where it goes from a box in someone's hands to a live sensor feeding a customer's operation. You will own those five minutes and the multi-year vision for what they become.

The install experience is critical to the compounding value of every Samsara product. A camera aimed correctly on day one trains better safety models. A gateway reporting cleanly makes every downstream workflow trustworthy.

You will own the software install experience end to end, with a dedicated engineering and design team, and you will own one number: install correctness, the share of installs completed right on the first attempt. Correctness today swings by several points depending on whether the installer uses the Samsara Fleet App, and closing that gap for every install is the first prize. Your target is an install under five minutes of active app time that confirms its own health before the installer walks away.

You are building for two people who each get the same five minutes. A contracted technician on their twentieth install of the day wants speed. A customer's shop mechanic on their first wants guidance that assumes nothing. Both are standing in a truck bay, holding a phone, sometimes without signal.

To understand the scale of this problem, review the Samsara Vehicle Gateway here, our full hardware lineup here, and our installer partner network here.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US. 

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master

ShiftKey is a platform that is disrupting the way healthcare facilities find licensed and certified professionals to fill available shifts. Leveraging marketplace dynamics and deep industry knowledge, the company is playing a vital role in mitigating America's healthcare staffing shortages, enabling direct connections between facilities and healthcare professionals. ShiftKey connects healthcare professionals with facilities across diverse care settings, and our professional experience - from the first shift someone picks up to whether they're still picking up shifts three years later - is what keeps that marketplace healthy. Our Product Team operates in an augmented model - you will direct what we are building toward and our non-negotiables, while our delivery partners direct how it gets built.

This role owns the experience that makes ShiftKey the one they stick with: finding shifts, getting placed, seeing what they earn and why, building a reputation, and coming back. This is a fully remote position based in the United States. You should be comfortable working asynchronously and partnering with teammates in different time zones.

  • Own the professional's experience end to end: discovery, placement, and what keeps them coming back.

ShiftKey connects healthcare professionals with facilities across diverse care settings, and our professional experience - from the first shift someone picks up to whether they're still picking up shifts three years later - is what keeps that marketplace healthy. Our Product Team operates in an augmented model - you will direct what we are building toward and our non-negotiables, while our delivery partners direct how it gets built.

Professionals who pick up shifts on ShiftKey have options - other platforms, direct facility work, leaving staffing entirely. This role owns the experience that makes ShiftKey the one they stick with: finding shifts, getting placed, seeing what they earn and why, building a reputation, and coming back. You'll own Professional Lifetime Value as the metric that tells you whether it's working, and you'll partner with the PM who owns the facility side to keep the marketplace healthy on both ends.

Where you'll work

This is a fully remote position based in the United States. You should be comfortable working asynchronously and partnering with teammates in different time zones.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the professional's experience end to end: discovery, placement, and what keeps them coming back.
  • Define and own Professional Lifetime Value, reporting on it up to leadership.
  • Build the retention strategy that keeps professionals active for years, not just their first shift.
  • Design how professionals build reputation and get discovered by facilities.
  • Make earnings clear - what they make, why, and how to make it better.

What you'll need

  • 7-9 years in product management, with meaningful time on the supply side of a marketplace or platform.
  • Experience solving for engagement, not just availability, in a marketplace or platform.
  • Comfort connecting product decisions to unit economics and talking through them with finance.
  • Sharp data instincts - you instrument before you build, and can diagnose retention vs. discovery problems.
  • A strong track record partnering across team boundaries you don't fully control.

Perks of working for ShiftKey

  • Inclusive and collaborative work environment where all voices are valued.
  • Hybrid-friendly office spaces designed to be fun and engaging.
  • Comprehensive health, vision, and dental coverage.
  • Benefits begin on your first day.
  • Generous PTO and company-paid holidays, including flexible floating holidays.
  • 100% 401(k) employer match up to 6%.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Wellness support, including access to mental health resources.

jobs.desc:
About the team

At Zillow, we believe home should be more than just a dream. The Zillow Home Loans (ZHL) Product team delivers a home financing journey that gives consumers more confidence, transparency, and ease than they can find anywhere else. We partner closely with Engineering, AI, Design, Research, and Operations to bring holistic experience innovation to market. This team is building an AI-native operating model for service delivery - agentic systems that reason about the next best action, and durable workflow infrastructure that carries those decisions out reliably.

About the role

The Principal Product Manager, Directed Workflows drives the vision, strategy, and execution for how ZHL's sales and service process gets encoded as directed work. AI agents reason over each customer's situation, adapt that process to the specific opportunity in front of them, and determine the next work that should happen: the action, the outcome it is meant to create, the quality bar it must meet, and the skills required to execute it. You will own that loop across engagement and loan production. You design the AI harness (context, tools, memory, orchestration, escalation, guardrails) that determines what those agents reason over and what work they produce. You own the eval infrastructure that scores those decisions against the process you defined, learns from operator feedback, and uses experiments to decide what to keep, change, or retire.

You Will Get To

  • Define and lead a multi-year product vision for Directed Workflows as an AI-first service system spanning engagement and loan production
  • Define, with Sales and Business Operations, the sales and service process this system encodes: customer jobs, value at each stage, and how that experience earns attention and advocacy
  • Design the AI harness that turns that process into AI agent behavior: context engineering, tool design, memory, orchestration, and guardrails, including where a model should reason, where deterministic systems should execute, and what requires a person. The work the agent produces names the action, intended outcome, quality bar, and skills required to execute
  • Own the eval infrastructure you build or integrate: score AI agent output against the intended process, learn from operator feedback in production, and run experiments that show whether the directed work moved the outcome
  • Sequence from high-leverage pilots to platform: prove outcomes in focused increments, retire or redesign what does not move the metrics, then expand successful patterns across the financing journey
  • Influence across Zillow so the customer experience, the real estate agent experience, and the home finance operator experience operate as one coordinated service, and represent that strategy with senior leaders including risks and trade-offs

Product Manager at Handoff

We’re hiring a Product Manager to own the roadmap, strategy, and execution of a core product squad. In this role, you’ll lead engineers and designers to ship high-quality, high-impact features that improve contractor workflows, while connecting product decisions to measurable business and growth outcomes.

This role is ideal for someone who combines a strong product mindset with customer obsession and a high bar for execution. You should be energized by complexity, detail-oriented, and excited to work in a fast-paced, AI-driven startup solving real-world problems for builders and remodelers.

About Us

Axle Health builds AI scheduling and workforce management software to empower in-home healthcare providers to deliver exceptional, personalized care right where patients feel most comfortable—at home.

Some of the biggest providers in the country use our software (like Cityblock Health and U Penn Health System) to improve the utilization of their field teams by 17%+, and automate the operational burden of scheduling and dispatching.

Our platform includes proprietary logistics algorithms to optimize scheduling, a mobile app for field staff, an operations dashboard for office teams, engagement and booking tools for patients, and a wide range of integrations and external APIs for modular access.

We’re a team of top-tier engineers and operators, backed by $14m from top investors such as Y Combinator, Pear VC, and F-Prime, applying our intellect and logistics experience to upend how home healthcare is delivered.

About You

Axle Health is building the operating system for home healthcare - scheduling, route optimization, and patient engagement tools that give health systems and home-based care providers the infrastructure to run better, faster, and at greater scale. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own critical product initiatives end-to-end, working closely with engineering and GTM teams to ship features that meaningfully improve how clinicians deliver care and how operations teams run the day-to-day. This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to our Head of Product, where you'll have significant autonomy to shape what we build and how.

You can look at a workflow and see immediately where the friction is, articulate what a great experience should feel like for home healthcare providers , and champion that standard all the way through to launch. You're a true advocate for the customer and the user - someone who leans into the user experience and holds the bar on experience even when it's easier to ship something just good enough. You're equally comfortable digging into the data and riding along with our customers to understand what they actually need.

You've shipped B2B vertical SaaS products at early-stage startups and know what it takes to move fast with limited resources, make smart trade-offs without losing sight of the user, and build things people actually want to use.

We do not monitor YC applications, please apply directly on our website to be considered for this position: https://www.axlehealth.com/careers

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, PBM Platform
jobs.desc:
**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

  

Rightway is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own claims adjudication, the system at the center of Rightway's PBM. Adjudication covers the full lifecycle of a pharmacy claim: eligibility, coverage, pricing, rejections, overrides, and coordination of benefits. It is one of the most complex and consequential product areas at Rightway, and this role owns its strategy, roadmap, and delivery.

You will develop deep expertise in how pharmacy claims adjudicate today and use that to define where the platform goes next — working through real claim behavior alongside engineering, writing requirements precise enough to build against, setting the bar for correctness, and owning the validation approach that proves the system is ready for production volume. The role reports to the Director, Product Management, and operates with a high degree of independence. It requires someone who can take full ownership of a major product initiative and work cross-functionally across product, engineering, operations, clinical, and compliance.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* Own the vision, roadmap, and delivery plan for claims adjudication, including how it scales with volume, new clients, and new lines of business
* Build deep expertise in how pharmacy claims adjudicate across eligibility, coverage rules, pricing, rejections, overrides, and coordination of benefits, and turn that into a structured, prioritized plan
* Define the long-term strategy for how the platform evolves to support operational scale, regulatory requirements, and new lines of business, including Medicare
* Write clear specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering and QA can execute against, and lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, and release coordination in an agile environment
* Partner day to day with the adjudication engineering team to sequence work, manage dependencies, and resolve ambiguity in claim behavior quickly
* Set the bar for correctness and own the testing and claim certification approach that proves the system is ready for production volume
* Own readiness and rollout planning, including validation against real claim volume, parallel testing, and phased release
* Coordinate go-live readiness across operations, clinical, client success, and compliance so changes land without disruption to members or clients
* Partner with PBM operations, clinical, legal, and client success teams to ensure the platform meets workflow and regulatory requirements
* Manage the drug data, formulary, and prior authorization dependencies adjudication relies on, treating the internal teams who own them as first-class partners
* Define and track KPIs for claim accuracy, system performance, and reliability
* Act as the primary product point of contact for adjudication across the organization and with external partners

**WHO YOU ARE:**

  

* Bachelor's degree required; 5 or more years of product management experience, preferably in healthcare or enterprise technology
* Experience with complex, rules-driven transaction processing systems such as claims adjudication, payments, or benefit administration, including responsibility for correctness and testing
* Experience leading a platform migration or major system transition from requirements through go-live
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives involving product, engineering, legal, and operations stakeholders
* Ability to work independently and drive execution with minimal direction
* Strong communicator who collaborates well across technical and non-technical teams
* Detail oriented and process focused, and comfortable in a domain where correctness is measured claim by claim
* Comfortable working across complex, data-heavy systems
* Curious and adaptable, willing to dig into unfamiliar and highly technical territory and find answers
* Experience working in or with PBMs, pharmacy claims, or pharmacy operations is a plus
* Familiarity with systems that support regulated healthcare markets

Beazley Security is a global cybersecurity firm committed to helping clients enable advanced cyber defenses that reduce risk with quantifiable results. We’re comprised of top talent from private industry, government, intelligence, and law enforcement who are specialists in threat detection, incident response, digital forensics, offensive security, risk management, and cyber resilience. As a subsidiary of a specialty insurance giant, Beazley Insurance, we’ve been at the forefront of cyber insurance management and breach response activities for business clients in the US, UK, and Europe since 2017. As Beazley Security, the company will have an expanded scope, leveraging nearly two decades of cyber incident experience, a strong services division, and a business strategy focused on growth, to realize our goals and deliver benefits to clients.

As a company, we are committed to upholding our core values of Belonging, Integrity, Service, Accountability, and Curiosity. We believe these values are essential to creating a strong and inclusive workplace culture, as well as to deliver world-class cybersecurity solutions to our clients worldwide. As Beazley Security, these values will continue to thrive, with an extra emphasis on expansion of our capabilities and capacity in helping solve unique client challenges.

organizations' attack surface, along with proactive prompts and curated intelligence on known exploited vulnerabilities that affect environment’s assets, IT and security teams can take action to mitigate threats. This pre-emptive approach is essential to addressing potential risk before it can materialize.

With TPRM, organizations can monitor vendor security posture in near real time with dynamic scoring based on vendors' access to their corporate systems, the sensitivity of data that they can access, and criticality to

business operations. DWM focuses on monitoring compromised user credential, notifying clients before attackers can exploit these credentials.

jobs.desc:
**About Smokeball**  
Smokeball powers people-law. Our legal practice management software lightens the administrative burden, so legal professionals can serve those who need them most. With offices in Australia, the US, and the UK, culture plays a big part in our success, and our clear purpose and vision motivate us daily.

**Senior Product Manager, Personal Injury**

We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to help rebuild and expand Smokeball’s Personal Injury (PI) offering. This is a hands-on, end-to-end role where you’ll own a PI product area from discovery and strategy through delivery and iteration — working directly with US personal injury firms and our engineering team in Australia.

You’ll report to the leader of our PI product team and work alongside our other Senior Product Manager, with the two of you sharing ownership of the PI portfolio. You’ll own your roadmap, make the calls on what gets built and why, and be accountable for the impact it delivers. Priorities will move, problems will change, and you’ll need to be comfortable jumping into something new, getting up to speed quickly, talking to customers, and turning messy problems into smart, well-scoped solutions.

One important thing: **don’t come in swinging a redesign hammer.** First, get to know the product. Firms rely on what exists today, and the quirks you might spot often exist for a reason. Your first job is to understand the *why* before deciding what should change.

We also build with AI in the loop. You should be comfortable using AI tools to design, experiment, and prototype — including Claude Code — and turning ideas into something customers can actually click on and react to. Around here, a good prototype can do a lot of the heavy lifting that a 20-page spec normally would.

Most importantly, this is a role for a Senior PM who wants to **do the craft, not just talk about it**. You’ll be in customer calls, sketching flows, building prototypes, making product calls, and getting into the backlog — not watching it all happen from a safe distance.

This is a **hybrid** position based in our Chicago, IL office. All Chicagoland employees are required to be in the office on **Wednesdays and Thursdays**.

**Customer discovery & validation**

* Build strong relationships with US personal injury firms and our in-house PI attorney to understand workflows, pain points, and market expectations.
* Run customer interviews, usability testing, and validation across your product areas.
* Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Support to identify recurring customer and commercial problems.
* Develop a deep understanding of the existing PI product and the legal and workflow decisions behind it before proposing changes.

**Product ownership & strategy**

* Own the roadmap for your PI area, prioritizing opportunities based on customer impact, commercial value, and delivery effort.
* Make clear product decisions and trade-offs, and partner with the PI leadership team and other Senior PM to sequence the wider portfolio.
* Represent your product area with executives, customers, Sales, and cross-functional teams.

**Prototyping & AI**

* Produce your own wireframes and flows during discovery. You don't need to be a designer, but you do need to be self-sufficient. If you do have design experience, that’s a plus.
* Create your own wireframes and user flows during discovery and use AI-assisted tools, including Claude Code, to rapidly build working prototypes for customer validation.
* Treat prototypes as the primary product artifact, keeping documentation focused on intent, behavior, and key requirements rather than exhaustive PRDs.

**Delivery & iteration**

* Work closely with our Australia-based engineering team, giving them context, priorities, and fast answers. Engineering's role on this team leans toward reviewing, correcting, and hardening what comes out of AI-assisted development, so your prototypes and decisions feed directly into what ships.

jobs.title: OG.com - Senior Product Manager - Predictions
jobs.desc:
**About Us**
------------

  

OG.com is a fast-growing, CFTC-regulated Prediction Market platform powered by cutting-edge technology. We’re building an engaging marketplace where users trade on real-world outcomes - from major sports and elections to cultural and financial events. With a sleek mobile-first app and a passionate community, we’re redefining how people interact with news, probabilities, and financial markets. OG.com runs on the rails of North American Derivatives Exchange, Inc. (NADEX), a CFTC-regulated exchange operating since 2004 and was acquired by crypto.com in 2022.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the consumer prediction-market trading experience end-to-end - web and mobile - once someone can fund: discovery, order entry, positions, parlays / live, and the fan UX that makes OG the default place to trade on real-world outcomes.

Your mandate is to make OG fast, clear, and design-obsessive for sports and prediction users: the core trading surfaces that keep them coming back, the workflows that feel native to fans (and to retail traders), and the translation of that craft into regulated U.S. event contracts. Fiat, KYC, and payment rails sit with a partner PM. You own what they do after they’re funded.

You will run this roadmap with independence. You make the call on UX tradeoffs, what ships when design quality isn’t there yet, and which trading patterns we borrow from sportsbooks, prediction apps, or retail perps -and which we refuse. You report to the Chief Product Officer, who sets product strategy and priorities across OG. You own the how and the when.

  

**You can come from one of three product worlds:**

* Native consumer predictions - sports fluency, parlays / live, fan UX - and you can bridge that into regulated event contracts.
* Prediction / event markets -you’ve already shipped this category.
* Retail perps / derivatives / advanced trading -you know trader-grade workflows and can make them accessible for fans, not only power users.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Sapience AI is the collective intelligence platform for professional communities. We sit above the CRMs, AMS platforms, and knowledge bases that organizations already run, and we turn the expertise scattered across them into something every member can search, act on, and share.

The intelligence a community needs is already inside it. Most organizations just cannot reach it. Knowledge lives in silos, in legacy systems, in the heads of a few experts, and in fragmented records no one can connect. We change that.

Our work is grounded in four commitments: technology elevates people and never replaces them, the best expertise is already inside the community, everything is built on trust, and every deployment is purpose-driven for the organization it serves.

**Let's achieve more, together.**

**Where this role sits**
========================

This role owns a product area end to end. Where the product marketer is the market lens, you are the person accountable for what we build, how it works, and whether it ships and succeeds.

You lead a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, and applied AI specialists to turn strategy into a product members rely on. You own the roadmap for your area, the decisions inside it, and the outcomes it produces.

You work at the center of the product organization, translating a clear point of view into shipped work that moves MINERVA and the COGENT architecture forward through each GR/GA milestone.

**Why this role exists**
========================

In an AI market where capabilities can be copied in weeks, the advantage goes to teams that decide well and ship fast. Someone has to hold the point of view, make the calls, and keep a team building the right thing.

Collective intelligence is hard product work: reasoning over messy knowledge, earning member trust, and fitting into how communities already operate. It needs an owner who can hold both the ambition and the details.

The Senior Product Manager is that owner. You set direction for your area, make the hard prioritization calls, and are accountable for whether the product succeeds with the people it serves.

**What you will own (Areas of Responsibility)**
===============================================

You hold eight areas of responsibility inside the product organization. Each one is yours to set direction on, build, and measure.

**1. Product strategy and roadmap ownership**
---------------------------------------------

* Own the strategy and roadmap for your product area, grounded in member needs, market evidence, and company goals.
* Make clear prioritization calls, and protect the roadmap from reactive churn.
* Sequence work so each release builds toward a strategy, not a list of features.

**2. Discovery and definition**

Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

Every custom part Xometry quotes has to be checked for manufacturability before it can become a job, i.e. Design for Manufacturing (DFM). As Staff Product Manager for DFM, you will own the strategy and roadmap for how Xometry defines, automates, and scales manufacturability review through AI across all geographies. This is a technical, cross-functional, high-ownership role at the intersection of manufacturing domain expertise, workflow design, and applied AI/ML — a critical component of our overall strategy.

* **Own the Intelligent DFM Workbench:** Lead the product that houses the single structured record of what each order requires to be built correctly — the source of truth read and edited by internal Staff, and viewed by Buyers and Partners through role-specific views
* **Partner with data science and ML engineering:** Work with data science and engineering to improve manufacturability models — 3D geometry analysis, and evaluation of Visual/3D Language Models for part understanding — and to build the champion/challenger and golden-dataset feedback loop that improves record accuracy over time from every workbench review

Description:

Deep Sync is the industry leader in deterministic identity and AI-powered data solutions. Leveraging our 35-year foundation of compiling direct mail-grade datasets, Deep Sync develops data-first technologies that power marketing, measurement, AI, and business intelligence for agencies and brands with our fully deterministic identity graph, privacy-first audiences, comprehensive data solutions, and integrations with leading platforms and cloud providers.

**Position Overview**

Marketing depends on identifying the audience correctly. Deep Sync supplies the identity data that makes that possible, across offline and online channels, in both consumer and business marketing.

You will own the product surface on which a customer selects an audience, purchases it, and delivers it into the channel where the campaign runs, built on the platform now under development. The role also covers new product development: taking an idea from a hypothesis to a paid offering, and discontinuing the ones that do not justify further investment.

The products we build have to be ready for an AI first world. Customers increasingly reach data through agents and natural language rather than through a screen, which means what we ship has to serve a machine as readily as a person.

The position calls for a senior product manager fluent in advertising and in data, and equally at ease with AI. You should already understand what a match rate is worth to a buyer, the limits of lookalike modelling, and why one individual appears as separate records in separate systems, you should be able to go into the data and verify such questions yourself, and you should be building with current AI tools rather than reading about them. We run a flat organisation and a fast product development cadence. The position is based in Kirkland, WA.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product ownership and delivery**

* **Surface ownership.** Own an area of the product from the problem through to the outcome: the case for doing the work, the requirements engineering builds from, and the usage it shows six months after release.
* **Requirements and written decisions.** We work in documents. A requirements document states the problem, the decision taken, what is in scope and what is not, and how success will be measured. Presentations are for reporting, not for deciding.
* **Scope discipline.** A rebuild invites reproducing every feature that exists today. Establish what is actually used, make the case for retiring the rest, and hold that position in review.
* **Release management.** Select the customers who receive each release first, define the test that closes a milestone, and report the result as it stands.
* New product development
* **Opportunity identification.** Attributes that have never been packaged, audiences that have never been priced, and questions customers are currently paying somebody else to answer.
* **Early validation.** A test with two or three customers, a measure agreed in advance, and a short written finding. Evidence before a long build rather than after it.
* **Applied AI.** Determine where a model or an agent belongs in the product and where it does not, specify how its output will be evaluated, and demonstrate the idea with a working prototype rather than a description of one. Design for consumption by machines as well as by people: predictable interfaces, described data, and output that a system downstream can act on without a person in between.
* **Progression or discontinuation.** Both are acceptable outcomes. An idea that remains a proposal for three quarters is not.

**Market and commercial**

* **Customer contact.** The sales, delivery and client facing teams hold most of the knowledge about what fails, and customers hold the rest. Time spent with them is part of the role.
* **Consumer and business marketing.** The two buy different things for different reasons, and both are Deep Sync customers. Understand what each is measured on.

jobs.desc:
**About Lively**

Lively set out to raise the bar on benefit solutions, because we believe no one should have to sacrifice personal wellness for financial wellness. While traditional benefits focus more on transactions and less on the humans using them, Lively harnesses user-centric design and innovative technology to deliver an effortless experience for employers and account holders alike. Our modern HSA is consistently top-rated, and we have since expanded our offerings to provide a full suite of other benefits and services for companies, consumers, and financial institutions.

Lively is a remote-first company, headquartered in San Francisco with employees across the US. Come join us and help make getting the value out of your benefits as simple as it should be.

#### **THE ROLE**

Lively is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own how data moves between our platform and the systems our customers and partners rely on — payroll and HR platforms, benefits administration systems, carriers, and third-party administrators. You will own enrollment and eligibility data, file-based and API-based exchange, and the integration roadmap that connects Lively to its ecosystem.

You will also own the AI agent experiences that sit on top of that data layer, with a focus on onboarding and validation: agents that help customers and partners get their data into Lively correctly the first time, interpret what arrives, surface problems in plain language, and propose corrections. Integration work at Lively is increasingly AI-assisted, and this role decides where that assistance belongs and where human review stays mandatory.

Alongside this, you will shape Lively's forward data integration strategy: how our connectivity model evolves as the ecosystem moves toward real-time exchange, where we invest in building versus partnering, and how we make each additional integration cheaper and faster than the last.

This is a technically grounded product role. You will work closely with engineering on system behavior, data design, and agent behavior, and you will be the person partners and internal teams come to when they need to understand how the data actually flows. You will own large initiatives end-to-end and operate as the primary subject matter expert for your areas.

**Please note:** As a majority of our engineering team sits in Pacific time, candidate preference will be given to those in the **Pacific** and **Mountain** timezones.

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**

Responsibilities are listed in order of anticipated time investment:

* Integration Ownership — Own the data exchanged between Lively and its partners: what moves, in what form, on what cadence, and what happens when something goes wrong. Define the contracts that both sides build against.
* AI-Assisted Data Onboarding & Validation — Own the AI agent experiences that accelerate getting partner and customer data into Lively: interpreting unfamiliar file structures, mapping fields, catching errors before they propagate, explaining what went wrong in language a non-technical administrator can act on, and recommending fixes. Define where the agent acts, where it advises, and where a human must approve.
* Enrollment & Eligibility Data — Own the enrollment data lifecycle end to end, including how changes, corrections, and exceptions are handled, and how Lively proves its records match the partner's.
* Reliability, Data Quality & Scale — Own the non-functional requirements of Lively's data integration platform: throughput, latency, availability, recovery, and the guarantee that data is never silently lost or partially applied. Define how failures are detected, communicated, and resolved. Plan capacity for the benefits industry's seasonal enrollment peaks and for growth in partner and record volume. Set the accuracy bar AI-assisted validation must clear before production use.

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager / Agent Builder
jobs.desc:
About the Opportunity

RK Industries is building an enterprise AI Agent capability using Microsoft AI technologies, and we’re looking for a Senior AI Product Manager / Agent Builder to help lead the journey.

This is a unique product leader + hands-on builder role for someone who can translate operational needs into scalable AI products that deliver measurable business value.

You’ll own enterprise AI Agents from business opportunity through prototype, production, adoption, and measurable business value—starting with RK Mechanical and expanding across RK as our AI capability grows.

About the Role

You are first and foremost an AI Product Manager. You’ll work directly with business leaders and frontline users to understand how work gets done, redesign workflows, define the right AI solution, establish evaluation and human-in-the-loop controls, and drive adoption and measurable outcomes.

What You’ll Do

* Discover high-value AI opportunities by working directly with business users.

* Own AI Agents end-to-end: problem product prototype evaluation production adoption value.

* Build and iterate agents using Microsoft Foundry / Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Microsoft Fabric.

* Design enterprise RAG, grounding, tools, integrations, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

* Personally create rapid prototypes, lightweight coded agents, integrations, and evaluation harnesses.

* Use AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Codex, and comparable coding assistants.

* Define evaluation datasets, acceptance thresholds, and production-quality standards.

* Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Data, Security, Responsible AI, MLOps/LLMOps, Change Management, and external AI development partners.

* Measure adoption and prove business value through revenue generation, time savings, cost avoidance, cycle-time reduction, quality improvement, or risk reduction.

* As RK builds dedicated AI/Agent Engineering capacity, production engineering will progressively transition to those specialists. You’ll continue to own the product, agent behavior, evaluation quality, adoption, and business value.

* We’re looking for a Product Manager who can build and not necessarily a full-time software engineer.

What We’re Looking For

* 5–8+ years of product-management experience in software, data, AI, enterprise SaaS, or related technology environments.

* 2+ years of meaningful AI, generative AI, or AI Agent product experience.

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Foundry / Azure AI Foundry.

* Hands-on experience with Copilot Studio and practical understanding of Microsoft 365 Copilot.

* Working knowledge of Microsoft Fabric.

* Strong understanding of enterprise RAG, grounding, retrieval, and evaluation.

* Experience defining evaluation datasets, acceptance thresholds, and human-in-the-loop controls.

* Hands-on prototyping experience using GitHub Copilot, Codex, or comparable AI coding tools.

* Strong product discovery, workflow mapping, roadmap, backlog, adoption, and business-value skills.

* Ability to work comfortably with executives, frontline users, engineers, architects, data teams, security teams, and vendors.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in construction, MEP, specialty contracting, industrial operations, manufacturing, or related domains is a plus.

How We Lead

We expect this role to demonstrate seven leadership principles equally:

Ownership | Bias for Action | Earn Trust | Dive Deep | Have Backbone; Disagree and Commit | Invent and Simplify | Insist on the Highest Standards

The Opportunity

This is an opportunity to help shape how RK builds enterprise AI from the ground up—combining business-process understanding, product leadership, Microsoft AI platform fluency, hands-on Agent building, evaluation discipline, governance, adoption, and measurable business value

Location: Aurora, Colorado  
Working Model: Hybrid — approximately three days per week in the office, with periodic visits to RK

We see a world where heavy industry is transformed to be safer, more productive, and environmentally friendly through illumination. We enable industrial customers operating in demanding environments to reduce their energy costs, maintenance costs, and carbon footprint while maximizing the safety and productivity of their facilities.

**Position Summary**

Dialight is seeking a **Senior Product Manager** to lead the strategy, development, commercial performance, and lifecycle management of an assigned global product portfolio. This role serves as the business owner and voice of the customer for the portfolio, translating Dialight's overall product strategy into actionable roadmaps, investment priorities, and product plans. The ideal candidate combines strong commercial judgment with technical aptitude and can lead cross-functional teams through complex decisions in global, long sales-cycle industrial markets.

**Job Responsibilities**

**Portfolio Strategy & Roadmap**

* Own the strategy and multi-year roadmap for an assigned product portfolio, aligned with Dialight's overall product strategy, business objectives, and regional market requirements.
* Evaluate customer needs, market trends, competitive activity, emerging technologies, and regulatory changes to identify and prioritize growth, differentiation, and portfolio improvement opportunities.
* Develop business cases for new products and portfolio investments, including demand forecasts, target pricing and cost, margin expectations, return on investment, launch timing, and risk analysis.

**Product Development & Lifecycle Management**

* Lead products through the full lifecycle, from opportunity definition and requirements through development, commercialization, continuous improvement, and end-of-life.
* Translate voice-of-customer and market insights into clear product requirements, specifications, performance targets, target costs, pricing objectives, and compliance needs.
* Partner with engineering, operations, supply chain, quality, and regulatory teams through the stage-gate or new product introduction process to deliver products on time, on budget, and to agreed performance and quality standards.
* Drive portfolio productivity through cost reduction, quality and feature improvements, SKU rationalization, product-line simplification, and disciplined discontinuation planning.
* Ensure products meet applicable global certifications and regulatory requirements, including UL, CE, DLC, IEC, and hazardous-location standards, as appropriate.

**Commercial & Financial Performance**

* Manage the assigned portfolio as a business, with accountability for revenue, gross margin, product mix, market position, and overall financial performance.
* Develop pricing recommendations and monitor market competitiveness, realized price, cost, and profitability to identify and implement corrective actions.
* Define and monitor key performance indicators for product and launch success; use data to recommend investments, corrective actions, or changes in priority.

**Go-To-Market & Sales Enablement**

* Partner with Sales and Marketing to define value propositions, product positioning, pricing, launch plans, and regional go-to-market requirements.

* Own the accuracy and readiness of relevant product content, including specifications, datasheets, brochures, website information, labels, installation manuals, and other customer-facing documentation.

You will own the end-to-end product strategy, driving day-to-day improvements, rigorous experimentation, and revenue-driving growth initiatives. If you are passionate about leveraging AI to build best-in-class consumer tools and thrive in an autonomous, data-driven environment, this is the role for you.

### **About This Team**

The Jobs team builds products to help job seekers find their perfect job, especially when it comes to remote work, WFH and flexible jobs. Our mission is to provide best-in-class tools that drive the best outcomes for our customers and long-term value for our brand. This role is specifically for our ExpertApply product. ExpertApply is our AI-powered job search automation product which applies to relevant job openings based on a candidate's profile.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Strategic Ownership:** Develop and execute a high-impact product roadmap for ExpertApply, partnering with leadership, Engineering, Design, Marketing, and Analytics to achieve core business goals.
* **Mobile-First Growth:** Champion a mobile-first strategy to optimize the application funnel, drive adoption and retention, and ultimately spearhead the launch of our dedicated mobile app.
* **Growth Loops & Experimentation:** Design, run, and interpret rigorous A/B tests across the product and marketing channels—including collaborating with Email Marketing to leverage job alerts for user retention.
* **Customer-Centric Innovation:** Continuously push the product forward by synthesizing market trends, competitive analysis, quantitative metrics, and qualitative user research into actionable features.

### **What You'll Need**

* **Experience:** 6-10 years of consumer-facing Product Management experience.
* **Execution & Prioritization:** Exceptional attention to detail with the proven ability to seamlessly manage multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities.
* **Analytical Rigor:** Deep expertise in A/B test design, quantitative metric analysis, and translating complex data sets into clear, actionable business strategies.
* **Technical Fluency:** A solid understanding of modern technology stacks, allowing you to accurately gauge the level of effort and partner effectively with engineering teams.
* **Collaborative Leadership:** A history of cross-functional team building, exceptional communication skills, and the ability to thrive in a globally distributed, remote work environment.

Product Marketing sits at the center of product, marketing, sales, and customer insight. The Senior Manager of Product Marketing will lead positioning, messaging, go-to-market execution, and revenue enablement for solutions that help organizations quantify cyber risk and use risk intelligence to make more informed business decisions. This role requires strong product marketing fundamentals, sound judgment, and the ability to translate complex risk models, data, and analytics into clear value for executive, risk, and security buyers. Success will be measured through product adoption, pipeline contribution, sales effectiveness, win rates, and market understanding.

* Own product positioning and messaging for cyber risk solutions (e.g., quantification, analytics, and risk intelligence), translating complex models, data, and analytics into clear business value for security, risk, and GRC leaders.

* Track product marketing performance through adoption, pipeline contribution, win-loss findings, sales feedback, and content use, and recommend changes based on the results.

* 5-8+ years of B2B product marketing experience in cybersecurity, risk management, GRC, analytics, financial technology, or a related market.

* Ability to leverage AI tools across roles and responsibilities.

jobs.desc:
About Stepful :

Stepful is a workforce platform redefining how America's largest health systems build, train, and retain their talent. Since our founding in 2021, Stepful’s trained over 32,000 practice-ready healthcare workers.

Layering onto our successful direct-to-consumer training, Stepful partners with leading healthcare institutions to address the growing national shortage of healthcare workers. We’re improving access to quality healthcare for everyone, everywhere, and improving access to healthcare career ladders for those who need them most.

Our students form the talent pipelines for major employers such as NY-Presbyterian, Mt. Sinai, HCA, Providence, CVS, and Walgreens. We have partnerships with half of the top 10 health systems in the US and are in process with many more.

Stepful is backed by Y Combinator, Reach Capital, and AlleyCorp, with a recent $55M Series C led by Oak HC/FT. We were named the #1 EdTech company in the U.S. by TIME for 2025.

Our values :

We credit much of our success to our exceptional team. We’re looking for mission-driven builders who thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, and embody our four core values:

  • Care first : We do whatever it takes for our students to succeed.

  • Learn quickly : We test, learn with data, and iterate.

  • Build together : We win when we rely on each other.

  • Own it : We show up, take initiative, and show pride.

The opportunity:

Thousands of adult learners come to Stepful to change their lives, often while balancing full-time jobs, families, and financial pressure. Our Student Experience teams build the classroom experience for all of our learners. Every step of their journey matters, from their first day of class through graduation, certification and final licensing exams. As the Product Manager for Student Experience, you'll own the product that carries them through that journey. You won't just optimize what exists. You'll question it, rethink how we deliver outcomes, and build experiences that help more students finish, get certified, and get hired.

This includes mobile and offline workflows, AI-guided inspections, geospatial context, photo and voice capture, operational visibility, and the connection between field observations and downstream compliance or corrective-action workflows.

Depending on the problem, that might mean sketching a workflow, building a lightweight prototype with modern tools, digging into usage data, writing detailed product behavior, or working directly with customers to test the riskiest assumption.

**The Role:**

As a digitally native company, Minted's Shopping Experience and commerce platform are core to the company's success. Minted's online shopping experience allows consumers to discover, customize, and purchase from an extensive assortment of products and categories, all designed by independent artists around the world. We are driven by creating a customer journey that serves both our artist community and the savvy e-commerce shopper.

We are seeking a Lead Product Manager to own the strategy for how customers find and choose products on Minted. Over the next two years, we are integrating a new product information management platform, which will give us structured, machine-readable data about our product catalog. That data supports a set of experiences we cannot build today: search and browse that understand what a customer is looking for, product detail and category pages generated from product attributes, and filtered navigation that is fully crawlable. Combined with parallel investments in analytics, customer data, and content management, it is the foundation for conversational shopping and for deep personalization later. This role decides what we build on that foundation, in what order, and why.

The role spans our discovery surfaces (search, browse, category, and product detail) and our conversion optimization program, with dependencies running into product data, customization and rendering, checkout, and marketing. You will set the strategy and objectives for your pod, lead initiatives that cross pod and functional boundaries, and raise the standard of product craft for the PMs around you.

* Develop and lead initiative strategies that span multiple teams and functions, and resolve the dependencies and disagreements those initiatives create with other teams and with stakeholders.

**About Pearl**

Founded in 2013, Pearl is a ratings and standards company building the national standard for home performance. Pearl SCORE™ rates every single-family home in the U.S. across five key pillars — Safety, Comfort, Operations, Resilience, and Energy — so homebuyers, homeowners, and real estate professionals can understand how a home performs in daily life.

Today, the value of a home is judged by its location, size, and aesthetics— but these factors overlook the home’s most important function: safeguarding the comfort, well-being, and finances of the people inside. Most American homes underperform in these regards because home performance is simply not on our radar. We can’t see it, quantify it, or put a value on it. Pearl aims to change that by making home performance a central part of how we view and value our homes.

We are not a home inspector, a contractor, a real estate platform, or a green-certification program — we rate homes against a transparent, evidence-based standard so that home performance becomes visible, measurable, and valuable in the real estate market.

As a Certified B Corporation, we're accountable not only to our shareholders, but also to the homeowners and communities we serve. For more information, visit pearlscore.com.

**About the role**

**Pearl PRO** is the professional side of Pearl's platform: the web and mobile app that real estate agents use to bring Pearl Score into their listings, client conversations, and daily workflow. As Pearl expands its footprint with agents and brokerages, Pearl PRO is a critical growth engine and one of the company's most active areas of product investment.

The **Senior Product Manager for Pearl PRO** will own the product end to end - strategy, roadmap, discovery, and delivery - for Pearl's real estate professional-facing app across web and mobile. Reporting to the SVP Product, this is a **full-stack product ownership** role: you are the **single accountable owner** for Pearl PRO's outcomes, not one contributor among several on a shared roadmap.

We're looking for someone who is genuinely energized by building consumer-grade digital products - clean, intuitive, fast experiences - and who wants to apply that bar to a professional, workflow-heavy user base. Real estate agents are busy, mobile-first, and unforgiving of friction; they'll only adopt a tool that fits how they already work and clearly makes them more effective with clients. This role requires a **sharp sense for professional user needs** alongside the product craft usually reserved for consumer apps.

You'll work closely with a dedicated designer and engineering lead/squad on Pearl PRO, plus Data Science & Standards (to translate Pearl Score and scoring concepts into clear, trustworthy agent-facing experiences) and Business Development/Customer Success (to keep the roadmap grounded in what's winning and losing deals with brokerages and agents).

**What you'll do**

Product strategy & ownership

* Own the Pearl PRO product strategy and roadmap, in partnership with the SVP Product.
* Be the single point of accountability for Pearl PRO's outcomes - adoption, engagement, and agent/broker satisfaction.
* Make and defend prioritization calls, balancing agent needs, business goals, and delivery realities.

### **Consumer-grade product craft**

* Set and hold a high bar for UX quality across both the Pearl PRO web app and mobile app - the app should feel as considered as the best consumer products agents use every day, not like enterprise software.
* Drive end-to-end discovery: research, define, and validate solutions before committing engineering resources.
* Write clear specs and requirements that let design and engineering move fast without re-litigating scope.

### **Deep user understanding**

* Build and maintain a sharp, current understanding of real estate agents' workflows, incentives, and daily pressures - from listing prep through closing.

**At Inriver, we help brands deliver better product experiences - everywhere their customers are. From the first product detail to the final purchase decision, we make product information work smarter.**
  
  
Now we're looking for a **Group Product Manager, Industry Solutions** to be our platform expert in front of customers and our voice for B2B Manufacturing back into Product. This is a hybrid role - part Sales Engineering, part Product Management, part Solution Architect - for someone who loves being close to customers and close to product decisions at the same time. You'll represent Inriver in customer conversations such as RFPs, check-ins and events, and you'll represent our Ideal Customer Profile, B2B Manufacturing, inside Inriver. You'll bring back what you hear, and you'll influence roadmaps across teams to act on it. In some cases that means shaping what dev teams build next. In others, it means building the answer yourself, configuring templates and solutions using the Inriver platform's own extensibility (including MCPs) to show what's possible, no dev resources required. This role reports to the SVP of Product Management.

### **Why you'll love this role**

* Be the platform expert in the room: Demoing Inriver, answering the hard questions, and representing product in RFPs, customer check-ins, and events
* Become our resident expert on B2B Manufacturing, our Ideal Customer Profile, and bring that signal directly into product decisions
* Work hands-on with the platform's extensibility features and prototyping tools to create solutions yourself, not just spec them for someone else
* Sit at the intersection of Sales, Partners, and Product, with real influence over what gets built.
* Join a company with strong product ambitions and a friendly, down-to-earth culture.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Deliver product demos that speak credibly to both business and technical stakeholders
* Gather structured feedback from customers and partners, and translate it into clear input for Product Management
* Build deep expertise in B2B Manufacturing as our ICP; their workflows, data challenges, and buying criteria
* Influence roadmap priorities across product teams by bringing evidence, not just requests

* Partner closely with Sales, Partner teams, Marketing, and Customer Success to keep the product story sharp and consistent

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

We don’t expect you to tick every box - but we think you’ll succeed here if you have many of the below:

️ 5-10 years of experience in a hybrid role spanning Sales Engineering, Product Management, or Solution Development, or strong exposure to more than one of these disciplines

️ Comfort presenting and demoing complex software to customers, from technical buyers to business stakeholders

️ A builder's mindset: you'd rather configure a working prototype than write a requirements doc about one

️ Experience within B2B Manufacturing

️ Familiarity with platform extensibility concepts (APIs, low-code configurators, MCPs, or similar), or eagerness to get hands-on with them

️ Strong communication skills: equally comfortable in an RFP response, a customer workshop, or a roadmap review

️ A collaborative mindset: you bring structure, curiosity, and follow-through

️ Willingness to travel occasionally for customer sites, team meet-ups and events

* A role with real visibility: to customers, to partners, and to the product roadmap
* The chance to shape how B2B Manufacturing customers experience
