**Why Work at Mercer Advisors?**

For more than 40 years, Mercer Advisors has been helping families amplify and simplify their financial lives by integrating financial planning, investment management, business management, tax, estate, insurance, and more, all managed by a single team. We deliver the kind of comprehensive care once reserved for only the wealthiest households.

Today, we serve over 42,800+ families across 110+ cities across the U.S. Ranked the #1 RIA Firm in the nation by Barron's for two consecutive years, Mercer Advisors is an independent fiduciary legally bound to act in our clients' best interests — always.\*

Mercer Advisors offers a workplace that stands apart in the financial industry. More than half of our employees and client-facing professionals are women, reflecting the clients we serve. With a flexible, national footprint, we build our teams around exceptional talent — wherever they are.

Join us and help families amplify and simplify their financial lives with confidence.

* *Mercer Advisors was ranked #1 for RIA firms with up to $70 billion in assets. The Barron's top RIA ranking is based on a combination of metrics – including size, growth, service quality, technology, succession planning and others. No fee was paid for participation in the ranking, however, Mercer Advisors has paid a fee to Barron's to use the ranking in marketing. Please see important information about the ranking criteria methodology* *here**.*

**Job Summary:**

Our ability to attract new clients is at the center of our continued success. As we've continued to grow - the success of our growth efforts relies increasingly on the digital experience, processes, and technologies that we offer to prospects, clients, as well as our own employees.

As the Senior Product Manager you are responsible for managing and executing the digital experiences and technologies that support our growth. You will be a key partner to achieve our growth targets – and will design and own digital experiences, technology, and processes - including integrations with partners. As a key-leader on our cross-functional team, you will be co-accountable for our OKRs.

You will provide organizational vision, leadership and strategy for our processes and products. You will be deeply hands on with the related technology (ensuring exceptional product day-to-day administration, data quality, user support) as well as establishing the long term vision, managing the overall roadmap enhancements, including system architecture, custom development, data integration, and ongoing release management. To be successful in this role, you must both have terrific operational skills and be able to think strategically about how the products can further enhance our business and how to successfully integrate acquired firms. A successful candidate will act like "employee #2" at a fast-moving startup and think like a "Growth CTO" for an established industry leader.

**Essential Job Functions:**

* Responsible for activities related to the design and development of our products and applications
* Deeply understand our business and collaborate across the organization to identify and prioritize technology, process and experience initiatives that will drive results
* Provide strategic direction across all functions to support the product environment, and facilitate the cross-functional squad in the execution of these initiatives
* Prepare, manage, and maintain documentation of current business processes, the implementation of internal processes, and measure KPI's.
* Build and continuously refine the product roadmap in close collaboration with business stakeholders.
* Collaboratively define and document functional and technical requirements and specifications, business processes, workflows, and reporting output
* Regularly collaborate and seek input from internal and external users, to identifying gaps and opportunities related to current processes
* Organize technical projects from beginnin

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Customer Zero
jobs.desc:
##### **Integration meets Innovation**

At Celigo, we believe integration should empower — not exhaust — innovation. As a modern Integration and Automation Platform (iPaaS), we're on a mission to simplify how companies integrate, automate, and optimize processes. Powered by game-changing technology like runtime AI and prebuilt, mission-critical integrations, Celigo is redefining how businesses connect their world.

Celigo is looking for a **Principal Product Manager - Customer Zero** to own the highest-leverage program in the company: running Celigo on Celigo. When GTO operates on our own platform across GTM, CX, and G&A systems, we become our own best customer. We discover what's hard before customers find it, feed it directly into Product, and give Sales a credible, live reference in every deal. This role is the dedicated owner of that program, end-to-end.

##### **What would you do if hired?**

* Own the Customer Zero program as a funded initiative with a real roadmap, clear outcomes, and an operating rhythm that holds across competing priorities. You set the pace, define what done looks like, and keep the work alive without needing someone to push it. You measure yourself by business value delivered, not by meetings held.
* Drive adoption of Celigo's own products (agents, MCP, Ora/CLI, integrations) inside GTO's GTM, CX, and G&A systems. When you run into friction, you dig into it before being asked. Surface what's genuinely hard, prioritize it, and shepherd it into Product's roadmap in partnership with the CPO's org.
* Use Celigo's AI-powered platform as part of how you work every day. You will be one of the first people inside the company to push on new agentic capabilities, give Product honest feedback on where they deliver and where they fall short, and help define what "AI-first" actually looks like inside an enterprise workflow. Your daily use is part of the feedback loop.
* Bring product discipline to every workstream: defined requirements, clear success criteria, and prioritization grounded in adoption and business value. Committed dates should hold because you've done the thinking up front, shipping the smallest version that delivers real value and iterating from there rather than waiting for a perfect build.
* Operate in both hats simultaneously: design the underlying business processes and own the solution as a product manager. You're the person who figures out how the process should work and the person accountable for whether what ships delivers an outstanding experience.
* Weigh user needs against security, privacy, and governance considerations (RBAC, permissions, service accounts), making trade-offs deliberately rather than after the fact. Build the prescriptive playbook Product and Sales need: governance patterns, reference architectures, and proof points that hold up in enterprise conversations.
* Be the external face of how Celigo runs on Celigo. Present at flagship events, join key customer and prospect conversations, and package our internal use into references Sales can put in front of prospects and existing customers. Enable Product Marketing and Sales to scale the story beyond you.

##### **Who are we looking for?**

**Skills & Abilities**

* You're energized by building something that doesn't fully exist yet. You ask the questions others skip past, including the uncomfortable ones about what's actually broken, and you treat ambiguity as the job, not an obstacle to it.
* You connect your work to the bigger picture. You understand why Customer Zero matters to the company, and you make decisions that serve that outcome, including the trade-offs nobody told you to make. You ask "why" before "how."
* You ship the smallest version that delivers real value and iterate on real feedback. A 10-slide internal use case that lands in one deal is better than a perfect playbook no one has read. You recover quickly when something doesn't land, without drama.
* You treat the program's problems as your own. You move

jobs.desc:
**About RocketRez:**  
RocketRez is the revenue maximization platform behind boat tours, theme parks, zoos, and other attractions and experience operators. Operators run their businesses on us: ticketing, capacity, memberships, point of sale, web stores, and the data that tells them how how to grow their business.
  
  
**The role:**  
**You'll own a product domain end to end:** its outcomes, its roadmap, its customers, and the case for where engineering time goes. You'll work in a trio with a designer and engineering, from discovery through launch and long-term growth.
  
This is not a backlog-grooming role. You'll be handed a business problem and held accountable for what moved, including what you chose not to build.
  
  
**Where it will sit:**  
**One idea runs through every domain:** operators move more of their business onto RocketRez when they trust us with their busiest day. Features earn that trust, and trust shows up as revenue. Your job is to find the changes that strengthen it and prove they did.
  
The domains you own will depend on where the business needs you and where your strengths fit. The outcomes below are illustrative. We'll set specific ones with you in your first weeks.
  
Core Ticketing. The fundamental building blocks operators use to turn their experiences into sellable products: single-use, multi-use and reloadable tickets; recurring products like memberships and donations; auto-renewing passes; timed, multi-date and multi-pack admissions; assigned seating; bundles and cross-sells. It also covers how those products are priced, from discounts and upsells to dynamic, usage-based and channel-specific pricing. For operators, this is how new products come to life, capturing more demand and maximizing the revenue of every sale. You'd answer for how quickly operators can launch new products and how much revenue each sale captures.
  
**Distribution. How operators' products get sold:** white-label ecommerce for each operator, RocketRez point of sale at the front gate, OTAs, and third-party sales partners. The work is building systems that make it as easy as possible for a guest to discover what an operator offers, find the best product for them, and complete the sale as quickly as possible. You'd answer for conversion by channel, attach rate, and throughput on peak days.
  
Ancillary Revenue. Revenue beyond admission, like food and beverage and retail, including the build-vs-partner calls that decide how we enter each line. You'd answer for ancillary revenue per guest, and for deals won because we can serve a broader range of operators.
  
  
**What you'll do:**  
**Strategy and roadmap• Own the roadmap:** sizing, sequencing, and what gets cut, even when the CEO or a major customer is asking for it. Engineering is a shared pool, not a dedicated squad, so make an evidence-backed case for your domain's claim on capacity and show that it paid off.
  

* Know the market well enough to say which gaps are worth closing, and shape pricing and packaging, not just scope.

Discovery, delivery and measurement• Spend real time with operators, like a zoo on a holiday weekend or a tour operator selling through OTAs. Tell a truly painful workflow from a merely unfamiliar one.
  

* Define success before you build, including instrumentation that doesn't exist yet. Measure behaviour change, not adoption.
* Write requirements engineering can estimate against, in plain language.
* Be willing to conclude that a thesis is wrong, and say so plainly.

As a Senior PM, you'll• Raise the decision quality of other PMs through review, pairing and mentoring, and contribute to hiring.
  

* Be the escalation point for cross-domain conflict, not the escalator.

**Two ways to be great here:**  
We hire PMs who lean toward one of two archetypes. Tell us which one sounds like you.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Data Cloud and Connectors
jobs.desc:
Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

About DX

DX is the developer intelligence platform. We help engineering leaders understand how work gets done, improve developer experience, and make better decisions about productivity and AI. DX combines self-reported insights from developers with data from the systems where software work happens, then turns those signals into insights teams can act on.

The role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead DX's data platform and connector portfolio.

The data platform is the foundation beneath every DX insight. It connects to the tools our customers use, ingests and organizes their data, protects its integrity, and makes it available to the rest of the DX product. You will own the product direction and outcomes for Data Cloud, our connector ecosystem, core data integrity, and the data infrastructure behind our demo environment.

This is a deeply technical product role. You do not need to be an engineer, but you must be able to reason credibly about connectors, APIs, data models, database design, data lakes, reliability, enterprise data requirements, and data privacy/security. You will turn that understanding into a data platform that customers and internal product teams can trust.

What you'll do

  • Set the vision, strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for DX's Data Cloud and connector ecosystem.
  • Prioritize connector investments using customer demand, market context, strategic leverage, and the needs of downstream DX products.
  • Improve the end-to-end connector experience, including setup, authentication, configuration, data mapping, sync health, and troubleshooting.
  • Define product requirements for data quality, freshness, completeness, reliability, and transparency.
  • Partner closely with Engineering on the evolution of DX's unified data layer while maintaining a clear boundary between product direction and technical design.
  • Own the product capabilities that keep DX's demo environment representative, reliable, and useful.
  • Build a deep understanding of enterprise data environments, security constraints, integration patterns, and the teams responsible for them.
  • Shape ambiguous opportunities with lightweight specs, prototypes, and clear written context before the team commits to a solution.
  • Know how the platform is performing across connector adoption, time to value, reliability, and customer satisfaction; investigate problems and drive the right improvements.
  • Partner with customer-facing and go-to-market teams on connector discovery, pilots, launches, documentation, and positioning.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - Data Products and Analytics
jobs.desc:
**About Vehlo:**

We started Vehlo in 2019 with a simple goal: to be the industry’s favorite provider of repair shop technology.

Across every part of the auto repair industry, Vehlo is igniting vehicle service success with software and financial solutions that unlock your potential. Our founder-led products power the entire service lane experience and keep customers coming back with streamlined tools that help you handle communication, workflow automation, touchless payments, valet pickup, and much more. We’re out to simplify the customer journey from start to finish and give power back to the people under the hood, making their jobs easier and your shop more profitable —just ask our over 30,000 customers, who generate more than 60M annual repair orders, and process over $12B in payments volume annually. At Vehlo, our only purpose is your success, and together, we’re reaching your goals faster than ever.

Being a Veep comes with more than a comprehensive benefits package—our biggest benefit is opportunity: Opportunity to make an impact, opportunity for growth, and opportunity for recognition and rewards. This is not a mega-corporation where you wonder what people are doing all day - every Veep is moving the ball forward day in, day out for our customers or for each other.

**About This Role:**

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to own our customer-facing data, analytics and insights portfolio end to end. Most of our customers buy more than one Vehlo product and then cobble together other solutions to assemble the 360-degree view of their business that we don't yet give them natively.

Closing that gap is the starting point, but the bigger opportunity is what we build on top of it. We're not looking for someone to ship more dashboards. More value will come from AI-powered insights that tell an operator what's happening in their business and what to do about it, without them having to know what to ask.

At Vehlo, a Principal Product role is senior, highly visible, and hands-on, reporting to the SVP of Product. You won't have direct reports on day one, but that could change as we grow the business. You'll own strategy and set the pace of play while leading through partners in engineering, analytics, customer success and go-to-market. You'll drive the commercial model as well as the product: what it costs us to serve, what belongs in which tier, and what customers pay for.

**What You'll Do:**

* New AI-powered insight products, built zero to one: surfacing what an operator would never have thought to ask, explaining why a number moved, predicting what's coming, and recommending the next action, delivered inside the workflow rather than in a separate analytics destination.
* The premium analytics product line end to end: reporting and dashboard experiences, alerting, natural-language reporting, and meaningful additions to the basic reporting built into individual products.
* The cross-product view: one unified analytics experience spanning a customer's entire Vehlo footprint.
* Data delivery beyond the dashboard: APIs, MCP surfaces, exports, warehouse sharing, BI connectors, and the access model that governs which customer sees which data.
* The semantic layer and the metric definitions inside it, across products that were built separately and don't yet agree with each other.
* Pricing, packaging, and unit economics: cost-to-serve per location, what's free because it drives retention, and what's genuinely a paid tier.
* Aggregate benchmarking and market-intelligence products built from our repair data, along with the data-rights and aggregation model that makes them defensible.
* Data quality and customer trust as measured product outcomes, so we reinforce trust and value in the market.

**In your first 90 days**

* Align the teams on a governance model so everyone knows what every number in our analytics product means and where it comes from.
* Build a cost-to-serve model per location that our finance team accepts.

**Description**

Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions.

Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.

Every lead sent to our premium customers is vetted and live-transferred to an agent through our Concierge Call Center, and which agent gets that lead is decided by a matching model that increasingly encodes customer-specific business rules, for example price-point eligibility or agent tier restrictions.

This role owns that matching model and everything downstream of it: the agent handoff experience, and the smaller product issues premium customers currently experience as bugs in that flow. You'll have a dedicated engineering team building this with you, and you'll work closely with the teams that own the customer-facing applications where these rules surface.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* The matching model: which agent receives a vetted lead, including customer-configurable eligibility and preference rules (e.g. price-point-based agent restrictions) that surface in customer-facing applications.
* Answer-to-Claim and the agent handoff experience: the flow from a vetted lead to a claimed, worked lead.
* Smaller improvements: fixes and refinements to issues premium customers currently perceive as bugs in the handoff experience.
* Claim Rate and Assignment Rate: the two funnel metrics that roll up, together with the Call Center Platform PM's metrics, into overall Live Transfer Rate.

**What you won't own today**
----------------------------

Call-center infrastructure sits with the Call Center Platform PM today. As the two roles mature this scope could expand to include call-center infrastructure.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own the roadmap for the matching mechanism in close collaboration with the customer experience teams, prioritized against Claim Rate and Assignment Rate impact
* Partner with engineering to turn customer-specific eligibility and preference rules into scalable configuration, not one-off logic per customer.
* Work with the teams owning customer-facing applications to ship the surfaces where customers set or see their matching rules.
* Triage and prioritize the smaller features premium customers experience as bugs in the handoff flow, and decide what's a quick fix versus a roadmap item.
* Track and report on Claim Rate and Assignment Rate, and how they roll up into overall Live Transfer Rate.
* Coordinate with the Call Center Platform PM to keep the boundary between matching logic and call-center execution clean, and help redraw that boundary if the role's scope expands.
* Represent this domain in planning, prioritization, and leadership reviews.

**Education & Experience**
--------------------------

* 8+ years of Product Management experience with a track record of owning complex business logic or decisioning systems, not just user-facing features.
* Experience working in marketplaces or lead-gen models where allocation, matching, or eligibility rules directly affect revenue.
* Comfort translating customer-facing configuration needs (pricing tiers, eligibility rules) into product and engineering requirements.
* A track record of driving measurable funnel metrics (conversion, claim, assignment, or similar) rather than shipping features and hoping they help.

Our mission is to return the atmosphere to 280 ppm CO₂. We convert excess inedible biomass into carbon-rich bio-oil and inject it into underground storage for permanent carbon removal. At scale, we can use bio-oil to make fossil-free iron.

Our carbon removal efforts began in 2020 with initial purchases from customers like Stripe, Shopify, and Microsoft. Since then, we’ve scaled to **thousands of tons of carbon removal**, grown to over a hundred employees, and established three locations in San Francisco, Colorado, and Louisiana.

We're expanding our team of ambitious, creative, and hands-on problem solvers. We value psychological safety, collaboration, and continuous learning. We take calculated risks and treat mistakes as opportunities to improve. If you're excited about tackling big challenges, we encourage you to explore **our company values**.

Come help us reverse climate change. Gigatons or bust!

As a Sr. Technical Program Manager in the Engineering Department, you will oversee and align complex, cross-functional engineering initiatives with strategic business objectives on the team across all major business units (Biomass, Pyrolysis, and Injection).   + Interface with Mechanical Engineers, Electrical Engineers, Automation Engineers, Materials Scientists, Process Development Engineers, Engineering Technicians, and Fabrication/Welding personnel to drive full system development cycles.
  + Collaborate on processing techniques, quality protocols, and analytical testing of Charm materials (ex. bio-oil, bio char, and biomass) through partnership with Pyrolysis and in-house Analytical Laboratory leaders.

jobs.desc:
Digible is a privately owned and operated digital marketing company founded in 2017 with a mission to bring cutting-edge solutions to the multifamily industry. We offer a full suite of digital services, alongside Fiona, our predictive analytics platform—the first of its kind.

At Digible, we take pride in our collaborative, transparent, and authentic culture. Since 2021, we've been recognized as a Top Workplace in Colorado and secured the #8 spot in the Best Places to Work Multifamily rankings. From our hiring process to our All Hands meetings and Town Halls, our values are at the core of everything we do.

We believe diversity fuels innovation, and we strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work. If you're ready to do the best work of your career, we'd love to have you on the team!

### **Core Values**

* **Authenticity** — The commitment to be steadfast and genuine with our actions and communication toward everyone we touch.
* **Curiosity** — The belief that a deep and fundamental curiosity (the "why") in our work is vital to company innovation and evolution.
* **Focus** — The collective will to remain completely devoted and ultimately accountable to our deliverables.
* **Humility** — The recognition and daily practice that "we" is always greater than "I".
* **Happiness** — The decision to prioritize passion and love for what we do above everything else.

**The Role**
------------

Digible is hiring a Group Product Manager who is both a hands-on product manager and an experienced people leader. Your primary responsibility is being the product manager for your own pod, and showing business results for that pod's area of responsibility is your top priority. In addition, you directly manage and coach two experienced Product Managers who each run their own pod. You and your two PMs work as a unit to identify overlaps and opportunities across pods, and you resolve them strategically and proactively in your respective product strategies and roadmaps rather than letting them surface as conflicts in delivery.

In your own pod, you'll work on integrations, customer data architecture, core platform, and workflow productization, and you should be excited by exactly that kind of work. You'll also work on some customer-facing experiences and run customer discovery and research, build real relationships with customers and stakeholders, and set and communicate strategy clearly enough to bring the company with you.

As a senior member of the team, you'll help lead AI transformation across product, design, and engineering, and you'll help shape how product management is practiced at Digible (AI-native, problem-first, customer-obsessed) through your own example and your coaching. You'll report to the VP of Product.

We're a small product org inside a profitable, bootstrapped company — nine years successful before the recent AI wave, and now in the middle of an AI transformation, reinventing how an established company operates and thrives in the AI era. Profitability and bootstrapping mean you'll work on real customer and business problems, not a search for product/market fit, with a direct line to an accessible leadership team. jobs.title: Senior Product Owner
jobs.desc:
**Position Summary**

The Senior Product Owner (PO) owns the vision, backlog, and delivery outcomes for one or more of Roeing’s public-sector software products. The Senior PO translates state and federal program requirements into a prioritized backlog, represents Roeing’s voice to the customer and the customer’s voice to internal delivery teams, and is accountable for maximizing product value across the full software development lifecycle. This is a senior individual-contributor role expected to operate with minimal oversight, mentor Business Analysts and Product Owners, and serve as the escalation point for backlog, prioritization, and requirements decisions on assigned product(s).

**Key Responsibilities**

Product Vision, Strategy & Regulatory Ownership

* Define and communicate the product vision and roadmap, aligned to Roeing’s strategic objectives and the governing state/federal program guidelines for the assigned agency contract.
* Serve as the regulatory subject-matter expert, tracking compliance and reporting/data-transparency obligations that shape the roadmap, and driving continuous improvement to keep pace with them.

**Product Backlog Management**

* Own, create, refine, and prioritize the product backlog independently, writing clear epics, user stories, and testable acceptance criteria, sequenced by value, risk, dependency, and urgency.
* Plan product releases — scope, schedule, and goals — and forecast delivery dates and outcomes in partnership with the assigned PM.

**Stakeholder & Client Collaboration**

* Act as the primary liaison between state-agency stakeholders, customers, and Roeing’s development, QA, and architecture teams.
* Gather and reconcile competing requirements from agency staff, executive sponsors, and end users, resolving conflicts and managing expectations through the product roadmap.

**Agile Delivery Leadership**

* Participate in and help facilitate Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives within Roeing’s Azure DevOps-based delivery process; review and formally accept completed increments.
* Mentor Business Analysts and Product Owners on backlog discipline and user-story quality (per Roeing’s IIBA-aligned standard), and document solution behavior per Roeing’s Developer Solution Description SOP for QA and SOC 2 traceability.

**Product Value, Market & Client-Facing Duties**

* Maximize product value by ensuring releases meet customer-satisfaction and business-goal targets, iterating on ticket-metrics and user feedback.
* Represent Roeing at trade associations, tradeshows, or user-group meetings, and partner with the Account Executive on demos, RFP/SOW input, and quarterly user training.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field (equivalent experience considered).
* 5+ years in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or Product Management, including 2+ years at a senior/lead level of independence.
* Demonstrated experience owning a backlog for a live, in-production software product — public-sector or regulated-industry experience strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of the full SDLC and Agile/Scrum delivery, with proven ability to write high-quality, testable requirements under competing priorities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to executive sponsors and non-technical stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps (Roeing’s standard tool) for backlog, sprint, and release management; SharePoint experience a plus.

Preferred Qualifications & Certifications

Roeing does not currently require certification for this role, but the following credentials are preferred and reflect the closest formal standards bodies for product ownership (there is no single organization named a “Product Owner Institute”):

* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or Advanced CSPO — Scrum Alliance; or Professional Scrum Product Owner I/II (PSPO

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager I - Regulatory Reporting
jobs.desc:
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of our Regulatory Reporting products. You'll sit at the intersection of regulation, investment data, and technology, translating complex and changing regulatory requirements into scalable, client-ready product capabilities. You'll work closely with engineering and data teams and engage directly with internal teams and external clients to make sure our solutions meet their compliance obligations.

**Responsibilities:**

  

* Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for regulatory reporting, balancing regulatory deadlines, client needs, and long-term platform goals.
* Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on the product, translating new and amended requirements into clear user stories, specifications, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with engineering on technical design, trade-offs, and delivery, taking part in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and architecture discussions.
* Work with clients, compliance teams, and client-facing groups to gather requirements, run feedback sessions, and support onboarding and adoption.
* Define how data flows across the investment lifecycle (trading, post-trade, operations, accounting, and reporting) and make sure regulatory outputs are accurate, complete, and auditable.
* Shape the client-facing tooling experience, including data delivery, integrations, APIs, file formats, and reporting interfaces.
* Define success metrics and track adoption, data quality, timeliness, and client satisfaction.
* Collaborate across Engineering, Data, Compliance, Client Services, Sales, and Operations to deliver cohesive solutions.
* Prepare product documentation, release communications, and client-facing materials.

**Requirements:**

  

* 7+ years of product management experience, with a strong technical product perspective.
* Background in regulatory reporting within financial services or fintech.
* Working knowledge of the investment lifecycle, including trading, operational functions, and the reporting that flows from them.
* Track record of working day to day with engineering teams in an agile environment.
* Experience working directly with external clients, including gathering requirements and managing expectations.
* Understanding of development architecture, workflows, and external client tooling (data feeds, APIs, integrations, reporting platforms).
* Ability to break down ambituous, complex requirements into clear, actionable product plans.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present to technical and non-technical audiences.

**Preferred:**

  

* Familiarity with the regulatory regimes relevant to the business, such as:
* MiFID II, EMIR
* Solvency II (EIOPA/NCAs, e.g., BaFin (Germany), ACPR (France), IVASS (Italy), DNB (Netherlands), Central Bank of Ireland, CAA (Luxembourg))
* Solvency UK (PRA)
* BSCR (BMA, Bermuda)
* Swiss Solvency Test (FINMA)
* NAIC RBC (US states)
* LICAT/MCT (OSFI, Canada)
* ESG regulation (e.g., SFDR, EU Taxonomy, CSRD)
* Experience with data modeling, data quality frameworks, reporting, or analytics tooling.
* Experience with SaaS or platform products serving institutional investors, insurers, asset managers, or corporates.
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, SQL, and BI platforms.

jobs.desc:

Stream is on a mission to bring financial wellbeing to all workers.

We partner with some of the world's most well-known employers, like Crate & Barrel, Driven Brands, General Electric, New Balance, Restaurant Brands International (RBI) and others, to give their teams access to fairer financial services. Over 3 million people track their shifts and earnings, start their first savings account, use budgeting tools, access financial education and choose when they want to get paid. All in one smartphone app.

Stream is unique: VC-backed and growing at scale-up pace, but with a social conscience. Some of the world's leading financial charities and impact funds were our founding investors.

You'd be joining a team of over 300 passionate, ambitious people across the UK, Europe and US, building a category-leading FinTech product with the mission to improve the lives of millions.

**The Opportunity:**

This isn’t a traditional PM role. Reporting into the US VP, Product, you’ll be the person responsible for owning, shipping, and localising Stream’s net-new products in the US market - from Wealth and flexible pay to AI-powered financial tools built specifically for frontline and everyday workers.

Stream’s US business is growing fast. The right person for this role will look at it and see not just a great job, but a seat at the table as this business scales toward its next chapter as a US leading workplace finance provider.

**The Team:**

You’ll work directly with a US engineering team, leading the product function with real autonomy. You’ll set the roadmap direction, drive MVPs from idea to launch at pace, and make the kind of decisions that matter. We’re not looking for someone who executes a vision handed to them. We’re looking for someone who has a vision of their own - and the conviction to ship it.

**What will you be doing?**

* Own the product roadmap for Stream’s US diversifying product suite.
* Lead the end-to-end launch of Stream’s first net-new products in the US market - from discovery and scoping to MVP, iteration, and scale.
* Work hands-on with the US engineering team to ship at high velocity, keeping things moving across time zones with clarity and urgency.

* Explore AI-powered use cases for Stream’s audience: people who are currently underserved by the wave of AI tools being built for knowledge workers.
* Be the voice of the consumer inside the product team, pushing back on ideas that don’t serve the people we’re building for.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with US Analytics, Partnership Marketing, and other product teams to align on priorities and land products that work end-to-end.

* Years of product management experience, ideally in consumer-facing, regulated tech or fintech (but that’s not essential)
* A track record of shipping products that people actually use - not just managing roadmaps.
* Experience working in or with scale-ups: comfortable with ambiguity, fast cycles, and doing more with less.
* Genuine context around the US socio-economic landscape and the financial challenges facing low-income and frontline workers (benefits, credit, SNAP, and beyond).

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Data Infrastructure
jobs.desc:
For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well.

For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you.

**Angi at a glance:**

* Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021
* Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide
* Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting

**About the Team**
------------------

Data Infrastructure builds the platform that every other data team stands on: access to shared data, orchestration, data ingestion, and the retirement of systems the company has outgrown. Every layer of this platform exists to make it easier for a homeowner to hire an Angi Pro, on one certified source of truth that people and AI agents can trust equally.

The team's strategy is built around one idea: this platform should feel like a self-service product, not a ticket queue, for the engineers and analysts who depend on it, and increasingly for the AI agents who depend on it too. Angi is moving toward AI agents as a normal way of building and operating, and every agent that touches company data comes through this platform first.

This role stewards that platform's product direction.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Product Management**

* Manage governed platform access - give engineers, analysts, and services safe, auditable access to shared data, and make the safe path the easy path.
* Streamline orchestration and scheduling - bring fragmented scheduling tools together into one system every team reaches for by default, and use AI-assisted tooling to migrate jobs faster, with less manual engineering effort.
* Drive data ingestion and replication - define what self-service ingestion looks like for teams who want to bring their own data onto the platform, and build toward that.
* Oversee legacy system retirement - close out systems that are no longer the source of truth, with clear ownership handed off at every step.
* Optimize compute cost efficiency - find where cost comes from habit rather than real need, and bring it down without anyone losing the developer experience they rely on.
* Advance compute strategy diversification - help move the platform toward a storage layer that works with more than one compute engine, so each workload runs on the engine built for it.
* Build the platform's AI-ready substrate - make agentic workflows safe by default, with the same governed access and audit trail for an agent as for a person.

**Execution and Individual Contribution**

* Use AI agents in your own daily work, set clear norms so the engineers and peers around you feel safe experimenting with agents and agentic workflows.
* Protect the team's focus and drive real rigor without micromanaging how the work gets done. Steward outcomes, not tasks.
* Build trust across engineering, domain teams, and leadership through empathetic, transparent, and clear communication when addressing complex challenges.
* Work closely with Data Engineering's other delivery teams - Data Mesh Enablement and Managed Data Products - and with the team building Angi's agentic workflows, toward one overall technical strategy.

**Who You Are**
---------------

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Five or more years of product management experience on a data or infrastructure platform team, where you stewarded technical roadmaps directly.
* Comfortable reading system architecture and pipeline dependencies well enough to make real sequencing calls with engineering.
* A record of taking cross-team migrations and retirements all the way to done, not just to a plan.

In this role, you will partner deeply with Finance stakeholders to understand complex operational workflows, identify pain points, and build scalable tools that improve accuracy, speed, and visibility across financial operations. This role will be located in Plymouth, Michigan and report to our Sr. Staff Product Manager.

**Finance Domain Expertise & User Research:**

* Become the subject matter expert for Finance and Accounting workflows at Rivian, including but not limited to accounts payable/receivable, treasury, financial close, reporting, forecasting, and compliance processes.
* Conduct deep user research with finance stakeholders, gathering qualitative and quantitative feedback to uncover pain points, inefficiencies, and unmet needs.
* Map existing workflows to identify manual processes, data silos, and opportunities to drive automation and accuracy improvements.

**Product Vision, Strategy & Roadmap:**

* Define and champion a clear product vision and roadmap for Finance & Accounting tools that aligns with Rivian’s strategic objectives around operational efficiency, financial accuracy, and compliance.
* Make a compelling case for changes, secure cross-functional stakeholder buy-in, and communicate product strategy clearly to stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
* Lead the product strategy end-to-end with limited supervision, focusing on high-level objectives that advance broader organizational goals.

**Custom Solution Design & Product Delivery:**

* Translate Finance user needs into detailed product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Collaborate with engineering and design teams to prioritize features that eliminate data silos and reduce manual effort.
* Manage the full product lifecycle — from discovery through development, testing, and launch — ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of custom-built finance tools.
* Oversee integration with ERP systems (e.g., SAP), financial data platforms, and third-party tools to create seamless workflows for the Finance team.
* Manage multiple inputs and deliverables simultaneously, understanding connections between financial systems and broader business workstreams.

**Data-Driven Optimization & AI/ML:**

* Leverage data and analytics to identify opportunities for improvement, track key performance metrics (e.g., close cycle time, error rates, process throughput), and drive continuous optimization.
* Research and evaluate AI/ML opportunities to automate repetitive finance processes, improve forecasting accuracy, detect anomalies, and enhance decision-making for finance leadership.
* Clearly communicate expectations and carefully track progress to ensure standards are met at a systematic level — keeping work on track across sprints and quarters.

**Collaboration & Stakeholder Management:**

* Work effectively with cross-functional teams including engineering, design, finance, accounting, and IT to ensure alignment and successful product delivery.

* Experience working with Finance, Accounting, or business operations teams as internal customers is strongly preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Incentives
jobs.desc:
Hello, we're Augeo – we are a global leader in enterprise-level engagement and loyalty platform technology, delivering compelling experiences and fostering meaningful connections for employees, consumers, members and channel partners across many industries and verticals. We serve hundreds of clients, including 70+ Fortune 500 companies, representing millions of end users.

We are thought leaders and disruptors who think differently and creatively, built by entrepreneurs, operators and innovators. At Augeo, we're passionate about providing an inclusive workplace that values diversity and our sustainability initiatives. Everyone is welcome - our employees are comfortable bringing their authentic whole selves to work. Be you, reach your full potential.

We work hard, we play hard and, most importantly, we care to our core about our teams and each other. We over-communicate around everything… especially while we navigate our new hybrid world.

**Summary:**

Augeo's Applied AI team builds THEO, the orchestration and intelligence layer behind the reward, recognition, incentive and advocacy programs our clients run. We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the Incentives domain: the THEO capability set that brings intelligence and automation to performance incentive programs, enabling organizations to configure programs, evaluate participant performance, identify earned outcomes, and orchestrate rewards and payouts at scale.

Today, THEO Reward capabilities power personalized reward search, discovery, and redemption in client marketplaces, with recommendations from an ML model trained on more than four million interactions. Within the next six to twelve months we expect to be in market with both THEO Incentives and THEO Recognition capabilities supporting new and existing clients, alongside continued expansion of personalized rewards and offers.

The Applied AI team is organized into four capability pods. (1) Intelligence/ML has a product manager and an AI architect/data scientist. (2) Rewards, (3) Recognition, and (4) Incentives each have a product manager and an AI architect. You would lead the Incentives pod with the Incentives AI Architect and partner most closely with Intelligence/ML on the models and signals behind incentive decisions.

THEO sits at Augeo's core, and its capabilities are built for every business unit rather than rebuilt inside each one. An incentive program for a Workplace client runs on the same THEO capability as an incentive program for an Advocacy client. This role works across all of Augeo’s business units to identify shared requirements and to maintain the boundary between what THEO owns and what each unit builds on top of it.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Incentives domain, from problem discovery through shipped, measured outcomes. Your primary success metric is incremental engagement per reward dollar: more of the behavior a client is paying for, at a lower cost per action

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Forwarded Deployed
jobs.desc:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Mission Command team is part of the Connected Warfare Division. We build the command and control (C2) tools that help warfighters understand what is happening around them, make faster decisions, and direct their forces. We spend a lot of our time with the people who actually use these tools: in the field, during exercises, wherever they are.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

This is not a product manager who happens to spend some time forward. The forward work is the product work. As a Forward Deployed Product Manager, you own the path from a warfighter problem to a fielded solution. That covers applications, data models, user experiences, integrations, and infrastructure.  
  
Most of all, you work as a translation layer between the warfighter and the engineering teams. You embed with units, build real expertise in how they fight, and earn enough trust that influence runs both ways. You are there to solve their problems, not to sell them something, and you build an open, trusting relationship by doing exactly that. Sometimes an introduction is made for you. You have to be comfortable with walking into a unit that has never heard of Lattice, and earn your footing from the bottom up.  
  
The profile we are hiring for: a product manager who can walk into a formation, understand the fight, earn the trust of the people in it, map the workflow and the data underneath it, and then pull the right parts of Anduril together to solve it. You walk in with a strong sense of ownership and responsibility, but you back it up with real curiosity and humility.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Own warfighter outcomes, not features.** Embed with units, learn the mission, find the problems that matter most, and own them through development, fielding, and the work that comes after.
* **Build real relationships with the people in the fight.** Earn the trust of warfighters, commanders, staff, and subject matter experts. Become a partner who understands how the unit actually fights, not just what shows up in a requirements document.
* **Do the research in the field.** Learn by watching, asking questions, and taking part in real workflows. Turn what you learn into clear priorities.
* **Connect the fight to the product.** Map the users, decisions, workflows, systems, data, and dependencies behind an outcome, and use that to drive what gets built and integrated.
* **Design across the whole stack.** Do not default to a new app or a new screen. Work out whether an outcome needs an application change, a new or richer data model, an integration, a workflow that spans applications, or a change in how data moves across the Mesh.
* **Use the data model as a product tool.** Get to know what data exists, how it is represented, where it comes from, who uses it, and what has to change to make a workflow possible.
* **Design for the tactical edge.** Understand how the network and the hardware affect what the user sees and does. Account for degraded conditions, bandwidth, latency, and compute when you define a solution.
* **Pull the right people together.** Get warfighters, engineering, design, and the other teams around the same problem, and drive them toward one coherent answer.
* **Make ambiguous problems workable.** Be just as comfortable writing

Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.

We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that “EX = CX”: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.

### **Position Overview**

Decision making in contract technology is shifting. Procurement, CFOs, and CIOs are gaining influence alongside Legal, and they expect contracting outcomes they can measure that are directly connected to company level business strategy. Agiloft has built deep strength with legal personas that will be extended into procurement through additional investments in our products.

As Senior Product Manager for Procurement, you will accelerate the development of procurement-focused contracting motions on our platform. You will identify the highest value procurement scenarios, prioritize for emerging customer demand, and turn them into a roadmap Product builds against.

This is a high-agency, high-accountability product and business building role reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer. You will create and prove value for procurement customers in close partnership with the teams building our core platform and our connected, third-party experiences and generate the evidence that shapes further investment in this motion.

### **Job Responsibilities**

* Define and prioritize the procurement use cases with the clearest path to customer value building upon Agiloft's advanced and growing contracting platform.
* Own a roadmap spanning new capabilities, existing platform features, and integrations.
* Give particular attention to headless experiences and workflows orchestrated by AI agents.
* Ensure delivery of critical procurement product roadmap items in partnership with engineering.

* Translate platform capabilities into a clear procurement value proposition, using customer evidence to guide investment, pricing, and monetization decisions.
* Represent the product strategy in customer conversations, webinars, conferences, and other relevant industry forum

**About Foodsmart**:

Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.

Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment:

Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards.  
Make It Happen - You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.  
One Team - You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.

Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food.

  

**About the Role:**

Reporting to our Chief Product Officer, this Senior Product Manager will be responsible for driving Foodsmart’s member activation. Every outcome we deliver for our members and clients starts with that first visit. You will own the funnel from first outreach to first visit, including the messaging, the channels, and the incentive structure that motivate members to show up.

Your customers are our members and our clients, who depend on us to turn eligible lives into engaged ones. You’ll lead a cross-functional pod to build out the systems and capabilities to achieve this goal and will work closely with Marketing, Data, and Partnerships to find what moves members from “eligible” to “booked” to “showed up,” and to do it at a cost that scales. This role is ideal for a product manager who is as comfortable in a funnel dashboard and an experiment readout as they are in the details of a text-message delivery issue or a broken scheduling flow.

### **You will:**

*Lead the Activation Pod & Funnel*

* Lead a cross-functional pod of Engineering, Design, Data, and Marketing partners with a clear mandate: increase the share of marketable members who complete a first visit
* Own the Activation roadmap, from discovery through launch and iteration, including improvements and buildouts to key capabilities that drive activation (marketing tooling, sign-up / scheduling optimizations, incentive program structure)
* Define and track funnel metrics from outreach to first visit (reach, booking, and show rates) by channel, client, and member segment
* Run a disciplined experimentation program: clear hypotheses, fast readouts, and confident rollouts

*Drive the incentive structure*

* Shape our member incentive strategy end

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Remote)
jobs.desc:
Overview:

GovCIO is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own the delivery strategy and continuous improvement of a complex, high-visibility product — or closely related set of products — within the VA Telehealth portfolio. These products are integral to how Veterans and VA clinical staff connect for virtual care, making this a mission-critical role with real impact on daily Veteran health outcomes.

Reporting to the Program Manager, the Senior PM serves as the primary product lead across VA stakeholders, clinical end users, and cross-functional delivery teams, including subcontracted development teams, — executing the VA's product vision with seasoned judgment, executive presence, and a record of owning consequential products in regulated or enterprise environments.

Responsibilities:

* Own the delivery strategy for an assigned telehealth product or product set, maintaining the roadmap in alignment with VA product vision, mission priorities and Connected Care program goals
* Serve as the primary point of accountability for product outcomes, including scope, quality, schedule, and stakeholder satisfaction
* Partner with VA stakeholders, clinical subject matter experts, and end users to translate complex operational needs into clear, prioritized product requirements
* Provide oversight and strategic guidance to subcontracted development teams executing Agile/Scrum delivery, ensuring sprint execution, backlog health, and release readiness meet the program's established quality standards and processes
* Advise on Agile best practices and delivery process improvements across teams; identify and address gaps in Scrum execution, team velocity, or delivery predictability
* Manage product planning artifacts — including roadmaps, backlogs, release plans, and integrated schedules — and keep stakeholders informed of progress, risks, and key decisions
* Identify, escalate, and drive resolution of cross-team dependencies, risks, and blockers in coordination with the Program Manager
* Coordinate across UX, integration partners, infrastructure, and help desk teams to ensure end-to-end readiness and quality at release
* Support product launches and change management activities in partnership with training and communications teams
* Mentor junior Product Managers and Associate Product Managers on the team

Qualifications:

**Required Skills and Experience**
==================================

* Bachelor's degree in a technical, business, healthcare, or related discipline
* 8+ years of progressive product management experience, including at least 3 years in a senior or lead PM role with full end-to-end ownership of a complex, enterprise-level product
* Track record of delivering in regulated, high-stakes, or mission-critical environments where product failure has meaningful consequences
* Strong working knowledge of Agile/Scrum practices at the team and program level, with demonstrated ability to evaluate delivery performance, advise on improvements, and hold development teams accountable to commitments
* Experience managing or overseeing subcontracted or vendor development teams
* Proven ability to navigate and influence senior stakeholders, with the confidence to drive alignment across competing priorities and organizational complexity
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level reporting and the ability to translate between business and technical contexts
* Experience with backlog and delivery management tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps
* **Clerance Required:** Public Trust clearance eligibility

**Preferred Skills and Experience**
===================================

* Experience supporting VA or federal health IT programs
* Familiarity with VA telehealth workflows, virtual care platforms, or clinical scheduling systems
* Experience with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), including supporting or leading SAFe adoption or program increment planning
* Background in healthcare IT or patient-facing digital health

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Consumer Payments
jobs.desc:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

**About the Product team**  
The Product team listens to our customers' needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.  
  
**About the role**  
The Consumer Payments team powers how customers successfully make payments to Affirm. As a Senior Product Manager, you will create new payment experiences that make repaying easier, improve payment success, and define how payments are processed safely and cost-effectively. This is a highly cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Design, and Partnerships.

**What you'll do**

We are looking for a curious, collaborative Senior Product Manager to improve how customers pay with Affirm.

* We are looking for a curious, collaborative Senior Product Manager to improve how customers pay with Affirm
* Focus on the customer, uncovering where paying breaks down through research and data, and sharing those insights across the team
* Create new payment experiences that make repaying easier, working with Design and Analytics from discovery to launch
* Design and run experiments that improve conversion, payment success, and cost
* Shape how payments are processed safely and cost-effectively, weighing performance and risk
* Be a trusted partner to Product, Engineering, Finance, Design, and Partnerships, exploring new opportunities together, evaluating their impact, and defining sequencing
* Drive an ambitious roadmap that delivers customer and business outcomes by identifying the highest-impact bets and presenting strategy to senior leaders

  

**What we look for**

* 5+ years of product management experience
* Analytical rigor: you are comfortable in the data and use experiment results and customer research to make product decisions
* Curiosity about customers: you have strong instincts for where an experience breaks down and the drive to fix it
* Experience holding informed conversations with engineers about how systems work and the tradeoffs they carry
* A track record of taking products from discovery through launch and iteration, including turning ambiguous or conflicting inputs into a clear plan
* Clear communication and influence: you explain tradeoffs well and build trust and alignment across Product, Engineering, Finance, Design, and Partnerships, including senior leaders, without needing formal authority
* Bonus points for experience in payments, fintech, or e-commerce

  

Base Pay Grade - N  
Equity Grade - 9

HealthStream is the leader in healthcare workforce solutions. We help organizations work better by helping their people work smarter.

HealthStream provides the leading learning, clinical development, credentialing, and scheduling applications delivered on healthcare’s #1 platform. We streamline everyday tasks while improving performance, engagement, and safety – fostering a workplace where people flourish, and care thrives.

Why Join Us

At HealthStream, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the future of healthcare by collaborating with a team of talented professionals dedicated to innovation and excellence. We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a supportive work environment where creativity and collaboration thrive.

Our shared vision is to enhance the quality of healthcare by empowering the people who deliver care – a commitment we have upheld for over 30 years through providing innovative solutions and driving constant growth. Join us in revolutionizing the healthcare industry and shaping the future of patient care. As a HealthStreamer, you will be at the forefront of healthcare technology innovation, making a recurring impact on the industry.

We’re proud of our values-forward culture that offers our people:

* Mission-oriented work
* Diverse and inclusive culture
* Competitive Compensation & Bonuses

* Inspiring workspaces to collaborate and connect with other HealthStreamers

At HealthStream, our thriving culture encourages collaboration and values contributions, allowing our team members to continuously solve big problems and grow. Position Overview

The Senior Product Owner is accountable for requirements, backlog, and delivery readiness across a portfolio of two concurrent programs: a conflict of interest disclosure platform being rebuilt from the ground up, and a continuing education management platform consolidating three separately developed products. The Senior Product Owner holds independent decision authority on backlog priority and release scope within the strategy set by product management, operates multiple development teams and Azure DevOps boards at the same time, converts AI-generated working prototypes into implementable requirements, and sets the product ownership standards used across both programs.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Revenue
jobs.desc:
**Tabs is the AI Operating System for Revenue, built for modern finance and accounting teams.** It combines deep revenue and accounting expertise with the agents and applications needed to run revenue work end to end. Tabs understands customer and contract context, applies accounting logic, and executes critical workflows with built in controls, auditability, and human oversight. With Tabs, finance teams can move from manually managing revenue workflows to directing outcomes while the system executes the work.

### **About the Role**

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Revenue at Tabs: the system that turns performance obligations and usage data into recognized revenue a finance team can close the month on and an auditor can sign off on.

Audit-defensible revenue recognition is core to what Tabs does. You'll own the recognition engine across methods, the ASC 606 treatment that drives it (SSP allocation, variable consideration, contract modifications), and the audit trail and controls that make the numbers defensible. You'll report to the Director of Product and work every day with engineering, Solutions, and the finance teams who use Tabs.

**Why this role exists:** most revenue software is built by people who have never had to defend a number at close. We want someone who has, and who has also built software with engineers.

### **How We Work**

* **We work hard.** Two-week sprints, weekly ship goals, short feedback cycles. Built around intra-month product releases.
* **We work smart.** Get in front of the customer, use both data and customer feedback to drive decisions, while keeping the bigger picture in mind.
* **We work together.** In-office culture with people you want to work with. Lots of whiteboard space. Expense coffee, lunch, and dinner when in the office.

### **What You’ll Work On**

**Own the revenue recognition engine**

* Define how performance obligations convert into revenue schedules across methods — straightlined, point-in-time, usage-based, and milestone
* Ensure contract changes (amendments, renewals, terminations) flow through correctly to revenue schedules, including re-allocation and restatements
* Own recognized, deferred, and unbilled balances, and the movement between them each period

**Drive ASC 606 compliance**

* Own transaction price allocation across bundled performance obligations (SSP), variable consideration, and contract modification accounting
* Stay current on evolving accounting guidance and audit standards, along with the needs of active and prospective merchants, and translate them into product direction

**Build toward audit-defensible, SOX-grade revenue**

* Define the audit trail standard — what was recognized, when, why, against which obligation — so an external auditor can verify any number directly
* Build toward segregated permissions and approval workflows (RBAC) for revenue and journal entry changes

**Bring AI into the revenue workflow**

* Partner on AI-powered tooling that goes beyond answering questions — flagging anomalies before close, explaining what changed and why, and recommending the right recognition treatment as obligations and contracts evolve

**About You**

* Background as a **Controller**, **Assistant Controller**, **Revenue Accountant**, or **Technical Accounting Manager** — someone who has done the hands-on technical accounting work of applying ASC 606 to real transactions
* 5+ years of relevant experience and a track record of building — you've worked hands-on with engineers to scope, prioritize, and ship a software feature or system
* Deep, practical ASC 606 fluency — comfortable reasoning through transaction price allocation, variable consideration, and contract modification accounting directly, not just at a conceptual level
* Comfortable translating complex accounting frameworks into product requirements and data models engineers can build against
* Highly analytical and data-driven; comfortable making decisions based on metrics and qual

We are in a unique position to enhance and expand the Rocket Lawyer platform to a scale never seen before in the company's history, to capture audiences worldwide. We are expanding our team to take on this challenge!

Have a passion for helping people through technology - especially AI? Join Rocket Lawyer as we disrupt the legal industry and advance our mission to make the law affordable and simple. You'll work at the forefront of agentic AI product development, building and launching cutting-edge products for attorneys. Sound exciting? We'd love for you to join us!

Your role will be to own the end-to-end delivery of our Legal Platform, the product that enables attorneys in Rocket Lawyer's network to deliver legal services through our on-demand marketplace.

Today, much of the legal work between attorneys and customers happens off platform - phone calls, emails, and file sharing. Your job will be to bring that experience on-platform through streamlined web conferencing, privileged workspaces, and secure collaboration tools for documents and messaging.

Creating a delightful experience for both attorneys and customers is essential. Attorneys already love Rocket Lawyer because it enables them to practice their craft on their own terms - without business development, invoicing, nor collections. Now we're equipping them with cutting edge legal technology and AI powered tools that enable them to do their job more efficiently than ever.

**How you will make a difference day to day**

* Drive Product strategy and execution for our Legal Platform.
* Develop a deep understand of the needs of our network attorneys through quantitative and qualitative research.
* Passionately represent the voice of the customer (attorneys) while building products aligned with our product vision.

* Define and analyze metrics to measure business impacts
* Prioritize features using data-driven analysis, business insights, and sound judgment.

* Develop a deep understanding of the marketplace and competitive environment.

jobs.desc:
**Senior Product Manager, Grantseeker**

Fluxx is looking for a strategic, systems-thinking **Senior Product Manager** to own and evolve our Grantseeker platform. This role is a great fit for someone coming from FinTech. If you've built products that move money securely and compliantly, you'll find a natural home here, helping funds reach the organizations doing mission-driven work.

We are looking for people who are curious, tenacious, candid, and have a bias toward action. We welcome diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply if you think you can bring value to our team, even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description.

**This is a full-time, exempt position open to candidates located along the East Coast, with a preference for candidates based in the New York City area. Candidates outside of New York City must be willing to travel to our Manhattan office for in-person meetings and collaboration as needed.**

**About Fluxx:**  
At Fluxx, our mission is to be the leading collaborative grant management platform in our global communities. We build technology that drives positive impact by helping foundations, government agencies, and nonprofits streamline their grants management process – on both the grantmaking and grantseeking side – helping to accelerate impact across the communities we serve.

Today, Fluxx supports a global community of 500+ customers who collectively manage and distribute more than $39B in grants annually.

**About Fluxx Grantseeker:**

Grantseeker was originally launched by Fluxx in 2017 to help nonprofits manage the grantseeking process—a market traditionally underserved by grants management software. After serving more than 3,000 nonprofits, the platform was strategically divested in 2023, rebuilt as Grantseeker Pro for larger nonprofit and public sector organizations, and re-acquired by Fluxx in November 2025.

Today, Grantseeker helps nonprofits, higher education institutions, and government organizations manage grant portfolios, deadlines, budgets, reporting, documents, and compliance in one platform. Combined with Fluxx Grantmaker, it delivers a complete end-to-end solution for organizations that both award and receive grants.

**The opportunity**

This role owns Grantseeker's product direction at a genuine inflection point - having been re-acquired by Fluxx. Grantseeker has real traction, a durable data asset, and a newly dedicated product and engineering team — and it also has a two-platform architecture to reconcile, a free-to-paid conversion motion to sharpen, and an unrealized strategic advantage in being the only grantseeker platform owned by a major grantmaker platform.

You will be the person who decides what Grantseeker becomes over the next several years. This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's.

#### **What you'll do:**

**Own the roadmap.** Set and defend a 12–18 month product strategy grounded in customer evidence, funnel data, competitive reality, and commercial goals and keep the org aligned to it.

**Resolve the platform question.** Grantseeker Classic and Pro run in parallel. Own consolidation end to end —feature parity, migration tooling, customer communication, sunset timeline — balancing speed against long-tenured customers' trust.

**Sharpen the product-led motion.** Own activation, conversion, retention, and expansion as product metrics. Find where free accounts stall, build what converts them, and decide what sits above/below the paywall.

**Win competitive migrations.** Own import tooling, data mapping, onboarding, and the first-week experience that determines whether a migrated account survives.

**Connect funders and seekers**. Turn Fluxx's two-sided position into a shipped product — data flow, reduced duplicate entry, shared visibility — partnering with the Grantmaker team on shared data models.

**Build on the data asset**. Turn Grantseeker's public filing data into better matching and applied AI that saves grant writers real hours, with hones
