jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Operator Tools
jobs.desc:
MarginEdge is seeking a **Senior Product Manager** to join our new Operator Tools team — the group responsible for helping restaurants understand and control their costs, and ultimately manage their restaurants better.

The team organizes around problems that define a restaurant's costs and operating workflows. We worry about things like what restaurants spend to bring goods in the door and the ordering workflow behind it; what it costs for the restaurant to make a dish and the recipe and prep workflows that produce it. We take the data a restaurant already has and turn it into insights and automations that drive savings, while giving operators hours back in their week. We believe that a number sitting in a report has limited value; helping operators turn those numbers into action is our job.

MarginEdge’s Operator Tools are part of a broader SaaS solution built for restaurant operators by restaurant operators.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will own a problem area end-to-end. That means you are accountable for an outcome, not a feature list: you determine what is worth solving, work with the team to define the best solution, get it built and launched, and then evaluate the impact.

You will work closely with external stakeholders — restaurant owners, GMs, head chefs, managers, accountants and bartenders — and translate their pain points to the MarginEdge engineering, design, operations, sales, and marketing teams. The ideal candidate has a “buck stops here” mentality, where you take responsibility for ensuring that all the stakeholders are put in a position to succeed, and you proactively anticipate the concerns of both customers and your team.

**MarginEdge: Where hospitality meets technology**

As a team built by former (and current!) restaurant operators, our mission is to bring operators the same energy, attention to detail, and passion that they bring to their guests. Our culture is deeply rooted in service, partially because that’s where so many of our team come from (including everyone on our Business Development team), but also because we believe it is just the right way to run a business. We design our software with profound empathy for the complexity of running a restaurant, and the goal of making the magic just a little easier for operators by taking the complex (read: very annoying) back office tasks off their plate, while empowering them with real-time data.

Our founders share a deep history in both owning and operating restaurants and in building successful tech companies. We are venture-backed and serve 12,000+ restaurants across the US and Canada.

We enable restaurants to make magic while knowing we are doing the same for them.

We have the utmost respect for our clients and because of this, we are unable to hire their current employees.

**What type of responsibilities will I have?**

* Own the strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for your problem area. Partner with leadership to define success, make prioritization decisions, and communicate the strategy and trade-offs.
* Build a deep understanding of restaurant operators and their workflows through regular customer interaction, qualitative research, and product data, and represent that understanding in product decisions.
* Validate problems and solutions before making significant investments. Use lightweight tests, prototypes, and pilots to reduce uncertainty, and be willing to change direction when the evidence warrants it.
* Use data throughout the product lifecycle. Be able to investigate usage and workflow patterns yourself, partner with Data on what needs to be collected, and measure whether launches actually drove the intended outcome.
* Lead product development in close partnership with Design and Engineering, from exploration and prototyping through delivery, balancing customer value, usability, feasibility, and quality.
* Understand the competitive and market landscape well enough to know where we are differentiated, where we are exposed,

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Audience Measurement & Media Data
jobs.desc:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**

The Senior Product Manager, Audience Measurement & Media Data will lead a critical area of measurement innovation across streaming, broadcast, and cable television. This role will shape the products, platforms, and data capabilities that help media companies understand who is watching, what they are watching, and how audiences move across screens and platforms.

The role brings together audience measurement, advanced analytics, third-party signals, data science, engineering, and product strategy. You will lead the development of scalable measurement capabilities that combine viewing behavior with high-quality external signals to produce richer, more accurate, and more actionable insights.

Your work will directly support the needs of publishers, broadcasters, streaming platforms, advertisers, agencies, media buyers, and other industry stakeholders. You will help them make better decisions about content, programming, advertising, audience development, and media investment.

This is a highly visible leadership role for an independent thinker who can set direction in a complex and evolving market. You will own a meaningful part of the audience measurement ecosystem, make decisions across product and technology trade-offs, and partner with a broad set of technical, analytical, commercial, and operational teams to deliver measurable customer value.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the product strategy, vision, and roadmap for audience measurement and media data solutions across streaming, broadcast, and cable.
* Lead the full product lifecycle, from identifying customer needs and defining requirements through delivery, adoption, and improvement.
* Partner with engineering, data science, research, and analytics teams to develop scalable measurement solutions.
* Drive innovation by combining viewing data and third-party signals to improve audience insights and measurement accuracy.
* Define product priorities, performance metrics, and success measures while balancing business needs and technical requirements.
* Ensure data quality, reliability, privacy, and measurement integrity through continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with customers and internal stakeholders to identify opportunities, solve problems, and improve products.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives, manage priorities, and communicate product progress and results to leadership.
* Manage, mentor, and develop product team members, supporting performance, accountability, and career growth.

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years of relevant experience in product management, data products, analytics, technology, or related fields.
* Previous experience directly managing and developing employees.
* Experience owning data-driven products and managing the full product lifecycle.
* Ability to work with engineering, data science, and other technical teams.
* Strong communication, decision-making, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in television, streaming, advertising, or audience measurement.
* Knowledge of cross-platform measurement, third-party data, and audience enrichment.
* Familiarity with data quality, APIs, cloud platforms, and modern data architectures.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Gameplay
jobs.desc:
**About Us**

Chess.com is one of the largest gaming sites in the world and the #1 platform for playing, learning, and enjoying chess.

We are a team of 600+ fully remote people in 60+ countries working hard to serve the global chess community. We are here to support 250M+ chess players worldwide with the best possible product, content, and tools to serve the community!

We are a tech company. A gaming company. A content company. And we do it all with passion and commitment to the game. Above all we prize our mission-driven, flat, life-celebrating, no-corporate culture, and we look forward to meeting you and learning more about what you can bring to the team.

**About You**

You love to play chess and want to help others discover that same passion. You understand the full user journey of being a chess player, and different types of players need to experience to find joy in the game. You are intimately familiar with the Chess.com experience and want to help further build out the Gameplay ecosystem.

You have extensive experience as a product manager shipping delightful consumer-facing products. You have worked deeply with design and engineering teams to define what great looks like and you communicate regularly and successfully to executive stakeholders.

**What you'll do**

* **Shape the Gameplay roadmap and vision.** In close partnership with leadership, shape both the near-term roadmap and the long-term vision for Gameplay at Chess.com. From live games, to daily, to bot play, you will own the gameplay experience.
* **Bring ideas and sharpen them with the team.** Come with your own point of view on what's worth building and why. You don't wait to be told. At the same time, engage seriously with feedback from leadership and peers: internalize it, push back where you disagree, and use it to make the work better. The vision is built together; you're a strong, informed voice in it.
* **Operate in public.** As a globally remote company spanning many time zones, async slack communication is how decisions get made. Work out loud in channels: brainstorm openly, pose sharp questions, make decisive small calls with reasoning attached, and be explicit on what's urgent vs. not. Engage with depth and without ego, pull the right people in by name to build alignment. Make the most of sync meeting time by taking on the biggest questions.
* **Define success and hold the bar velocity and quality.** Frame the problem, partner deeply with engineers and designers, work through what "good enough to ship”. Get product scope first-time right.
* **Use AI to prototype, de-risk, and accelerate.** Build mocks, test flows, and pressure-test ideas yourself. Bring working artifacts into discussions, not just decks. Run AB tests with velocity and build with foresight on configurability.

**Required Skills**

* **7+ years in product management, 4+ shipping consumer-facing products at scale.** You've shipped consumer-facing products to large user bases. You know how to balance a quantitative understanding of funnels, metrics, and experimentation with a qualitative feel for what makes a delightful user experience.
* **Excellent product taste, especially in the chess context.** You know what feels good and what doesn't. You know what users with different levels of chess skill and experience are looking to get out of gameplay.
* **AI-native.** You already use AI daily to prototype, explore ideas, and accelerate execution. You build working prototypes as the basis for discussion.
* **High-velocity communicator.** You communicate clearly and concisely at speed and across many projects. You act as the focal point across design, engineering, stakeholders, product peers, and executives, digging into engineering specifics in one thread then zooming out to exec-level outcomes in the next.

jobs.desc:
Overview:

**Working at Atlassian**

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Responsibilities:

**About the team**
------------------

Confluence is where organizations write down what they know: decisions, architecture, process, and policy. But a company's work does not happen in one tool. It happens in file drives, chat, code hosts, CRMs, and data platforms.

The Aggregation team makes Confluence fill and organize itself from those tools. Content arrives with its source system's permissions intact, gets organized so a team can navigate it, and stays current as the underlying work changes. That content is what Confluence's AI answers are built on, which makes its coverage and quality the difference between an answer a team acts on and one they go verify by hand.

**About the role**
------------------

You will own how Confluence turns connected content into knowledge that maintains itself: what a space pulls in, how it gets organized, how it stays current, and when it flags that something important is missing. Vision through launch and iteration, on problems that arrive undefined.

Quality is the job here, not a stage of it. Content that is stale, mis-grouped, or wrong does more damage than content that was never connected at all, because a team will have already acted on it.

You are building for three audiences, and the role requires you to name which one you are serving in every decision: the admin who approves connecting a system of record and will disconnect it the moment trust breaks, the space owner accountable for a body of knowledge staying current, and the end user who wants the answer without knowing which tool it came from.

### **What you'll do**

* Own the strategy and roadmap for what connected content becomes inside Confluence: what gets pulled in, how it is grouped, titled, and summarized, and what happens to content that has gone stale or contradicts a published page.
* Define how messy inputs become usable structure. Documents, spreadsheets, meeting transcripts, chat threads, and CRM records do not arrive as pages, and deciding what shape they take in Confluence is the core of the work.
* Own freshness and decay. Decide what updates on its own when a source changes, what needs a human to confirm, and how a user can tell which one they are looking at.
* Set and defend the quality bar for retrieval: permission fidelity to the source, accuracy, and latency. Decide what does not ship, and hold that line when a date is at risk.
* Own the quality evals for the parts of the experience powered by a large language model. Define what a correct output looks like, build the test sets, catch regressions as models and content change, and decide when output is good enough that a user stops double-checking it.
* Decide where AI belongs in the experience and how it behaves when it is wrong. A suggestion that costs nothing to ignore and a suggestion that hijacks what someone was doing are the difference between a feature teams keep and one they switch off.
* Drive execution across Engineering, Design, Data Science, Research, Marketing, Partnerships, and Security and Trust. Bring clear recommendations to executive forums.
* Set the product bar. Mentor PMs and raise the quality of specs and decisions across the team.

### **What we're looking for**

* 8+ years in product management, including at least one product where content, retrieval, or a model-powered experience was the core value rather than a feature added later.
* You have taken a 0 to 1 product from strategy through launch and past the first disappointing metric.
* You have shipped features powered by large language models and owned their evals. You can walk through how you defined a correct answer, built and maintained the test set, cau

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Ready to be a Titan?

At ServiceTitan, we're building the operating system for the trades. As we continue to scale, we're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Data & AI Platform team and own the algorithmic systems that sit underneath dozens of downstream product features and quietly decide what gets prioritized, surfaced, and trusted across ServiceTitan.


This is a senior individual contributor role for a product leader who thinks in statistics, not just user stories. The specific problems you'll own will shift based on what domain teams and our customers need most — today that might mean ranking methodology, deduplication logic, or causal inference; tomorrow it could be a different statistically-driven problem entirely. What stays constant is the kind of thinking: translating ambiguous, statistically messy problems into clear product requirements that engineering and ML can build against with confidence. This is a heavily stats-driven PM role: you'll be evaluating model tradeoffs, defining what "correct" means for a given system, and defending methodology choices to a technical audience as much as you'll be writing a roadmap.


What you'll do:

  • Define and own the roadmap for whichever algorithmic systems — ranking, deduplication, causal inference, or similar — are highest-priority based on domain team and customer need.
  • Translate real customer pain (bad matches, untrustworthy rankings, wrong conclusions drawn from correlated data) into statistically rigorous product requirements.
  • Co-author PRDs for statistically ambiguous problems where the "right answer" isn't obvious — you're defining the evaluation criteria as much as the solution.
  • Partner with ML and engineering to evaluate model tradeoffs (precision/recall, false positive cost, explainability vs. accuracy) and make the product call when there's no clean answer.
  • Set measurable, multi-quarter goals for algorithmic system health and lead cross-functional teams toward them with rigor.
  • Lead discovery with domain product teams and customers to understand where algorithmic errors actually cost time, money, or trust.
  • Proactively identify and resolve disagreements over methodology, ownership, and model quality before they stall multiple teams building on your systems.

What you'll bring:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, strong track record in enterprise B2B SaaS; experience with at least one of ranking/recommendation systems, entity resolution, or causal inference — this role will likely touch more than one over time.
  • Genuine statistical fluency — comfortable with precision/recall tradeoffs, confounding vs. causation, and model evaluation, regardless of which specific problem you're applied to.
  • Demonstrated ability to define evaluation criteria and "what correct looks like" for a new statistical problem from scratch, rather than working from an existing rubric.
  • Comfort context-switching between different algorithmic domains as customer and business priorities shift.
  • Experience translating customer-reported problems (bad matches, low trust in recommendations, wrong conclusions) into statistically defined product work.
  • Strong communication skills — explaining model tradeoffs to domain PMs, ML engineers, and customers who each need a different level of technical detail.
  • Self-starter who takes initiative and holds themselves accountable to outcomes — "mostly works" isn't good enough when customers are trusting your systems with real decisions.
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, or equivalent work experience.

Why This Role Matters:
Ranking, deduplication, causal inference — and whatever comes next — quietly decide what

About Us:

At ENFRA, we blend a rich history with a forward-looking vision. With over 100 years of experience, we are a pillar of stability in the energy infrastructure industry and a leader in innovative energy solutions. Our commitment to leveraging emerging technologies ensures that we remain at the forefront of the Energy-as-a-Service sector.

We believe in growth—not just for our business, but for our people. Our team members have the opportunity to advance their careers in a supportive environment that values continuous learning and development. We embrace innovation and encourage creative problem solving to tackle the energy infrastructure and energy challenges of tomorrow.

Inclusion is at the heart of our culture. We strive to create a workplace where every voice is heard and valued, fostering a collaborative environment where diverse perspectives drive our success.

Join us to be part of a legacy of excellence and a future of groundbreaking advancements. At ENFRA, stability, innovation, and growth are more than just values—they are the pillars of our continued success.

  
Overview:

**Position Purpose:**

The Senior Product Manager is the accountable owner of a technology platform within ENFRA’s portfolio of software products, including AI-powered tools and operational workflow systems. Where the Product Manager executes against a defined roadmap, the Senior Product Manager sets it: identifying which operational workflows are worth transforming, framing the problem, building the case, and driving it through delivery and adoption with minimal direction.

Our users are engineers, analysts, modelers, and field staff working in highly technical domains, and our products are built by software engineers. The Senior Product Manager is comfortable working across both, drawing requirements out of subject matter experts and shaping them into specifications the technology team can build against.

This role partners closely with the product leader for its business area on portfolio strategy, mentors Product Managers and Business Analysts, and is the recognized face of its platform to the teams that use it.

Responsibilities:

**Duties & Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the single accountable owner for an assigned platform: set the roadmap, hold decision authority over the backlog, accept or reject delivered work, and answer for the product’s outcomes.
* Drive both strategic and tactical work independently, from multi-quarter direction down to writing the story.
* Maintain a discovery runway ahead of the engineering team, so that upcoming work is researched, specified, and ready before it is needed.
* Develop the UI and UX of roadmap items directly, using AI-assisted design tools to move from concept to interactive prototype quickly, and use those prototypes to validate direction with users before engineering work begins.
* Hold the separation between forward-looking product decisions and immediate delivery concerns, resisting the pull to be consumed by in-sprint engineering issues at the expense of what comes next.
* Act as the visible owner of the platform to its users: lead demos, release communications, and recurring user meetings.
* Lead requirements development end to end (elicitation, analysis, specification, and validation) and raise the standard of requirements quality across the product team.
* Personally conduct user research and usability testing with technical staff and synthesize findings into decisions.
* Identify and pitch opportunities to modernize data-heavy operational workflows through AI and application development, including sizing the opportunity and defining success measures.
* Define and instrument product telemetry, and use adoption and usage data to evaluate whether shipped features changed the workflow they were meant to change.
* Drive launch, enablement, and adoption, including the internal change management required to move teams off legacy processes.
* Mentor Product Managers and Business Analysts

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Vendor Relations
jobs.desc:
KPI Solutions is a national supply chain consulting and warehouse automation systems integrator, helping some of the biggest names in e-commerce, retail, and distribution move product faster and smarter. Formed in 2021 through the combination of Kuecker Logistics Group, PULSE Integration, and QC Software, KPI brings together decades of material handling and systems integration experience — rooted in material handling integration dating back to 1971. From initial design through go-live and ongoing support, KPI delivers engineered solutions that blend automated technologies (MHE, robotics, conveyor, ASRS, AMR/AGV) with intelligent warehouse execution software to optimize productivity, increase fulfillment speed, and build operational resilience for clients.

**Position Summary**

The Senior Product Manager – Vendor Relations owns the product strategy and roadmap for a portfolio of material handling and warehouse automation solutions, with primary emphasis on managing and growing the OEM, technology, and equipment vendor relationships that underpin those offerings. Because these solutions only deliver value once vendor hardware and software are working reliably inside the company's and customers' systems, this role also owns the software integration requirements that make multi-vendor solutions function as one system — defining API contracts, data exchange standards, and technical acceptance criteria alongside the commercial relationship. This role serves as the strategic and technical bridge between engineering, IT, sales, operations, and external partners — including robotics and automation OEMs, WMS/WES/WCS providers, and equipment/parts suppliers — ensuring product commitments align with vendor capabilities, integration feasibility, contract terms, and long-term partnership health. The ideal candidate combines strong product management fundamentals with deep comfort negotiating, managing, and growing multi-vendor ecosystems, and enough technical fluency in software integration (APIs, data interfaces, middleware) to evaluate vendor claims and de-risk integration in a complex, integration-heavy industry.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Vendor Relations & Partnership Management (Primary Focus)**

* Serve as the primary product-side point of contact for OEM and technology vendors (e.g., robotics, AS/RS, conveyance, WMS/WES/WCS, controls) throughout the partnership lifecycle.
* Lead vendor evaluation, onboarding, and tiering processes; negotiate commercial terms, SLAs, and roadmap commitments alongside Procurement and Legal.
* Own the vendor scorecard process — tracking reliability, cost, lead time, quality, and roadmap alignment — and drive corrective action plans with underperforming partners.
* Build and maintain executive-level relationships with key suppliers and technology partners to secure preferential pricing, priority allocation, and early access to new capabilities.
* Coordinate joint go-to-market activities, co-development initiatives, and technology roadmap alignment sessions with strategic vendors.
* Manage vendor contract renewals, escalations, and dispute resolution in partnership with Legal and Finance, protecting margin and delivery commitments.
* Represent the company at vendor summits, industry trade shows (MODEX, ProMat, MHI events), and partner advisory boards.

**Software & Systems Integration (Vendor Interoperability**)

* Own the technical requirements and acceptance criteria for integrating vendor-supplied software and hardware (robotics controllers, WMS/WES/WCS, PLC/controls) with internal platforms and customer environments, partnering closely with Engineering and IT.
* Define and document API contracts, data exchange formats (e.g., REST/SOAP, EDI, MQTT), and middleware requirements needed for vendor systems to interoperate reliably with company and customer software stacks.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**Job Purpose/Summary**

The Product Manager (PM) owns the business and customer-facing product vision for Knowmadics' 360 Space platform, an API-first, cloud-native data platform for telemetry data ingest, entity and track management, data retrieval and delivery, and domain awareness capabilities through a user-centered front-end. Space and satellite data is the first domain the platform supports; the Product Manager is responsible for identifying the standardized, domain-agnostic core of the platform and extending it to additional domains. This role is the primary link between the market (Sales, Business Development, prospective and current customers) and the product roadmap: understanding who will buy and use 360 Space capabilities, validating product-market fit, and translating that understanding into clear, prioritized product direction.

This role owns overall product priorities and is accountable for the unified product vision and roadmap for our telemetry data platform technologies and product portfolio, beginning with the Space domain, and delivers on that by working hand-in-hand with the Engineering/Tech Lead, Human-Machine Interface (HMI) Lead, and Project Manager as trusted peers, each bringing deep expertise in their own domain. The Product Manager is expected to actively synthesize business, technical, and user-experience perspectives into a single, well-communicated direction, and to keep the broader team aligned and motivated around it. The Product Manager will work closely with the Project Manager, who governs schedule and budget constraints and decisions, to keep product development on track and within budget. This role carries the flexibility to absorb related product scope over time, including additional data domains and AI/ML-enabled features, as Knowmadics' product portfolio matures.

What this Role Owns: Product Vision Roadmap, Product-Market Fit Analysis, Product Scope and Priorities (e.g., Functional Requirements, User Stories), Domain Expansion Strategy (identifying the standardized core platform vs. domain-specific needs, External Customer and User Engagement Strategy, Internal Cross-Team Stakeholder (e.g., Sales, Marketing, Business Development, C-Suite) Communications.

What the Technical Lead Owns: Engineering Implementation Strategy and Prioritization, Technical Architecture Decisions, Development Sequencing, Resource (Staff, Data, Equipment) Requirements and Priorities.

What the Project Manager Owns: Funded R&D milestone and deliverable tracking and prioritization, subcontractor management, external (e.g., US Government) R&D sponsor / stakeholder management, product development schedule tracking and adjustments (e.g., push release to accommodate new feature or hold release to hit deadline), product budget tracking and adjustments.

Product Vision, Market Fit & Go-to-Market

* Partner directly and regularly with Sales and Business Development to understand customer needs, active pursuits, competitive positioning, and the broader space domain awareness market and other domains with similar telemetry data challenges.
* Own and continuously refine the product vision and business case for 360 Space, translating customer conversations, market signals, and sales pursuits into clear product direction.

jobs.desc:
Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring a Senior Product Manager, Virtual Care to join our Product team.

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family.

  

**About the role:**

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll lead product development for Oscar Virtual Care (OVC), improving how members access care and how clinicians deliver it. Your work will span the experience before, during, and after a visit, from intake and scheduling to clinical documentation, treatment, and follow-up.

Oscar brings together a health plan and its own care delivery organization, creating an opportunity to connect product decisions directly to the cost and quality of care. You'll work with clinical and business partners to identify where technology can help members get the care they need. This includes improving access to virtual care and health assessments, supporting effective clinical workflows, and reducing administrative work for care teams.

You'll turn ambiguous problems into a clear product direction, align partners around priorities, and work with engineering, design, and data science to deliver and measure results.

You will report into a Director, Product Management.

**Work Location:** This position is based in our Los Angeles (Marina del Rey) office, requiring a hybrid work schedule with 3 days of in-office work per week. Thursdays are a required in-office day for team meetings and events, while your other two office days are flexible to suit your schedule. #LI-Hybrid

**Pay Transparency:** The base pay for this role is: $163,944.00 - $215,176.50 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program, company equity grants and annual performance bonuses.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for Virtual Care. Prioritize investments based on their expected impact on affordability, clinical outcomes, member experience, and operating efficiency.
* Lead discovery with members, clinicians, and operations teams. Combine user research with data analysis to identify problems, challenge assumptions, and build a business case for product investments.
* Improve the member journey from finding and accessing care through the visit and follow-up. Reduce friction in intake and scheduling, improve visit completion, and help care teams share context and coordinate next steps.
* Build tools that help clinicians deliver high-quality care efficiently, including reviewing medical history, documenting encounters, addressing care gaps, and ordering appropriate tests and treatments. Evaluate opportunities for AI and automation to reduce administrative work while maintaining clinical quality.
* Define success metrics and measure the clinical, financial, and operational impact of product changes. Use findings to refine priorities and improve the experience after launch.
* Lead alignment across clinical, operations, engineering, design, and data science partners. Bring clear recommendations, work through competing needs and tradeoffs, and establish decisions that move the work forward.
* Own complex initiatives from problem definition through delivery. Write clear requirements, manage dependencies and risks, and resolve issues across teams with the autonomy expected of a Senior Product Manager.
* Invest in strengthening the talent on Oscar's product team, by developing more junior team members through mentorship.
* Compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
* Other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Measurement & Reporting
jobs.desc:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.  
  
Vibe.co is an **Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform** that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.  
  
Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Agentic AI
jobs.desc:
Principal Product Manager, Agentic AI

REMOTE, United States

JOB OVERVIEW

Legion is building AI agents that carry out workforce management work, not agents that describe it.

Much of what is presented as AI in workforce management today is a conversational layer over an existing scheduling screen. The more substantial problem — software that reasons over demand, labor regulation, and employee preferences, then acts, with a person in the loop wherever the stakes require one — remains unsolved across the category. Legion intends to solve it, and this role leads the product work to get there.

You will take an agent surface from operational research through specification, prototype, evaluation, and enterprise deployment, working hands-on throughout. You will work closely with Legion's AI Lab engineers and with our CEO, who is engaged in this work daily.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

Agent definition. Determine what an agent is responsible for, which tools it may call, what it must escalate, what it must never do, and what a manager sees when it acts. These decisions affect employee pay and legal compliance. Much of this work is pre-launch, so you will shape the direction rather than inherit it. 

Problem selection. The hardest judgment in agentic product work is identifying which workflows suit an agent and which do not. You will spend substantial time inside customer operations — district managers, store managers, labor operations, frontline employees — and return with a ranked, defensible view of where an agent creates measurable value and where it does not.

The human-in-the-loop contract. Scheduling decisions affect income, childcare arrangements, and legal protections. For each agent action you will define where autonomy is appropriate, the escalation thresholds, how a manager overrides the system, what is logged, and how a compliance team audits the outcome. Legion treats this as a first-class design problem.

Build quality. You are accountable for what ships, not for what was specified. That means staying engaged through implementation: reviewing the build against the specification as it comes together, using the product yourself before anyone else is asked to, joining bug triage and design review, catching drift from intent while it is still cheap to correct, and holding a release when the quality is not there. Our customers experience the build, not the document. A well-written specification that produced a product managers do not trust is failed product work, and we assess it that way.

Evaluation. Build and maintain the evaluation sets that determine whether an agent is ready to ship and whether it is degrading in production — writing the cases, reviewing failure traces, setting the pass criteria. You will be the person who holds a release when the demonstration is persuasive and the evaluation is not.

Specifications. Legion uses Functional Requirements Documents as its ground-truth specification layer; release notes, enablement material, and sales content are generated from maintained specifications rather than reconstructed from code or institutional memory. Write FRDs that meet that standard and keep them accurate after release. A specification is where the work begins, not where your responsibility ends.

Commercialization. Partner with go-to-market on packaging, metering, pricing inputs, and field readiness. Agentic products raise difficult commercial questions — what unit to meter, what a customer is paying for when software performs work a person previously did — and you will be expected to hold a considered position on them.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**About Technosylva**

Technosylva is a global leader in wildfire and extreme weather risk mitigation software. The Company’s market-leading solutions, enhanced by AI and machine learning capabilities, provide real-time and predictive insights to support electric utility, insurance and government agency customers.

Technosylva has provided critical solutions for the past 26 years. In 2022 the organization entered a period of significant growth and transformation with investment from TA Associates, a leading growth PE firm, scaling to about 175 employees and offering its product in over 10 countries. In 2024 General Atlantic, a leading global growth investor, announced a strategic growth investment in Technosylva to support the company in its mission.

**Role Overview**

Technosylva’s products help our customers protect people and assets by making high quality and timely decisions. They use our software to apply world class fire, weather, and climate modeling and simulations to pressing operational and planning decisions.

As a Senior Product Manager at Technosylva you will be responsible for driving the product vision, strategy, and execution for key functionality within our core SaaS Operations product line. You will lead the discovery and delivery of these functions within the product that solve real customer problems while helping scale the business. This role requires deep customer empathy, strong analytical skills, and collaboration across product, engineering, design, and business teams.

The people at Technosylva are passionate, expert, and welcoming. You’ll find this to be an environment where you can grow, while working to address some of the most urgent and challenging problems we face.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead product discovery through customer interviews, data analysis, and market research to identify valuable, usable, and feasible solutions for our utility and agency customers
* Create and maintain product artifacts while driving the process from conception through go-to-market, including beta testing and rollout strategies
* Partner with engineering teams to define technical solutions and success metrics that align with business objectives
* Develop and maintain the product roadmap and vision based on customer needs, market opportunities, and business strategy
* Build strong relationships with utility and other customers to deeply understand their workflows and pain points
* Collaborate across sales and customer success teams to gather feedback and market requirements
* Continuously refine product features based on customer feedback and emerging market needs
* Assist with product pricing and packaging strategies

  

**Required Skills**

* 4+ years of product management experience, including experience leading B2B/enterprise SaaS products
* Track record of driving product discovery and validation, including leading research programs and developing systematic approaches to customer feedback
* Expertise in SaaS metrics, unit economics, and business strategy
* Experience managing large-scale enterprise deployments with utility companies or similar regulated industries
* Advanced analytical skills with the ability to develop frameworks for complex decision-making
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and align cross-functional teams

  

**Preferred Skills**

* Product development experience in ClimateTech, wildfire and/or utility software
* Deep understanding of utility operations and regulatory frameworks
* Experience with ML and advanced analytics
* Experience using AI tools to manage product roadmaps, requirement writing and wireframing or UI/UX design

jobs.desc:
**Senior Product Manager**  
  
**Purpose**  
The Senior Product Manager is responsible for the strategy, roadmap, and feature definition of all CKE Solid Keys products. They will be responsible for bringing new product lines to B2B and retail channels in an engaging, functional way, while opening up fresh distribution channels by collaborating with departments across the company.
  
  
**Summary**  
The Senior Product Manager bridges market opportunity with product definition that meets customer needs, driving new product introduction from early ideation through engineering development to successful commercial launch.  
  
Reporting to the VP Technology, this role owns the product strategy, roadmaps, and feature definition for all CKE Solutions. The role partners closely with R&D, Manufacturing, Marketing/Sales, and Executive Leadership to define product roadmaps, validate technical specifications, and deliver innovative, high-margin solutions.  
  
**Duties Critical to Success**

* **Product Definition**
  + Starting with customer requirements, define product functional specifications for the R&D, marketing and sales teams.
  + Collaborate with Sales and Marketing to define market size, pricing strategies through competitive analysis and volume forecasting.
* **Program Scoping**
  + Partner closely with R&D and Sales teams to define product technical specifications, technical and commercialization risk mitigation strategies, proof-of-concept MVP demonstrations with success criteria.
  + Collaborate with the R&D team to define product cost, program timeline and resources needed for program execution.
  + Own the customer-value proposition, feature trade-offs, business case ROI evaluation and present to the executive leadership team for approval.
* **Program Execution**

* **Product Roadmaps**
  + Based on market and sales trends, own the 5-year product roadmap with updated scoping metrics, revenue projections, and product cost estimates.
  + Present business cases and product strategy proposals to the Executive Leadership Team for approval.
* **Product Lifecycle Ownership**
  + Own the accuracy of product owner's manuals, packaging, and product information on the CKE website.
  + Manage product Vehicle in Operation (VIO) coverage data for internal and external stakeholders.
  + Resolve escalated high-visibility customer issues.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Critical to Success**

* Solid technical background with experience in hardware and software development for consumer products. Familiarity with regulatory requirements, product literature, marketing material, and packaging. Demonstrated experience in project management.
* Proven ability to define product specifications based on customer pain points, develop product and marketing strategies, and effectively communicate recommendations to executive management.

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead
jobs.desc:
About Foxit

Foxit is a global leader in PDF and digital document software—powering over 700 million users and hundreds of thousands of businesses worldwide. As we expand our SaaS platform and evolve our customer-centric product strategy, we’re building a new generation of product leadership.

This is a founding Technical Product Manager role, created to bridge the gap between Product, Go-to-Market, and Engineering teams across continents. You’ll shape how Foxit listens, translates, and delivers for customers at global scale.

The Opportunity

You’ll serve as the technical heartbeat of our global product organization—connecting real customer feedback from our Alpharetta GTM teams and enterprise clients directly to our engineering centers in China and Asia-Pacific.

Fluent in both English and Mandarin, you’ll ensure nothing is lost in translation—from nuanced customer pain points to detailed developer requirements. You’ll turn ambiguity into clarity, accelerate decision-making, and drive high-impact product outcomes.

Initially, you’ll own the Foxit Editor platform roadmap. Over time, your remit will expand to other Foxit SaaS products as business priorities evolve.

What You’ll Do

* Be the founding technical bridge across global teams—aligning Product, Engineering, and GTM functions around a shared roadmap.

* Translate enterprise customer needs (captured by Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success) into clear, technically feasible requirements for our China-based engineering teams.

* Communicate in Mandarin with developers to ensure accuracy, context, and priority alignment—closing feedback loops faster and reducing misinterpretation.

* Partner with Engineering & Architecture to validate technical feasibility, manage trade-offs, and influence design decisions.

* Work side-by-side with GTM teams in Alpharetta to surface key customer insights and turn them into product improvements.

* Define success metrics, lead release planning, and champion post-launch measurement to ensure real customer impact.

* Build scalable frameworks for cross-regional communication, ensuring the next generation of Foxit products are truly global in design and delivery.

What You’ll Bring

* 7+ years in SaaS Product Management, Technical PM, or Platform PM roles.

* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field.

* Fluency in both English and Mandarin (verbal & written) — must be able to communicate technical detail to developers in Mandarin.

* Strong technical acumen: APIs, SDKs, cloud architecture, data flow, agile methods.

* Proven ability to translate between customer needs and engineering realities.

* Experience working with globally distributed teams and bridging cultural and time-zone divides.

* Willingness to travel regularly to Alpharetta (~1 week/month).

Nice to Have:

* Experience with document workflow, PDF editing, or SaaS developer tools.

* Background in software engineering or technical architecture.

* Experience supporting GTM and product alignment across US + APAC.

Why This Role Matters

This is not just a job—it’s an opportunity to define a new capability at Foxit.

You’ll:

* Be the founding member shaping how Foxit’s global product organization integrates GTM and engineering.

* Build bilingual, bi-continental collaboration models that scale.

* Influence strategic priorities, roadmap decisions, and customer experience across the full product lifecycle.

You’ll be joining a company where innovation meets execution—and you’ll sit right at the intersection of both.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
The Team + The Role

Pendo's Product Marketing team translates what we build into why it matters. The team works at the intersection of product, revenue, and marketing, owning the narratives, positioning, and go-to-market motions that drive pipeline and commercial outcomes. It operates as a small, senior team with high ownership, low overhead, and a strong bias toward work that moves the business forward.

Pendo is looking for a Sr. Product Marketing Manager to play a key role in our growing Enterprise business. You will partner closely across Product, Sales, and Marketing to package and position Pendo's offerings as powerful solutions for Enterprise clients. This is an individual contributor role for a builder who can create, test, adapt, and make an immediate impact in a fast-moving, AI-native environment.

This is a remote role in the United States. We have offices in San Francisco, CA, Raleigh, NC, or New York, NY.

What this looks like day-to-day

  • Enterprise positioning: Own and maintain clear, concise, and impactful solutions messaging for the Enterprise market. Translate Pendo's product capabilities into value-driven narratives that resonate with Enterprise buyers.
  • Cross-functional partnership: Collaborate strategically with Product, PMM, Sales, and Marketing teams to package and position Pendo's offerings for Enterprise clients. Serve as a key conduit between Enterprise go-to-market teams and Product by bringing field feedback into product conversations.
  • Flexible execution: Move fluidly across adjacent work as priorities shift, including solutions marketing, growth-hacker-style experiments, and demand-gen support. Adapt quickly rather than staying in a single fixed lane.
  • AI-enabled GTM: Leverage AI tools and workflows, including building agents, to accelerate research, content creation, and go-to-market execution. Use AI as a practical multiplier for how you work and what you ship.
  • Market research: Conduct in-depth research to define, understand, and articulate the distinct needs and opportunities within the Enterprise landscape for Pendo. Use that insight to shape messaging, campaign direction, and sales conversations.
  • Sales partnership: Forge strong partnerships with the Enterprise Sales team to understand their requirements, challenges, and revenue opportunities. Participate in strategic Enterprise deals by providing product and solutions expertise.
  • Testing and iteration: Rapidly test, learn, and adapt messaging and campaigns in a fast-changing environment. Use feedback from the market, Sales, and Product to improve the work quickly.
  • Enterprise content: Develop compelling content and collateral for Enterprise audiences, including presentations, white papers, and case studies. Ensure materials are clear, persuasive, and aligned to the needs of Enterprise buyers.
  • Enterprise strategy support: Elevate and accelerate Pendo's overall Enterprise marketing strategy and execution. Contribute strategically to competitive intelligence, pricing considerations, and enablement programs tailored for the Enterprise market.

jobs.desc:
**Join Our Team at HuFriedyGroup – Innovating Excellence in Dental Instrument Manufacturing**

HuFriedyGroup is a leading manufacturer of dental instruments and infection prevention products. Our 10,000-plus products, hand-crafted by highly skilled artisans, are known for their precision, performance, longevity, reliability, and quality. To help dental professionals be The Best in Practice, HuFriedyGroup provides a unique combination of world class products, value-added services, clinical education, and dental community platforms that result in superior clinician performance and enhanced safety for dental professionals and their patients. Working at HuFriedyGroup is so much more than a job, as every employee has a part in driving and supporting the organization’s inspirational vision to be a global force in advancing dental performance through Best-In-Practice dentistry that improves lives around the world.

**About the job**
-----------------

HuFriedyGroup is creating a new Senior Digital Product Manager role dedicated to our Dental Service Organization (DSO) customer segment. DSOs are among the fastest-growing and most strategically important customers in dentistry, and they buy, operate, and measure value differently than independent practices: through multi-location parent/child account hierarchies, centralized procurement, contract pricing, and system-to-system integration. This individual will own the roadmap for implementing digital solutions for DSO customers, which may include eProcurement, eCommerce, DSO portals, and DSO-specific digital service offerings. This is a foundational role: there is no DSO digital roadmap today. The right person will immerse themselves in the business, learning how HuFriedyGroup serves DSOs and how DSOs operate, while building a backlog of digital opportunities that evolves into a living DSO roadmap. The work is agile and iterative, not linear: this role will launch near-term proofs of concept and pilots to learn quickly, pivot based on what is learned, and keep driving toward longer-term outcomes at the same time. The role reports to the Director, Digital Solutions Management.

This Senior Digital Product Manager will own the end-to-end product lifecycle from discovery and prioritization through delivery and optimization, working closely with Strategic and National Accounts, Commercial Excellence, Customer Care, Enterprise Technology, and external partners. They will develop a deep understanding of how DSO corporate teams (procurement, supply chain, operations, and clinical leadership) and the practices beneath them work, and use data, experimentation, and AI-enabled approaches to inform decisions. Success in this role requires strong B2B product judgment, fluency in enterprise account structures and integration patterns, and the ability to translate complex commercial and clinical workflows into clear, scalable solutions aligned with HuFriedyGroup's premium brand and long-term digital strategy.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Shaping the DSO Roadmap**

* Owns the DSO digital roadmap and backlog, building it from the ground up and continuously evolving it as the business, customers, and learnings change
* Builds a working understanding of the DSO segment, including how DSOs are structured, how they buy, and how corporate and practice-level teams work, through ongoing discovery with DSO customers, Strategic and National Accounts, Commercial Excellence, Customer Care, and Operations
* Captures and evaluates digital opportunities across eProcurement, eCommerce, DSO portals, and DSO-specific digital service offerings, assessing customer value, business impact, feasibility, and effort
* Balances near-term proofs of concept and quick wins with longer-term platform outcomes, pursuing both in parallel rather than in sequence
* Uses evidence from pilots, experiments, and customer feedback to validate, reprioritize, or pivot, and is willing to stop work that isn't delivering value

**The Opportunity**

The Senior Product Manager owns a KWI product area end to end. You will evolve what clients run today and define where the product goes next. You are accountable for what it delivers, not only for what ships: adoption across the client base, measurable gains for the retailers using it, and a delivery pace the team can hold.

This is a hands-on role on a small product team. You will work directly with the retail teams who use your product every day, with engineering and design, and with the client-facing teams who see the problems first, in an AI-led, spec-driven development model.

**The Company**

We are a small team with a big vision: to be the premier provider of cloud technology solutions for retailers. KWI offers a complete, unified commerce solution, specifically designed to help specialty retailers grow their business. Our portfolio of customers includes Pandora, Bluemercury, Tom Ford and many other globally recognizable brands.

We combine Point of Sale, Merchandising, Order Management, CRM, and Loyalty into one cloud-based platform. We are a values- and mission-driven organization, and we believe that if we develop and demonstrate leadership in our strategy, operations, and people, we will continue to drive product innovation and service excellence.

**AI at KWI**

We are serious about AI. Not as a buzzword, but as a real part of how we work. We expect every member of our team to actively use AI tools to work smarter, move faster, and do more with less. We are not looking for someone who has heard of AI. We are looking for someone who can walk us through how they use it day to day: in their current role, in how they organize their work, and in how they solve problems. **THE POSITION**

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

FanDuel is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Core Data Infrastructure (CDI) within our centralized Data Products team. CDI is the foundational layer that powers every data product at FanDuel: our Databricks lakehouse platform, workflow orchestration, self-service data tooling, and the governance and cost discipline that keep all of it trustworthy and efficient. You will set product direction across four engineering verticals (Data Tooling, Databricks Platform, Data Platform Customer Success, and Data Security), working daily with senior engineering leadership to move CDI from an engineering-led backlog to a product-led roadmap with clear priorities, defensible metrics, and measurable adoption. This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role on the critical path for company-wide data reliability, compliance (SOX, ABAC and data governance), and platform cost management, feeding directly into FanDuel's broader Data Platform strategy and 2026 OKRs.

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.

  

**THE GAME PLAN**  
Everyone on our team has a part to play

* Own the CDI product roadmap end to end: the Databricks lakehouse platform, Airflow orchestration, and Stargate (our self-service data access and provisioning tool), translating a large technical backlog into a focused, prioritized roadmap.

* Represent CDI in FanDuel's Unified Data Context and semantic layer strategy, partnering with peer Data Product Managers and Central AI to define scope, sequencing, and hand-offs as the program matures.

* Elicit requirements in the form of clear problem statements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and run a disciplined backlog that engineering managers and stakeholders can plan against with confidence.

* Monitor platform health (reliability, data quality, blocked-work trends, and adoption) and use that signal to continuously re-prioritize the roadmap.

* Play an active role in FanDuel's Product Management community, sharing best practices and helping raise the bar for product-led thinking across traditionally engineering-led teams.

**What We Do:**

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That's why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 5M endpoints and 16M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

**Reports To: Director of Product Management, Platform**

**Location: Remote US**

**Compensation: $190,000 to $220,000 base plus bonus and equity**

**About The Role:**

We are building a product management organization to own and drive our product strategy, and we are looking for an experienced product manager to own a new team focused entirely on Security tooling for the Huntress SOC.

Our SOC is the cornerstone of the Huntress Security Platform, serving SMB and mid-market clients through MSP/MSSP and Reseller channels. It delivers premium, human+AI services at a scale most companies can't match — Rapid Response, Tactical Response, and Hypercare together accounted for roughly 150 engagements in a single recent month. It is also the foundation layer, so the interfaces you publish are consumed by our agentic automation team and our partner-facing product team.

Your users are professional security analysts, and they are down the hall. You will get direct, immediate, unfiltered feedback on everything you ship from people who do this work for a living.

You will work closely with SOC leadership, engineering leaders, support, and other Product Managers. jobs.title: Senior Commercial Product Manager
jobs.desc:
As the first product lead for commercial systems at Zoox, you will own the vision and priorities for marketplace optimization in our ride-hail business — how we price, how we promote, and how we deploy a fixed fleet across the hours and zones of each market — and turn them into the requirements the teams building those systems plan against. Because we own and operate our vehicles, supply is fixed in the short run, and these levers are how we trade growth against profit week to week. They include:  
Planned pricing — the rate card and its shaping by time of day and geography, per-zone fees, and the controls operators use to manage a market before any model intervenes.

**Dynamic pricing** — the real-time engine that balances a fixed fleet against live demand, weighing growth against profit market by market.  
**Promotions and incentives** — from promo mechanics and budget planning through targeted, personalized incentives as the rider base grows.  
**Fleet supply** — how many vehicles are in service each hour and where they stage and charge, so fleet and pricing decisions optimize against the same objectives.

This is a hands-on role: you will write the PRDs that define what each system optimizes for, specify the models that make those decisions, and prove they worked. You will sit in the Commercial organization and partner closely with Data Science, Fleet Operations, Finance, and the product and engineering teams that build these systems. It is ideal for a marketplace product manager who has owned a pricing, incentives, matching, or supply lever and wants to shape how an autonomous mobility business makes money.

### **In this role you will:**

* Set the objectives that pricing, promotions, and fleet deployment optimize against, from the weekly supply plan to real-time dispatch, so that decisions made in separate systems add up to one commercial plan.
* Partner day to day with Data Science on elasticity estimation, price effects modeling, demand and supply forecasting, supply planning, and marketplace simulation, bringing a clear point of view on what to build.
* Set the priorities for the vertical: size the expected business impact and effort of each initiative with the science and engineering leads, stack rank them, and re-rank each quarter as results come in.
* Drive delivery across the teams that build these systems, managing dependencies, holding the schedule, and escalating early when a date is at risk.
* Design the experiments and simulation studies that gate launches, set ship criteria and guardrail metrics before launch, make the ship call, and write the readout against the sizing that justified the work.  
  Run the weekly operating cadence with Commercial Operations, Fleet Operations, and Finance: diagnose variance, propose changes to live levers, and present lever performance and roadmap status to leadership.

### **Qualifications**

* 8+ years in product management, technical program management, or marketplace strategy roles, including significant time on marketplace products — ride-hail, delivery, travel, or similar — where pricing, incentives, matching, or supply planning was the product.
* Demonstrated ability to specify an optimization problem in writing: given "we should price better," you can return an objective, its constraints, the data it needs, the guardrails it must respect, and the experiment that validates it.
* A track record of driving a roadmap to completion through teams that do not report to you, changing priorities with evidence rather than authority.
* A quantitative foundation: a degree in economics, operations research, statistics, or a similar field, and practical experience applying it — specifying or building models, running experiments, and reading their results.
* Clear writing and presentation skills: PRDs that engineers and scientists can build from, and readouts that leadership can decide on.

jobs.title: Senior Digital Tipping Product Manager
jobs.desc:
### **About Us**

Think about your last hotel stay. Did you skip the front desk line with mobile check-in? Message the staff for extra pillows? Order a late-night snack with a tap on your phone? **Then you’ve likely run into Canary in the wild.**

Canary Technologies is the leading agentic AI platform for hotel and guest management, powering the digital infrastructure for more than 20,000 hotels in 125+ countries. The world's most renowned hospitality brands, including Marriott International, Four Seasons and Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, partner with us to increase revenue, improve operations and elevate the guest experience.

We’ve executed the largest deployment of autonomous AI systems in hospitality, building technology that fundamentally redefines how guests and hotels interact. It’s made us one of the top-funded hotel technology companies in the world, with nearly **$200M raised to date.**

Canary has been recognized as a 2024 and 2025 **Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ company, Inc. 5000 fastest-growing company,** and **swept the 2026 HotelTechAwards**, including *Best Place to Work, #1 Guest Experience Platform,* and *the Hotelier’s Choice Award*. We’re scaling our team to bring innovation to life faster than ever.

We're growing quickly, and we're looking for people who are passionate about their work, want to grow with us and are ready to take on more responsibility along the way. We value rigor and velocity in equal measure: high standards, fast pace, real ownership. If that's the environment you're looking for, this is the place for you.

**Come join us! Let’s shape the future of hospitality together.**

### **About the Role**

We’re looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to drive Canary’s Digital Tipping product, the award-winning platform that lets hotel guests tip and thank staff from their phones. Housekeepers, valets, bell staff and others have long missed out on tips because guests no longer carry cash. Digital Tipping changes that and puts meaningful income and recognition in the hands of the people who make hotel stays great. Tip volume has more than tripled year over year, and we’ve been named Best Digital Tipping Solution in the HotelTechAwards three years running.

This role sits where guest experience, payments and workforce systems meet. A guest scans a QR code or taps a link and tips in seconds. Behind that moment, money has to move accurately and in compliance. It has to reach staff through digital wallets, bank accounts or payroll, and it has to stay in sync with the HR and payroll systems that hotels and management companies run on. Working closely with Product leadership, you’ll own the roadmap and delivery across that loop, from the guest’s first tap to the payout in a staff member’s account.

  

### **What You’ll Do**

* Own the roadmap and day-to-day execution for Digital Tipping, in partnership with Product leadership, across the guest tipping experience, staff onboarding and wallets, payouts, and hotel admin and reporting.
* Drive payments and money-movement work with engineering and finance: payout partner integrations, wallet funding and reconciliation, ledger accuracy, fees, and tax and compliance reporting (e.g., IRS tip reporting, PCI).
* Ship and improve HR and payroll integrations (e.g., UKG, Workday, Dayforce), helping move bespoke enterprise integrations toward repeatable, self-serve capabilities.
* Partner with customer success and sales on enterprise rollouts with hotel brands and management companies, including brand-app integrations, brand standards and complex staffing models such as contract workers.
* Run initiatives and experiments to grow adoption and tip volume: staff setup completion, scan-to-tip conversion, and guest touchpoints in use (QR, SMS, email, checkout, brand apps).
* Track and report on the product’s key metrics, including tip volume, conversion, staff activation, payout reliability and support volume, and use the data to inform priorities.
* Write clear requiremen

jobs.desc:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

Reddit is looking for an experienced Product Manager to help build a safe experience for the next generation of experiences for younger users while preserving a high-quality consumer experience. You will own ambiguous, zero-to-one product problems at the intersection of consumer product, safety, identity/age assurance, and global regulation. You will work closely with legal and cross-functional partners to determine what is truly required, frame clear options and tradeoffs, and ship scalable experiences that can adapt as laws and expectations evolve across markets.

Responsibilities

  • Own strategy, roadmap, requirements, launch, and measurable outcomes for Youth product initiatives.
  • Build and evolve age-assurance and third-party age-verification flows, including recovery/appeal experiences for users who are incorrectly classified.
  • Develop youth-specific product protections and controls, including age-gated content experiences, parental-control flows, and appropriate restrictions on product mechanics such as notifications, personalization, or chat where required.
  • Translate changing global regulations into objective product frameworks: clarify must-haves, deadlines, consequences, country exceptions, and viable product options with Legal and Policy.
  • Make principled tradeoffs between compliance, user experience, product value, technical complexity, and speed; escalate with clear evidence rather than treating legal interpretation as binary.
  • Partner with Engineering, Data/ML, Design, Research, Safety, Policy, Legal, and adjacent Product teams to ship durable solutions at Reddit scale.
  • Define success metrics and launch guardrails, monitor false positives/negatives and user friction where relevant, and iterate based on data and qualitative feedback.
  • Communicate strategy, risk, decisions, and progress clearly to senior stakeholders, including Product leadership.

Must-have qualifications

  • Significant product management experience building and launching consumer products at large scale.
  • Demonstrated zero-to-one ownership: framing ambiguous problems, setting strategy, writing requirements, shipping, learning, and iterating.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and ability to negotiate high-stakes tradeoffs with Legal, Engineering, Data, Safety/Policy, and senior stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and first-principles problem solving; can distinguish legal requirements from interpretations and convert ambiguity into decision frameworks.
  • Experience launching products across multiple markets or navigating meaningful market-specific requirements.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including concise articulation of options, risk, rationale, and recommendations.

Deployment choices change the product: features that are simple in standard SaaS can be hard, expensive, or impossible in a regulated or customer-owned environment. You'll also help shape which deployment models we offer next.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Internet Map
jobs.desc:
Company Background

Censys’ mission is to be the one place to understand everything on the internet. Frustrated by the lack of trustworthy Internet intelligence, we set out to create the industry’s most comprehensive, accurate, and up-to-date map of the Internet. Today, Censys delivers real-time Internet intelligence and actionable threat insights to global governments, over 50% of the Fortune 500, and leading threat intelligence providers worldwide.

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to scale execution of the Censys Internet Map: the most continuously updated view of every asset, port, service, and certificate we can find across the public internet. Building it means running one of the largest internet-wide scanning operations in the world - 400+ Protocols providing access to 3Trillion+ scans in our APIs, 10PetaBytes+ of historical data, scanning 250Million+ IPs across 65K ports daily, resolving 8Billion+ names every 24 hours and tracking DNS at scale, tracking 18B+ certificates, fingerprinting 100K+ technologies behind what we find, enriching all of it with human readable labels, and third-party context so it becomes actionable intelligence rather than raw data.

This role is anchored in disciplined delivery, translating complex coverage and enrichment priorities into requirements engineering can build against. You'll define business and customer priorities, run the delivery cadence, and keep engineering and cross-functional stakeholders aligned on what's shipping and why it matters.

What You’ll Do

Internet Map Execution: You will define the business and customer priorities behind what goes into the Internet Map and how it stays best-in-class. This is the lever that enables Censys to be successful across every product and every segment we operate in.

  • Coverage: How do we grow the map, how often we refresh it, and how comprehensively? This spans expanding IPv4/IPv6 scan scope, adding and prioritizing ports and protocols, increasing scan and DNS resolution frequency, and improving certificate and host discovery. You'll define this data collection work as detailed engineering requirements and acceptance criteria, and track coverage against baselines to identify and close gaps.
  • Context: How do we enrich data into actionable intelligence? You'll define enrichment priorities based on customer and product needs: technology fingerprinting, risk scoring, and third-party data integrations. This includes evaluating external/third-party data sources for accuracy, coverage, and cost; defining the metrics used to judge data and enrichment quality; defining the schema that structures how coverage and context data is represented; and writing the documentation that makes both understandable and usable internally and externally.

Cross-Team Alignment and Execution:

  • Drive cross-functional data prioritization across the Censys suite and provide business priority input into sequencing for new protocols and enrichments, ensuring data investments align with company goals, resolve multi-product conflicts, and provide roadmap transparency to other product managers and EMs.
  • Engineering partnership and data quality: You ensure Engineering teams working on scanning infrastructure, data pipelines, and enrichment systems have well-defined requirements, clear acceptance criteria, and the context they need to make good architectural decisions. Track coverage and context quality against baselines. Identify gaps between current state and target, and translate findings into concrete engineering work to close them.
