**Why Wellthy is for you!**

At Wellthy, we dream of a world where everyone has the care infrastructure they need to manage their own health and the health and well-being of their loved ones.  
  
We're building something new in the care space - reimagining how care is delivered, accessed, and supported by families around the globe. As we grow, we're seeking collaborative, curious, and purpose-driven teammates to help us expand what's possible.  
  
Our work is grounded in the expertise of seasoned care professionals who deeply understand families' real challenges paired with agile, tech-powered solutions that deliver support efficiently and at scale. We embrace a mindset of continuous learning, especially around emerging technologies. Tools like AI and other innovations are accelerators, enabling us to scale our impact, work smarter, and stay at the forefront of care delivery.

Through Wellthy, millions of families have access to support to help them manage care during every stage of life, with hands-on experts guiding families through caregiving or backup care journeys. And with the acquisition of Patch Caregiving, Wellthy continues to expand how care shows up for working families by pairing care navigation and coordination with on-site and near-site employer-based childcare. This combination allows us to support families not just in navigating care decisions, but in accessing real, hands-on help when and where they need it most. Together, we're building a more connected, comprehensive care experience for families and caregivers alike.

We partner with leading companies including more than 40 Fortune 500 companies to support the care needs of their workforces globally. We also work alongside health plans and carriers to embed care support into their offerings, enhancing the experience and outcomes for members.  
  
We're building, evolving, and expanding the market category for care, and we're looking for responsive, collaborative, curious, and purposeful colleagues to join us.

**As our Product Manager II**, you will work in a management capacity to shape the future of our product. You will help build and deliver solutions to better support our caregiving members, enable our internal care teams to more efficiently deliver a world-class experience, and showcase the value of our service to our clients. You will lead efforts around product vision, prioritization, and scoping.

**You will report directly to the Chief Product Officer.**

**To be successful in this role you will be:**

* **Product Vision & Strategy:** Owning and championing the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, aligning stakeholders and leadership while exercising strong judgment to prioritize what gets built and why.
* **Hands-On Discovery:** Leading a rigorous discovery process by running user interviews, conducting experiments, and analyzing data to uncover insights and validate hypotheses.
* **Execution & Collaboration:** Working side-by-side with engineers, designers, and data professionals to clarify requirements, solve roadblocks, and guide the development of high-impact features.
* **Innovation:** Actively identifying opportunities to leverage AI and other emerging technologies to create a competitive advantage and deliver step-change improvements to the user experience.
* **Ownership & Impact:** Defining success metrics, tracking product performance against key business goals, and taking full ownership of the product lifecycle from launch to sunset.
  

**Qualifications**

To be successful in this role, you'll need to be open to learning, experimenting, and evolving. Comfort with emerging technology and curiosity around how tools like AI can support your workflow or help families more effectively is a plus.

* You are a builder who is energized by learning, experimenting, and evolving. You actively seek to apply emerging technologies, especially AI, to enhance your workflow, build smarter products, and more effectively support the members we serve.

**Summary**
  
  
The Product Manager is responsible for supporting the direction, delivery, and ongoing success of assigned Naviam products. This role manages the product roadmap, backlog, requirements, release priorities, and cross-functional coordination for approximately two to three products, ensuring that product execution aligns with company strategy, customer needs, delivery realities, quality expectations, and engineering capacity.  
  
The Product Manager serves as a key collaboration point between Product, Engineering, Delivery, Quality Assurance, Customer Solutions, Sales, Support, and other stakeholders. This role translates business goals, customer feedback, implementation learnings, and market insights into clear product requirements and actionable development priorities. While overall commercial and product strategy is led by senior product leadership, the Product Manager may provide input based on customer discovery, delivery feedback, product usage, and market observations.  
  
Success in this role requires strong communication, practical decision-making, attention to detail, and the ability to balance customer needs, technical feasibility, delivery timelines, testing readiness, and product quality in a B2B enterprise software environment.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and manage the roadmap, backlog, priorities, and product direction for assigned products, typically overseeing two to three products.
* Define, document, and communicate product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, release priorities, and product decisions.
* Serve as a primary collaboration point between Product, Engineering, Delivery, Quality Assurance, Customer Solutions, Sales, Support, and other stakeholder teams.
* Work closely with engineering teams during planning, refinement, sprint execution, review, and release activities to support clear prioritization and successful delivery.
* Coordinate with Quality Assurance on testing scope, test planning, feature validation, defect review, regression considerations, and release readiness.
* Help ensure new features and product changes are clearly defined, testable, and aligned with expected functionality before release.
* Partner with delivery, implementation, customer solutions, support, and customer-facing teams to gather feedback, identify recurring needs, and ensure product improvements address real-world enterprise use cases.
* Participate in customer, prospect, partner, and internal stakeholder conversations, including sales and delivery discovery calls, to understand needs, explain product direction, and gather feedback for future planning.
* Prioritize product work based on customer value, business impact, delivery effort, technical considerations, quality, testing needs, and strategic alignment.
* Support release planning by helping define release scope, communicate planned functionality, review readiness, coordinate stakeholder awareness, and identify unresolved risks or dependencies.
* Maintain product documentation, including product requirements, feature definitions, internal enablement materials, release notes, testing coordination notes, and related product communication.
* Collaborate with design, engineering, delivery, and QA stakeholders to ensure features are usable, technically sound, practical to implement, and sufficiently validated.
* Help identify opportunities for product improvement, operational efficiency, product integration, and better alignment across Naviam’s enterprise software offerings.
* Monitor customer, market, and technology trends relevant to assigned products and use those insights to inform product recommendations and prioritization discussions.
* Support Agile and Scrum-based practices, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, prioritization, review, retrospective activities, and ongoing coordination with delivery teams as appropriate.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Omnichannel
jobs.desc:
**Description**

**About the Company**

Ria Money Transfer is a business segment of Euronet Worldwide, Inc. (NASDAQ: EEFT). We make it fast, reliable, and affordable for people to send money abroad. Ria has become one of the largest players in traditional remittances, and now we're focused on making online money transfers simple and accessible to everyone.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a Product Manager to own Ria's omnichannel product portfolio — the programs and tools that bring our massive brick-and-mortar customer base into digital channels. Ria built its business on physical agents and storefronts, and this role owns the strategy and products that move those customers online: the Agent Referral Program, in-store self-service tools, and the agent POS experience. It's a role central to Ria's long-term omnichannel strategy, with scope and seniority that grow as the program scales globally.

You'll own a multi-program, multi-market portfolio end-to-end, partnering across engineering, design, compliance, regional and commercial teams, and our global agent network. This is a consumer-facing PM role with real scale and real stakes — you're on the hook for digital adoption from a customer base placing millions of transactions, and for expanding proven programs across Ria's footprint. If you like solving practical problems that touch millions of people sending money home — and you want to own the bridge between physical and digital, not just a single app — we'd love to talk.

**What You'll Do**

Own the Portfolio

* Own the roadmap and delivery for Ria's omnichannel portfolio: the Agent Referral Program, the brick-and-mortar self-service tool, and the in-store agent POS experience.
* Scale and improve the Agent Referral Program, expanding it beyond current markets (US, AU, CA, UK, MY) to all Ria markets.
* Roll out the B&M self-service tool — transfer status, modify, cancel, receipts, and compliance document upload — from US/AU to all markets.
* Write clear specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering can build from directly.

Drive Digital Migration

* Define and drive new initiatives to migrate brick-and-mortar customers to digital channels (app and web).
* Improve the omnichannel experience in the agent POS used in stores.
* Use product data and customer insight to prioritize the adoption and migration problems actually worth solving.

Ship & Scale

* Lead a cross-functional squad through delivery — managing trade-offs, clearing blockers, and keeping momentum.
* Own outcomes, not just output: define success metrics — digital adoption from the B&M base, program performance, market expansion — and tie your work directly to them.
* Build for scale, expanding proven programs across Ria's global footprint with a repeatable playbook for each new market rather than a one-off lift each time.

Align Stakeholders

jobs.desc:
About GaggleAMP

GaggleAMP helps companies turn employees into active advocates on social media. Our customers run employee advocacy programs that drive brand visibility, sales engagement, and recruiting impact, all with minimal effort from the people involved. We've been at this for years, have real customers, and have a clear point of view about what we do and who we do it for.

Mission

Own product at GaggleAMP so that every feature we ship makes our customers' jobs genuinely easier and proves measurable value to their organizations, applying phase-one discipline and customer evidence to every decision.

Outcomes

We share this scorecard openly so you know exactly what success looks like.

**By day 30:**

* Reviewed at least 20 recorded customer calls and built working knowledge of customer pains and language patterns
* Held one-on-ones with each developer, the engineering lead, the customer success lead, the CEO, and at least two CS team members
* Read and internalized our product principles, persona docs, brand guide, and GTM playbook well enough to apply them in conversation
* Audited the current product backlog, can articulate what's in flight and why, and formed initial opinions on prioritization
* Scoped at least two product optimizations end-to-end (from usage data through a defined solution to engineering handoff)
* Produced a written first-impressions document for the CEO and engineering lead

**By day 90:**

* Shipped at least one meaningful piece of new work that you scoped, designed, and handed off, with engineering buy-in
* Own and run weekly product/design reviews independently
* Produced a roadmap proposal for the upcoming quarter, defined as the full mix of new capability, optimizations to existing flows, and infrastructure work that affects usability. Grounded in customer evidence and our product principles
* Built your own customer conversation cadence (at least two live customer calls per month)
* Reduced senior leadership involvement in feature-level product decisions to near zero
* Made at least one clearly defensible "no" to a feature request, based on principle application rather than capacity

Competencies

**Customer obsession and persona discipline.** Every product decision grounded in real customer evidence, applied to a specific persona, not imagined users.

**Phase-one scoping discipline.** Ship the smallest meaningful version first and let customer feedback drive what comes next. Comfortable cutting scope. Can defend "no" with reasoning.

**Strategic and tactical balance.** Real product work is a mix of new capability, optimizations, and usability-affecting infrastructure, not just new feature delivery. Resist the bias toward shipping new things at the expense of improving what exists.

**AI-leveraged execution with human ownership.** Use AI tools fluently across discovery, writing, design, and analysis. Own every outcome and deliverable as your own work, regardless of which tools helped produce it. AI is leverage, not a substitute for judgment.

**Scrappy execution and self-direction.** Operate without scaffolding. Build your own systems and rhythms. Comfortable with ambiguity. Direct in communication, including with leadership.

**Design fluency (a plus, not required).** Comfortable partnering on UI work and reviewing it against our design system. Hands-on Figma execution is a bonus.

How we work

Small team, fast cadence, customer-driven. You'll partner closely with engineering on a continuous shipping rhythm and have direct CEO engagement on product strategy. You'll own product end-to-end: there's no separate designer, no PM peer, no analyst pulling reports for you. We use AI tools heavily and expect you to.

This role is for builders, not process managers. If you want to talk to customers, make the strategic calls, influence the design of the screens, write the stories, and ship to real people who depend on the product, let's talk.

jobs.desc:
**Overview**

MARTAC is seeking a Product Manager to own a hardware-software OEM module product line. This module enables platform and mission autonomy by integrating sensors with compute, networking, and circuit-level hardware into a productized package that third parties can adopt. This role requires genuine engineering design skill in circuit integration, compute selection, and networking architecture, not only program coordination, since the Product Manager will directly manage and integrate the components that make sensor integration possible. Beyond engineering design, this role owns the product's full lifecycle and market position, working closely with business development as MARTAC brings the product to customers.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the engineering design and integration of the product's core components: circuit integration, compute selection, and networking architecture.
* Manage the integration of sensors into the module to enable platform autonomy (navigation, collision avoidance) and mission autonomy (sensor-driven behaviors).
* Define and maintain the product's design specifications, ensuring the module meets performance, size, weight, power, and manufacturability requirements.
* Own the product lifecycle, from concept and design through production, fielded support, and next-generation iteration.
* Own the product's market position, working with business development to shape pricing, positioning, and customer-facing roadmap as MARTAC pursues customers for the product.
* Partner with the Chief Systems Engineer on design reviews, ensuring design decisions meet engineering standards and receive appropriate technical sign-off.
* Coordinate with third-party OEM partners and internal platform teams to define integration requirements and interface specifications for product adoption.
* Support proposal efforts, customer technical interchange meetings, and program reviews as the product lead.
* Maintain configuration control and design documentation for the product line.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* Hands-on engineering design experience in circuit integration, embedded compute, and networking architecture.
* Demonstrated experience integrating sensors into a hardware platform or module, ideally in support of autonomy or robotics applications.
* Experience taking a hardware or hardware-software product through productization, from design to a market-ready product.
* Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to work across engineering, business development, and customer-facing stakeholders.
* Comfort owning both the technical design and the business and lifecycle side of a product.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience with unmanned or autonomous systems, sensor fusion, or defense OEM hardware products.
* Experience supporting defense customers and contract deliverables.
* Familiarity with platform autonomy and mission autonomy concepts as applied to unmanned maritime systems.
* Prior experience operating within a matrixed engineering organization supporting multiple concurrent product lines.

**Location**

This position is based on-site, either at MARTAC's Melbourne, Florida headquarters or at MARTAC's San Diego, California West Coast Innovation Hub.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

At Exacta Systems, we’re not just shaping the future of gaming—we’re redefining it. As a leader in historical horse racing (HHR) technology, we create cutting-edge gaming solutions that power thrilling player experiences nationwide. Now part of the Churchill Downs family, we’re backed by a storied legacy of excellence in racing and gaming. This new chapter brings exciting opportunities for growth, stability, innovation, and impact. If you're looking for a career where technology meets tradition and where your ideas drive the future, let’s explore the possibilities together!

**JOB SUMMARY**
---------------

This role sits directly under the Sr. Director, Product Management in a small, high-visibility product organization. The Product Owner will own the backlog for a defined product area, with real latitude over day-to-day delivery decisions, direct access to product leadership, and a clear line of sight from the work to how operators run their business. For someone who wants to build durable expertise in a complex regulated domain and see their decisions reach production quickly, this is a more substantive seat than an equivalent role inside a large product org.

The Product Owner is responsible for translating Exacta’s product strategy and roadmap into clear, actionable work for software development teams. Serving as a key connection point between Product leadership, Engineering, Quality Assurance, Operations, and other business stakeholders, this role owns and prioritizes the product backlog and ensures development teams have the requirements, context, and clarity necessary to deliver high-quality solutions.

The Product Owner works closely with technical teams throughout the software development lifecycle to define requirements, develop user stories and acceptance criteria, clarify business needs, prioritize work, and validate that completed functionality achieves its intended outcome. This position requires a strong understanding of Exacta’s Historical Horse Racing (HHR) products, customers, operational environments, and business processes.

This is a hands-on, delivery-focused position. The Product Owner operates within the product strategy and roadmap established by Product leadership and is expected to exercise strong independent judgement on day-to-day prioritization, scope, and sequencing.

* Own, maintain, and refine the product backlog.
* Translate product strategy, roadmap priorities, business needs, and customer requirements into actionable development work.
* Prioritize work based on business value, customer impact, dependencies, regulatory requirements, and defect severity.
* Ensure backlog items are defined, sequenced, and development-ready.
* Exercise independent judgment on daily priorities; escalate decisions materially affecting scope, roadmap, or strategy.
* Ensure development teams understand priorities and business rationale.

About HUD

HUD is building infrastructure to create RL training data and evals for frontier AI agents, as well as a marketplace to sell these to frontier labs through the HUD marketplace. Our platform is used by frontier labs, Fortune 500 companies, and startups. We’ve raised $16M from top VCs and were YC W25.

About the role

We’re looking a Product Manager to own product work for our data marketplace. You’ll make it easier for data vendors to bring high-quality RL environments and training data to HUD, and for research teams to discover, evaluate, and use them. You’ll work closely with engineering, research, and GTM to turn technical and operational needs into product decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Own the marketplace product lifecycle, from understanding vendor and buyer needs through prioritization, launch, and iteration

  • Improve how vendors onboard, submit work, understand quality feedback, and manage their offerings on HUD

  • Improve how research teams discover, assess, and access environments and training data that meet their needs

  • Work with engineering, research, GTM, and operations to turn complex requirements and manual processes into reliable platform workflows

  • Define and track measures of marketplace health, product adoption, and user experience; use feedback and product data to decide what to build next

Experience

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • Experience owning a live software product from discovery through launch and iteration

  • Strong product judgment and the ability to simplify technically complex workflows for users

  • Experience talking directly with users, identifying the problem behind a request, and turning what you learn into clear priorities

  • Ability to balance user needs, business impact, and engineering constraints when making product decisions

  • Comfort using qualitative feedback and quantitative signals to assess whether a product change worked

  • Clear written communication and the ability to bring engineers and other partners together around decisions in an ambiguous environment

Strong candidates may also have:

  • Experience with marketplaces or products serving two distinct groups of users

  • Familiarity with AI training data, evaluations, and RL environments

  • Experience building a product function or establishing product practices on a growing team

  • Early-stage startup experience and strong communication skills for collaboration across teams and time zones

We prioritize technical aptitude and learning potential over years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet all criteria.

Overview:

**About M.C. Dean**

M.C. Dean is Building Intelligence. We design, build, operate, and maintain cyber-physical solutions for the nation’s most mission-critical facilities, secure environments, complex infrastructure, and global enterprises. With over 9,000 employees, our capabilities span electrical, electronic security, telecommunications, life safety, automation and controls, audiovisual, and IT systems. Headquarters in Tysons, Virginia, M.C. Dean delivers resilient, secure, and innovative power and technology solutions through engineering expertise and smart systems integration.

**Why Join Us?**

Our people are passionate about engineering innovation that improves lives and drives impactful change. Guided by our core values—agility, expertise, and trust—we foster a collaborative and forward-thinking work environment. At M.C. Dean, we are committed to building the next generation of technical leaders in electrical, engineering, and cybersecurity industries.

We are seeking a **Product Manager** to join our **Security and Electronic Systems (SES)** business Unit. As part of **(SES)** Strategic Business Unit you will be part of a team that designs, engineers, integrates, operates and maintains electronic security services inclusive of intrusion detection, access control, biometric authentication, video surveillance, audio visual, it systems, perimeter defense and command and control systems for federal, local and commercial customers across high-growth markets.

Responsibilities:

We design, develop, deploy and manage software which extends, manages, and integrates the OT solutions we deploy with our customer’s business systems. The software we develop orchestrates critical business processes for our customers and automates data flow to form their enterprise systems. The focus of this position is driving delivery of the software we build for our customers throughout the entirety of the Software Development Life Cycle. The successful candidate will have a keen ability to research, empathize with, and translate user needs into prioritized, clearly defined product requirements that are understandable by technical and business teams. The Senior Product Manager responsibilities will include (but will not be limited to) the following:

* Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle from concept to implementation.
* Capture, document, and communicate customer needs, translating requirements into features and user stories and drive the technical team’s understanding of requirements.
* Define and prioritize product roadmaps to best meet the needs of a diverse set of internal and external stakeholders throughout the organization and across our customer set.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to define product requirements and ensure timely product delivery.
* Manage product backlog, prioritize features, and work with technical and project stakeholders to make trade-off decisions.
* Lead day to day software operations, managing productivity to ensure release targets are consistently met by managing work assignments, balancing resources, and remediating blocking conditions.
* Create, manage, and maintain detailed and accurate system documentation, including design and configuration plans, design diagrams, task-oriented procedures, operations and maintenance plans, etc.
* Plan and conduct user testing (UAT).
* Establish KPIs, identify gaps, and improve performance and adoption of the products we deliver.
* Lead product demos, training sessions, and other activities to support internal and external stakeholders.

**Key Requirements:**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related Technical Discipline with 10+ years

Product Owner

Are you a product driven problem solver who enjoys turning customer insight into things that actually get built? Do you love turning complexity into clarity, aligning teams, and shaping product experiences that genuinely make people’s lives easier? If so, we’d love to meet you!

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
**About Improvado**
-------------------

Improvado is a marketing data and AI analytics platform for enterprise brands and agencies. We connect 500+ marketing and sales data sources, normalize them through a governed data model, and put an AI agent on top so marketing teams can ask questions of their own data without going through BI or IT.

**What we sell:** extraction and 500+ connectors; data transformation (SQL and dbt-compatible); Marketing Data Governance — taxonomy, naming, data-quality rules; warehouse and storage; dashboards; AI agent and MCP access to live marketing data; DECS, data engineering as a service on a 2 to 4 week SLA.

**Who buys it:**

* *Economic buyers:* CMO, VP Marketing, VP Demand Gen, agency COO and ops leadership
* *Technical evaluators:* VP or Director of Marketing Analytics, marketing analysts, data engineering, sometimes IT and security
* *Segments:* enterprise brands, mid-market, agencies
* *Verticals:* pharma and healthcare, financial services, retail and eCommerce, gaming, agencies

**Why this role, now**
----------------------

* **Our messaging is not aligned.** Positioning, web, sales pitch, product and content each carry a different version of what Improvado is. The market categorizes us as "marketing ETL" while we position as an AI marketing analytics platform. That gap costs us deal quality and price.
* **The category is crowded and moving fast.** Battlecards exist but decay, and nobody owns keeping them true.
* **Attribution, incrementality and causal measurement is where deals are won and lost** — and it is the hardest thing to argue credibly without hand-waving.
* **Analyst firms are a silent blocker.** When an enterprise buyer asks Gartner or Forrester about Improvado, there is no briefed narrative waiting for them.

You would not start from a blank page. We already have a positioning registry, roughly 11 documented buyer personas, a pain-point and value-prop library, competitor intel reports and about 10 battlecards. They are inconsistent and under-used. Your first job is to make one version true and make people use it.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* **Positioning and messaging.** Core positioning, category framing and message hierarchy across ICPs and personas. ICP and persona documentation that is used, not filed. The messaging layer of new product and feature launches, including the internal rollout that makes the field able to sell it.
* **Competitive intelligence and win/loss.** A structured win/loss interview program with quarterly readouts. Living battlecards. Monitoring competitor positioning, pricing and product moves, and driving our counter-positioning.
* **Sales enablement.** The core pitch narrative, demo storyline and objection-handling framework. The messaging components of new-rep onboarding. A standing weekly cadence with Sales leadership — not quarterly check-ins. Direct support on competitive and enterprise deals: RFPs, security and technical evaluations, displacement plays.
* **Market and analyst relations.** The Improvado narrative for Gartner, Forrester and category influencers, so that a buyer's analyst call becomes an accelerator rather than a blocker. Feeding structured market and buyer insight back into product prioritization.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 4 to 8 years in product marketing, or an equivalent blend of product marketing with marketing analytics, marketing or data ops, sales engineering, analytics consulting, or product management on a data product.
* Category fluency in marketing data and measurement: attribution models, incrementality testing, MMM, data governance and taxonomy, warehouses and ETL/ELT — including where each is honestly weak.
* B2B SaaS sold to marketing or data buyers. Marketing analytics, martech, measurement, CDP, BI and data-infrastructure vendors are the reference profile.
* Proof you have shipped, not just documented: positioning that changed the website and the pitch, battlecards

Our platform powers critical operations across business aviation, regional airlines, and aircraft leasing & finance, helping over 1,000 aviation organizations streamline operations, improve decision-making, and operate more efficiently.

Portside is hiring a Product Manager to work on Horizon, our cloud-based flight management platform built for flight departments, fractional ownership programs, and jet card operators of every size and level of complexity. Horizon serves as the operational core for these organizations, unifying aircraft scheduling, crew management, compliance tracking, and financial operations into a single connected system, supported by advanced analytics and a growing suite of integrations.  
  
In this role, you'll help build and deliver features that support real flight operations, in an industry that is rapidly modernizing, including a growing use of AI.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Care Operations Platform
jobs.desc:
About Caret Health

Caret Health runs care coordination for rural and critical-access hospitals. Rural hospitals are accountable for value-based-care outcomes and eligible for reimbursable programs — remote patient monitoring, chronic and transitional care management, annual wellness visits, quality-gap closure, cancer navigation — that they have nobody to staff. We supply both: the platform the programs run on, and, where a customer wants it, the people who run them.

That combination makes us unusual. The clinical platform is licensed and used directly by hospital care teams, and it is also the system our own staff work when we deliver programs on a customer's behalf. It carries real clinical operations across 50+ hospitals and a large rural patient panel — quality measures tracked, discharges worked against a 48-hour clock, monitoring alerts triaged, billable time documented.

This role owns that platform.

**The role**

You will own the **Care Operations Platform**: the system care teams work in every day to run every program we deliver. Patient records and statuses, protocol and tasking engines, work queues, task outcomes, the team inbox, multi-program logic, roles and access — plus the integrations that feed it.

The bar is high. These are people doing clinical work under deadlines, on patients with real conditions, in organizations that are already short-staffed. A confusing screen costs time that a rural care team does not have. A broken data feed means a care gap nobody knows about.

This is an execution-heavy product role with room to grow into strategy. You'll run discovery, write the specs, own the planning, run the release train for your area, and be accountable for whether what you shipped actually got adopted. You'll report to the Chief Product Officer, who currently carries this scope directly — your first job is to take it off their plate and run it better.

**What you'll own**

**Platform ownership.** The clinical platform end to end: roadmap, backlog, specs, and outcomes. You decide what gets built next in your area and say no to the rest, using a simple test — does it protect revenue, improve our cost-per-outcome, or advance our AI and data position?

**Discovery and research.** Run a continuous loop with the care teams, team leads, and operations managers who use the platform. Watch the work as it actually happens and turn observations into a ranked, evidenced problem list rather than a wish list. You'll be the person who can say what actually slows a care team down, with numbers attached.

**Integrations.** Clinical data arrives from EHRs, payer sources, monitoring devices, telephony and messaging providers, and partner platforms. You own the product side of these: what we ingest, how it maps, what happens when a field is missing or a feed goes quiet. Integrations must be **seamless for the user and observable for us** — a care team should never have to think about where the data came from, and we should know a pipeline is degraded before a customer tells us.

**Hypotheses and metrics.** Every meaningful thing you ship starts as a stated hypothesis — what we believe, what we expect to change, how we'll know — and ships with success metrics defined before the build. You'll instrument the work, read the results honestly, and kill what didn't work. Our product analytics stack is already in place and under-used; you'll change that.

**Planning and delivery.** Break quarterly direction into epics, specs, and well-written tickets. Own sprint planning and the backlog with the engineering leads. Keep cross-team dependencies visible and resolved before they become slips.

**Release management.** Own the release train for your area: scope, readiness, regression coverage with QA, release notes, rollout, and what happens when something goes wrong. Our cycle is slower than it should be — shrinking it, safely, is one of the things we'll measure you on.

**About Luma Financial Technologies**

Founded in 2018, Luma Financial Technologies (“Luma”) has pioneered a cutting-edge fintech software platform that has been adopted by broker/dealer firms, RIA offices, and private banks around the world. By using Luma, institutional and retail investors have a fully customizable, independent, buy-side technology platform that helps financial teams more efficiently learn about, research, purchase, and manage alternative investments as well as annuities. Luma gives these users the ability to oversee the full, end-to-end process lifecycle by offering a suite of solutions. These include education resources and training materials; creation and pricing of custom structured products; electronic order entry; and post-trade management. By prioritizing transparency and ease of use, Luma is a multi-issuer, multi-wholesaler, and multi-product option that advisors can utilize to best meet their clients’ specific portfolio needs. Headquartered in Cincinnati, OH, Luma also has offices in New York, NY, Miami, FL, Zurich, Switzerland and Lisbon, Portugal. For more information, please visit Luma’s website.

**About the role**

Luma Financial Technologies is expanding into asset management, and is seeking a Product Owner to help lead that expansion. This role owns product delivery for ETF, Actively Managed Certificate (AMC), Separately Managed Account (SMA) and other related product types that will be supported across Luma's Lifecycle Manager and Product Marketplace, and for the data connectivity that underpins them — integrations with ETF ecosystem partners, such as DTCC, custodians, transfer agents, index provides, sub advisors and other market participants.. The role requires strong organizational discipline, the ability to quickly reprioritize as situations evolve, and the judgment to balance near-term execution with longer-term platform objectives.

The ideal candidate brings 7+ years of experience with ETF, AMC, SMA or other similar products and understands the workflows of Asset Managers, ETF Providers, Custodians, DTCC, and other market participants. A background working at an Asset Management Company that creates and manages ETFs (e.g., Invesco, BlackRock, or similar) is strongly preferred, alongside experience at a fintech platform, custodian, or similar capital-markets institution.

**What you'll do**

**AI-DLC Execution and Delivery**

* Own end-to-end execution of Luma's AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Lifecycle) across discovery, design, development, QA, release, and post-launch evaluation for asset management capabilities.
* Apply Luma's AI-DLC process as the standard delivery methodology which is followed by all Luma Product Owners, using it to accelerate discovery, requirements drafting, and delivery.
* Translate complex asset management workflows into clear, detailed requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Manage multiple high-priority initiatives at once across Lifecycle Manager and Product Marketplace, ensuring each remains on track through structured planning and active communication.
* Demonstrate strong flexibility and real-time reprioritization as new information, constraints, or business needs emerge.
* Collaborate closely with Engineering to guide sprint planning, backlog refinement, and milestone management.

**Business Stakeholder Partnership**

* This is an external facing role that will require the Product Owner to manage client and partner relationships during the requirements, design, test and launch phases. Prior client or partner facing experience is a key requirement.
* Act as the central liaison between business teams and engineering, ensuring alignment of priorities and clarity of requirements.
* Partner with Sales, Trading, Operations, Asset Managers, ETF Providers, Custodians, Legal/Compliance, and Client Success to refine workflows and validate solutions.
* Communicate evolving priorities clearly and adjust plans as market conditions or stakeholder needs

We're ~160 people, fully remote, building an AI marketing platform. Our main product is OTTO, which runs a site's SEO on its own - it reads live search data and pushes the technical and on-page fixes itself, nobody queues them up. Around that we've got ad automation for Google and Meta, GBP management for multi-location brands, content gen, and LLM visibility tracking (whether ChatGPT and co are citing you). Autotrader, Hyundai, P&G, Vendasta are some of our customers.
Work happens in pods, 1 PM and 2-4 engineers. You own your pod's roadmap and ship it with them, no veteran PM signing off on your specs first. That's the part most PM roles won't hand you.
Looking for 3+ years PM in B2B SaaS with an actual technical background - eng or QA before PM, or a PM who's been getting into the codebase themselves. You should be able to read Python and TS, write your own SQL, find your way around an API, and not need an engineer to tell you what a stack trace says. We're Django on the back, React/Next on the front. QA is yours end to end including release sign-off, people tend to underestimate that bit. And you're already using Claude Code or similar daily, not "open to it".
A few notes before you apply:
- Experience: we're looking for people with a few years of hands-on product or engineering work behind them. The role is autonomous from the first week, so we need you ready to take the wheel. - Recruiting agencies: we hire in-house and manage every application ourselves, so there's no need to send candidates or reach out about partnerships. Thank you for understanding! - If your stack matches, please do reach out. Django/DRF/Celery/Postgres with React/Next, Python automation work around SEO: if that's your day-to-day and you're using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, whatever you like) in your real workflow, I want to hear from you. Don't talk yourself out of it because the title isn't an exact fit; tell me what you've built.
Recruitment process is screen with me, a take-home that runs about 75 mins, technical round with one of our senior PMs, then a call with our Director of Product (who you'd report to). I usually come back to people within 2 business days.
Our ATS forces us to list specific ywhere as long as you can do EST hours, so apply even if yours isn't
P.S: Not a PM, or the PM role isn't quite your thing? Have a look at everything else we have open at https://careers.searchatlas.com and apply directly to the role that suits you best (preferred route). If you're not sure which one that is, email me with a short line on what you do and I'll point you to the right one.

**What We’re Building**
-----------------------

Ember AI is building advanced agents to take that work off their plate, and help healthcare providers get paid for the care they deliver, without all the admin. We’re growing very fast, at 200% month on month which is why we need you!

**About the Role**
------------------

We’re looking for an exceptional Product Manager to own major areas of Ember’s AI agent platform.

You’ll become the SME for the product surfaces you own: understanding the customer problem deeply, defining what the agent should do, and working with engineering and operations to turn that understanding into a reliable product.

Our teams operate in fluid pods organized around the problem at hand. Depending on the initiative, you might work closely with engineers, agent operators, healthcare experts, customer-facing teams, or the founders.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own meaningful areas of Ember’s agent platform, from problem definition and product strategy through launch and continuous improvement.
* Talk directly with customers and users to understand how their work happens today, where it breaks down, and which problems are most valuable to solve.
* Translate complex workflows, customer needs, and business goals into clear product requirements, agent behavior, edge cases, and success criteria.
* Partner closely with engineering to design and ship AI-native products that are useful, reliable, and trusted in real healthcare environments.

-----------------------

Alpaca Health enables clinicians to become entrepreneurs, starting in autism care.

We help clinicians launch and scale their own clinics by providing AI-powered software, payer contracting, and full back-office infrastructure. Our goal is simple: shift power in healthcare away from large consolidated entities and back to clinicians.

We've raised over $14M in funding from early-stage investors like Core Innovation Capital, Adverb Ventures, and South Park Commons, and are building for long-term category leadership.

**The Role**
------------

We're hiring a Product Manager to own the buildout of several critical internal functions. You’ll lead the planning, implementation and rollout of internal tools and automations used by the Alpaca team to better service clinicians.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Get to the bottom of hard problems.** You’re going to be thrown into complex and ambiguous problems, clearly define the problems to be solved, and identify the 80/20 drivers and pursue them relentlessly.
* **Rethink how the work gets done.** You’ll have a chance to look at workflows with fresh eyes and design novel, industry first, high leverage solutions that work at scale. You’ll have a high degree of autonomy to select the best automation, integrations, product changes, and AI solutions.
* **Design how work flows.** You’ll map complex processes across people, systems, and outside partners, and design better ones that will stand the test of scale (as we grow 10x YoY).

* **Own the outcome.** You’ll work closely with our Head of Operations & Strategy to define success, then own the metrics and outcomes.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* **[REQUIRED]** 4 - 8 years of Product Management experience, preferably having previously owned a function at a venture backed mid-stage startup (Series B - D)
* **[REQUIRED]** Hands-on technical ability: comfortable writing code (Python, SQL, JavaScript, or similar), building with AI tools, and working with APIs and data
* **[REQUIRED]** Experience designing or rebuilding end-to-end processes in a regulated or operationally complex environment, such as healthcare, fintech, or logistics
* A track record of world class problem solving. You’ve been able to solve problems that 99% of people were not able to with meaningful outcomes
* Exceptional written and verbal communication. Ability to clearly communicate complex ideas in a clear and concise way. Ability to tailor your message based on the audience you’re speaking to (i.e. clinicians, internal stakeholders, our investors).

**Why Join**
------------

* The opportunity to materially impact the health outcomes of the most vulnerable populations
* Join one of the fastest growing healthcare startups in the world (between 30% - 50% monthly growth)
* Join a team of rockstar performers who are taking a new tech first approach to building a scalable digital health platform
* Competitive salary
* Meaningful equity
* Health benefits

Compensation Range: $160K - $200K

jobs.title: Lead Technical Product Management
jobs.desc:
**Discover a more connected career**
------------------------------------

Dycom Industries is embarking on a massive, transformational SAP S/4HANA implementation that will redefine how we operate. We are building a world-class SAP Center of Excellence (CoE) and are seeking a visionary **Technical Product Managemen**t **Lead** to own the "Lead-to-Cash" digital lifecycle.

In this critical role, you will bridge the gap between business execution and technical SAP configuration. You will act as the Chief Product Owner for the Sales and Order-to-Cash (O2C) functional areas, translating complex business needs into a scalable, modern digital experience.

**Connecting you to great benefits**
------------------------------------

* Weekly Paychecks
* Paid Time Off, Parental Leave, and Holidays
* Insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance)
* 401(k) w/ Company Match
* Stock Purchase Plan
* Education Reimbursement
* Legal Insurance
* Discounts on gym memberships, pet insurance, and much more!

**What you’ll do**
------------------

**Product Vision & Roadmap**

* Strategic Ownership: Own the multi-year product roadmap for the SAP Sales, Pricing, and Billing functional areas.
* Business Alignment: Partner directly with the BPO Lead for Sales/O2C to translate business goals, such as faster billing cycles and automated rate sheets, into actionable digital product strategies.
* Transformational Innovation: Identify opportunities to leverage SAP AI for predictive pricing, contract anomaly detection, and automated service entry sheet (SES) approvals.

**Process Engineering & Solution Design**

* Workflow Digitization: Map complex physical construction workflows to digital SAP workflows, ensuring the system elegantly handles unit-price contracts, milestone billing, time-and-materials (T&M), and retention tracking.
* User Experience (UX) Authority: Act as an authority on the UX for sales and billing personnel by advocating for simplified interfaces that reduce friction and manual data entry.
* Architectural Integrity: Collaborate with SAP Architects to ensure all proposed sales solutions adhere to the enterprise "Clean Core" strategy.

**Agile Delivery & Backlog Management**

* Team Leadership: Serve as a leader for the Sales/O2C technical team by writing clear, business-value-driven Epics and User Stories.
* Relentless Prioritization: Working with the Sales/O2C BPO, ruthlessly prioritize the development backlog based on ROI, focusing heavily on features that directly accelerate cash flow or reduce revenue leakage.
* Development Orchestration: Lead sprint planning, backlog refinement, and sprint reviews to ensure SAP developers understand the exact business intent behind every line of code.

**Adoption & Value Realization**

* Change Management: Partner with Organizational Change Management (OCM) to ensure new sales and billing features are fully embraced by the field and back-office teams.
* Performance Tracking: Define and monitor Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) to prove that released features actually move the needle on business velocity.

**What you’ll need**
--------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 5-8+ years of experience in SAP Sales & Distribution (SD) or Order-to-Cash (O2C) functional areas.
* Proven experience leading Agile development teams (Scrum or SAFe) and managing a product backlog.
* Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA architecture and SAP Fiori user experience principles.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into technical product strategies.
* Experience with "Clean Core" architectural principles and SAP development best practices.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams.
* Knowledge of SAP AI capabilities and their application in business process automation.

jobs.title: Product Manager – Insurance Technology
jobs.desc:
**Job Title: Product Manager – Insurance Technology**

**Location: Union Beach, NJ (Onsite) – Need Locals or relocation candidates who are open to relocate day one**

**Duration: 12-18 months Contract**

  

**MOI: Phone/Video (MSTeams)**

  
  

**Recruiter Additional Notes:**

Recruiter Focus Notes: A senior-level Product Owner / Product Manager with strong insurance industry expertise who can own product direction while also working hands-on with Agile delivery teams. The ideal candidate can understand complex insurance workflows, turn them into clear requirements and backlog items, facilitate discovery, make prioritization decisions, and communicate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.

Target level: Senior Product Owner / Senior Product Manager / Business Product Lead.

**Top Recruiting Priorities — Required**

7+ years of progressive Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Product Lead, or similar experience delivering software/digital products.

Strong insurance domain knowledge, including insurance operations and terminology.

Proven product strategy, vision, roadmap, and value-delivery experience.

Strong ability to translate complex business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, business rules, and functional requirements.

Hands-on product backlog ownership and prioritization in an Agile/Scrum environment.

Strong stakeholder leadership and facilitation, including business leadership, users, engineering, QA, architects, and SMEs.

Working knowledge of data mapping, transformation rules, APIs, error handling, exception management, and retry mechanisms.

Working proficiency with AI tools, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio or comparable tools.

Niche combination to prioritize: Candidates combining senior product ownership + deep insurance domain knowledge + hands-on Agile backlog/requirements management + understanding of data/integration concepts.

**Job Description:**

**Senior Product Owner – Insurance Technology**

**Position Overview**

Drive the vision and delivery of digital products that improve the experience and effectiveness of employees, clients, and business partners within the insurance environment. This role combines strategic product management with hands-on product ownership, translating complex insurance workflows and business needs into actionable requirements for cross-functional technology teams.

The successful candidate will establish product vision and roadmaps, prioritize the backlog, lead discovery and requirements activities, guide Agile delivery, and use customer and business insights to drive continuous product improvement.

**What You'll Do**

**Product Strategy, Vision, and Value**

Define and communicate product vision, strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes aligned with business priorities.

Partner with business leaders and users to understand goals, operating processes, pain points, and opportunities.

Evaluate product ideas based on customer impact, business value, cost, risk, technical feasibility, return on investment, and build-versus-buy considerations.

Build stakeholder alignment around product priorities, trade-offs, and release decisions.

Product Manager  
  
Digitalzone is a B2B marketing company building the demand orchestration systems that connect buying signals to revenue. Our products turn scattered signals into pipeline our customers can act on. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Product Manager to join the product team and help shape where these products go next.  
  
POSITION OVERVIEW  
As a Product Manager, you own the strategy and delivery of our demand orchestration products. Your deep understanding of B2B marketing and lead generation, combined with strong product management craft, will be central to aligning product strategy with business objectives. You will work closely with engineering, data science, design, and marketing; make decisions grounded in data; and keep a clear line of sight from customer problems to revenue outcomes.  
We also expect a modern toolkit. Product managers here use AI tools in their daily work to move faster: to synthesize research, to build a rough prototype that makes an idea concrete, and to tighten the loop between an idea and real user feedback. Those tools support the fundamentals, they do not replace them. *Judgment is still the job.*  
  
Key Responsibilities

* **Product strategy:** Own the roadmap for demand orchestration and align it with company objectives, connecting product decisions to outcomes such as SQLs, high intent leads, and marketing sourced and influenced revenue.
* **Customer and market understanding:** Conduct market research, track competitors and industry trends, and maintain a deep working knowledge of lead generation and B2B marketing processes.
* **Discovery and user research:** Talk to customers regularly, run interviews and usability sessions, and turn what you learn into prioritized product decisions.
* **Requirements and definition:** Write clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Where a prototype communicates the intent better than a document, build one.
* **Prioritization:** Make explicit trade-offs about scope, sequence, and what will not get built, and explain the reasoning to stakeholders.
* **Cross-functional collaboration:** Partner with engineering, data science, design, sales, and marketing to take products from concept through launch and adoption.
* **Agile delivery:** Run disciplined iterative development: short cycles, working software each sprint, and steady progress against the roadmap.
* **Data-driven decision making:** Define success metrics before launch, instrument what you ship, and read the results honestly afterward.
* **Go-to-market partnership:** Support launches with positioning input, enablement material, and a clear view of the customer value being delivered.
* **Communication:** Articulate product vision and requirements to audiences ranging from engineers to executives to customers.
* **Problem solving:** Break down ambiguous problems, including the newer ones that come with building AI powered features.

The fundamentals above are the core of the role. These practices are how we expect a PM to apply them today.

* **Prototyping:** Comfort turning an idea into something tangible within days, whether that is a wireframe, a clickable Figma flow, or a rough working prototype. A prototype in front of a user answers questions a specification cannot.

jobs.title: Product Manager – Data Platform
jobs.desc:
### **The Company**

Glassbox's mission is to empower enterprises to shape trusted, frictionless digital experiences.

Glassbox is a leading force in shaping digital experiences. It helps organizations uncover digital issues, boost conversion rates, enhance accessibility, prevent fraud, and more. Leveraging AI-driven customer intelligence, Glassbox enables enterprises to deliver secure, proactive, and preventative digital experiences. Its solutions are trusted by highly regulated organizations, including SoFi, Cal, and many others. We are growing and have been recognized by G2 as one of 2024's Top 50 Software Companies in the world.

### **The Opportunity**

We are looking for a **Product Manager – Data Platform** to lead the strategy and roadmap for Glassbox's data platform and analytics capabilities.

You will own products that power behavioral analytics, AI insights, and Product Intelligence across the Glassbox platform. Working closely with Engineering, Data, AI, Design, and Customer teams, you will build scalable, enterprise-grade data products that transform digital behavior into actionable intelligence.

This role is ideal for a product leader who combines strong product thinking with deep technical understanding of data platforms, analytics, and AI.

### **What You Will Do?**

* Own the roadmap for Glassbox's data platform and Product Intelligence capabilities.
* Partner with Engineering, Data Science, and AI teams to deliver scalable data products.
* Define data models, analytics capabilities, APIs, and platform services.
* Drive product decisions through customer insights, analytics, and market research.
* Ensure data quality, scalability, governance, and performance across the platform.
* Help shape Glassbox's AI-first and agentic product strategy.

  

### **What You Will Need?**

* 7+ years of Product Management experience in B2B SaaS.
* Experience building **Data Platform, Analytics Platform, Integration, or AI products**.
* Strong understanding of modern data architectures, event-driven systems, and large-scale behavioral data.
* Experience defining and managing **REST and Batch APIs**, data contracts, and integration capabilities for internal and external consumers.
* Experience working with cloud-based data platforms and storage technologies (AWS S3, Azure, SFTP)
* Strong SQL and analytical skills, with the ability to translate customer and business needs into scalable data solutions.
* Experience partnering closely with Engineering, Data Engineering, and Architecture teams on highly technical products.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and product leadership skills.
* Hands-on familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, or Copilot.

**An advantage:**

* Experience with Product Analytics or Digital Experience Analytics platforms (Amplitude, Mixpanel, FullStory, Quantum Metric, Contentsquare, Pendo, Datadog, etc.).
* Familiarity with modern data technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, Kafka, Elastic, or ClickHouse.
* Experience in enterprise SaaS or regulated industries (Financial Services, Insurance, Healthcare, Telecommunications).

At Glassbox, we value curiosity, ownership, and a constant drive to learn and improve, no matter the gender, age, nationality, religion, or background. We believe diverse perspectives make us better, and that potential matters just as much as experience, and encourage people of all shapes and sizes to apply.  
If this role excites you and you're motivated to make an impact - we'd love to hear from you, even if you don't meet every listed qualification.

Dorsia is at the forefront of hospitality-tech innovation, redefining how the world gains access to the most in-demand restaurants, events, and experiences. By fusing cutting-edge technology with the art of luxury hospitality, we empower our members to secure impossible-to-get reservations while providing operators with unprecedented levels of control, visibility, and revenue optimization.

Dorsia is seeking a **Product Manager, Payments** to own Dorsia Pay and the full member payment experience, from card on file and deposits through checkout, split bills, tipping, settlement, and post-dining support. At Dorsia, the best payment is the one a member never has to think about. This is a builder role at the boundary of product, engineering, and operations. You won't just write requirements for AI features or bolt on off-the-shelf copilots. * Turn wireframes and agent behaviors into testable builds in days, then refine them through live traces and usability testing.

* Help build a reusable agentic payments platform with shared tools, policies, evals, and observability.
* Deploy back-office agents for reconciliation, disputes, fraud triage, and payout exceptions as volume scales.

* **User Experience:** Advocate for intuitive experiences and contribute to solution design from concept through execution
* **AI Innovation:** Identify and apply AI (including GenAI and agentic tech), rapidly experimenting to responsibly scale ideas into production

**Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of hands‑on product management experience with a strong execution track record

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership**

* Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Loyalty domain, including rewards programs, tier structures, incentive campaigns, customer engagement initiatives, and partner programs.
* Define and prioritize features based on customer needs, business impact, retention opportunities, and technical feasibility.
* Build and maintain a structured product backlog that balances customer value, revenue growth, and platform scalability.
* Create PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that enable efficient delivery.
* Define measurable loyalty KPIs including retention, repeat purchase rate, redemption rate, engagement, and customer lifetime value.

**Customer Discovery & Member Insights**

* Develop a deep understanding of professional buyer behaviors, purchasing patterns, and loyalty drivers.
* Conduct customer interviews, surveys, user research sessions, and data analysis to identify opportunities for improving customer retention.
* Translate customer insights into scalable loyalty experiences and engagement strategies.
* Partner with sales, customer success, marketing, and business stakeholders to validate customer needs and product direction.

**Loyalty Program Ownership**

* Own loyalty program design including points accrual, points redemption, rewards catalog, loyalty tiers, and customer recognition initiatives.
* Define requirements for targeted offers, promotions, bonus point campaigns, referral programs, and seasonal incentives.
* Drive personalization capabilities based on customer behavior, purchasing patterns, and engagement history.
* Optimize loyalty experiences across web, mobile, and digital channels.
* Define customer journeys from enrollment through engagement, redemption, and advocacy.

**Customer Analytics & Data Foundation**

* Partner with engineering and analytics teams to establish customer data models that support loyalty program execution and measurement.
* Define analytics instrumentation requirements for loyalty engagement, customer retention, and campaign performance.
* Monitor customer cohorts, churn metrics, reward utilization, and lifetime value trends.
* Leverage experimentation and A/B testing to continuously improve loyalty program effectiveness.

**Delivery & Cross-functional Leadership**

* Drive end-to-end feature delivery in an Agile environment from ideation through release and optimization.
* Collaborate closely with engineering, architecture, marketing, customer success, and business teams.
* Communicate strategy, program performance, roadmap priorities, and business outcomes to executive stakeholders.
* Manage dependencies across loyalty, commerce, customer data, CRM, promotions, and marketing platforms.

**Required Qualifications**

* 7+ years of product management experience with ownership of customer engagement, loyalty, rewards, retention, CRM, or commerce-related products.
* Strong understanding of loyalty program fundamentals including rewards structures, customer segmentation, lifecycle management, and retention strategies.
* Experience defining and launching customer engagement initiatives and retention programs.
* Proven ability to develop product strategy using customer research, analytics, and market insights.
* Experience writing PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria for complex customer-facing products.

About the Augustine Institute

The mission of the Augustine Institute is to serve the formation of Catholics for the New Evangelization. Through our graduate school, media, and parish programs, we equip Catholics intellectually, spiritually, and pastorally to renew the Church and transform the world for Christ.

Position Summary

We are seeking a strategic, data-driven, and growth-oriented Product Manager to join our product team. The ideal candidate will take end-to-end ownership of our direct-to-consumer (B2C) offerings, applying consumer psychology and rapid experimentation to maximize user acquisition, daily active engagement, and retention. In this role, you will lead continuous A/B testing, optimize self-serve monetization funnels, and build rigorous business cases for new offerings. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams—including technology, marketing, content, and customer success—you will deliver frictionless, emotionally-resonant experiences that help Catholics understand, live, and share their faith.

Key Responsibilities:

* Develop and communicate a clear, prioritized product roadmap that aligns with organizational goals and ensures successful implementation.
* Lead the product vision, lifecycle, and growth strategy for direct-to-consumer offerings.
* Develop quantitative business cases, market forecasts, and strategic justifications for new and prospective consumer product features and offerings
* Create and implement comprehensive go-to-market strategies, designing high-converting onboarding and product adoption funnels.

* Monitor project progress, identify risks, and take proactive measures to address challenges.
* Optimize the user experience by analyzing feedback, usability data, and industry best practices.
* Clearly communicate product developments, updates, and changes to internal and external stakeholders.
* Monitor product performance and implement optimizations to enhance user engagement.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for product-related inquiries and initiatives.
* Develop training and documentation to support product maintenance.
* Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices.

jobs.title: Product Manager, File and Remit
jobs.desc:
Anrok is the leading tax automation platform enabling businesses to expand globally without compliance complexity.

As the digital economy has grown 6x over the last decade, software businesses have gone from not worrying about sales tax to needing to monitor exposure, calculate rates, and file returns across 50 US jurisdictions and 100+ countries. This creates a critical bottleneck for companies that should be able to transact with customers everywhere.

Anrok eliminates this complexity by connecting with billing and payment systems to automate tax monitoring, calculations, and filing end-to-end. Our unified platform handles the ever-changing maze of tax laws at municipal, state, and federal levels—so companies can focus on growth, not compliance.

Our customers include:

* 40% of Forbes Top 50 AI companies
* 20% of Forbes Top 100 Cloud companies
* Top companies like Notion, Anthropic, and Cursor

We're making compliant digital commerce a reality for companies big and small, backed by over $100M from leading investors including Sequoia, Spark, Index, and Khosla Ventures.

Every month, Anrok files more tax returns than ever before, and the next month beats it. Behind each return is a company counting on us to file it correctly, on time, and get the money to the right government. Nobody else is set up to do this at our scale.

As the **File & Remit Product Manager**, you'll own the last mile of tax compliance: from preparing a return until the money reaches the tax authority. Everything else Anrok does builds up to this. You'll be solving two problems that shape the company:

**File every return in the world.** Our filing volume keeps setting records. The systems that got us here won't carry us through the next 10x. You'll define the filing platform that can file every return for every company in every jurisdiction. It should run itself, with automation that monitors and repairs its own problems and humans involved only for edge cases.

**Open Anrok to the world.** Today, a company based outside the US has to open a US bank account before it can remit through Anrok. For great international companies, that's often the last thing standing between them and Anrok. You'll build the remittance infrastructure that lets them pay from their local bank account in top international markets.

Our vision: tax filing is handled like magic, and sellers never have to think about it.

**In this role you will**
-------------------------

* Build a filing platform that scales to every return in the world, with most filings fully automated and zero human touches
* Put AI at the center of filing, with agents that write filing automations, catch problems before a filing period opens, and repair them automatically
* Unlock international sellers by making remittance work from their local bank accounts, in local currency
* Own money movement end to end, from collecting seller funds to landing payments at thousands of tax authorities across currencies, banking partners, and jurisdictions
* Build tools for our in-house TaxOps team, your power users, so they can do more jurisdictions with less effort
* Make the returns experience that sellers trust completely: every filing on time and accurate
* Drive the metrics that matter: cost per filing, 100% on-time filings, and fewer amendments
* Identify the next frontier, including whether Anrok's filing engine becomes a standalone platform of its own

**What excites us**
-------------------

* 4+ years of product management experience, with 2+ years building B2B products
* Experience in payments, fintech, money movement, or high-volume operational systems
* Systems thinking: you design for 100x, not just for next month
* Comfort going deep technically alongside engineers building automation infrastructure
* High standards in places where a mistake costs a customer money
* A GM mindset with strong product and business instincts
* Clear, concise communication, verbal and written
* Strong cross-functional work with

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.desc:
At Shutterfly, we make life’s experiences unforgettable. We believe there is extraordinary power in the self-expression. That’s why our family of brands helps customers create products and capture moments that reflect who they uniquely are.

**Shutterfly is looking to hire a Product Manager to join their team!**

**What You'll Do Here:**

* Ability to continuously manage and groom feature/product backlogs with the goal of prioritizing the most important work. This requires collaboration across the organization to populate the backlog, understand what is feasible from an engineering perspective, and provide adequate information to help inform execution planning. Key expectations of backlog grooming include the ability to generate a business case estimate benefit/value, understand strategic alignment and work closely with the project management organization to estimate effort.
* Drive upstream project deliverables associated with a given project including business cases, project proposals, user requirements, and acceptance criteria.
* During execution, it is expected that you effectively identify and resolve risks, tradeoffs and obstacles, and understand when to engage leadership teams for support.
* Challenge the organization to be quality focused by leveraging data to help drive decisions, having a mindset focused on continuous process improvement and helping to guide test plans to ensure end-to-end, robust coverage.
* Collaboratively work with stakeholders across the organization to gather input and assist product leaders with multi-year product roadmaps.

**The Skills You'll Bring:**

* 5+ years of product management experience
* Demonstrated knowledge and ability to manage product backlogs
* 3+ years of experience leading project teams
* Experience managing a platform roadmap
* Demonstrated experience and knowledge working with Atlassian tools such as JIRA, Confluence, and BitBucket
* History and experience juggling multiple concurrent projects
* Experience working with agile scrum teams to bring new features to market
* Analytical and problem solving experience with large scale systems
* Strong partnership and collaboration skills – you appreciate the importance of bringing others along on the journey
* Experience managing teams through change

Supporting a diverse and inclusive workforce is important to Shutterfly not only because it directly reflects our value of Embracing our Differences, but also because it’s the right thing to do for our business and for our people. We welcome all applicants and evaluate them based on their qualifications. Learn more about our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion on our Career Site.

As a Product Manager, you will independently lead features and projects of moderate complexity that improve experiences for readers, journalists, and advertisers while driving business outcomes.

**Why it matters:** This role is central to shaping the future of Axios' products. As a Product Manager, you will own initiatives from discovery to delivery, using data and user insights to guide decisions. You'll collaborate with designers, engineers, and stakeholders across the company to define priorities, optimize user journeys, and launch impactful features.

**Responsibilities**

In this role, you will make an impact at Axios with the following responsibilities:

* Independently manage features and quarterly priorities, from discovery through delivery.
* Use data to inform decisions, track performance, and optimize conversion funnels and core user journeys.
* Conduct user research and stakeholder interviews, translating insights into actionable requirements.
* Partner cross-functionally with engineering, design, editorial, and revenue teams to align execution with business goals.
* Communicate clearly across teams, adjusting messaging for different audiences.
* Maintain high-quality standards, ensuring features are delivered with minimal oversight.
* Mentor junior team members through reviews, feedback, and modeling best practices.
* Actively support teammates through collaboration, pairing, and team rituals.
* Apply AI tools independently to improve speed and quality of routine tasks, sharing prompts and workflows with peers.

**Skills**

Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit, a passion for Axios' mission, and have the following skills:

* **2–4 years of experience** in product management or equivalent roles in technology, media, or SaaS.

* Strong analytical skills with experience using data to optimize user flows, funnels, and core product experiences.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to stakeholders at different levels.
* Experience conducting user research and translating findings into product requirements.
* Collaborative mindset with experience mentoring or supporting junior teammates.
* Fluency with AI tools to accelerate work, and the ability to share effective use cases with peers.

**What success looks like**

* Delivery of features and quarterly priorities that measurably improve user engagement and business performance.
* High-quality execution with minimal oversight and strong cross-functional alignment.
* Clear, audience-appropriate communication that builds trust with stakeholders and peers.
* Positive mentorship impact on junior product team members.
* Demonstrated use of data and research to shape product decisions.
