jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**About DeweyLearn**

DeweyLearn exists to help organizations preserve and scale expert judgment. We believe the most valuable knowledge in any organization doesn’t live in manuals or policies, it lives in the decisions experts make every day. Our platform captures that expertise, transforms it into scalable AI systems, and applies it to authentic assessment, coaching, certification, quality assurance, and any workflow where human judgment matters.

DeweyLearn is an AI-powered human assessment and evaluation platform. Our multimodal system analyzes audio and video of real learning, training, and coaching sessions using observational frameworks developed with domain experts, then turns what it sees into structured insight for assessment, coaching, certification, and quality assurance. Our partners span higher education, corporate training, clinical practice, and K-12 education.

DeweyLearn won the GSV Cup grand prize at the 2026 ASU+GSV Summit as the world’s best edtech startup, and recently closed a Series A led by SJF Ventures.

**Tasks**
---------

**About the role**

You own end-to-end product management across existing verticals, new verticals, and internal tooling. Working with the Head of Product, you take a focused approach to understanding the problem, and building, validating, launching, and improving a solution that people actually use. Use cases might include a nursing simulation workflow, a repeatable solution for an existing customer need, or an internal tool that helps our team deliver faster.

This is a hands-on building role. You use agentic tools to compose existing DeweyLearn and third-party capabilities, configure workflows, and test working solutions. You partner with Customer Success and domain experts to understand the use case, and with Engineering and Product Delivery to deliver it successfully. You own the assigned product’s outcomes, then take on new opportunities as the solution becomes repeatable, and ongoing ownership is clear.

**Requirements**
----------------

**What you'll do**

Understand the use case: Partner with Sales, Customer Success, customers, and domain experts to identify the problem, current process, and evidence of value.

* Build the complete solution. Configure workflows, prompts, evaluation frameworks, and integrations using existing capabilities and agentic tools. Work with Engineering when platform changes are needed.
* Validate in real use. Test the full customer or internal workflow against agreed quality criteria, review failures with relevant domain and technical owners, and iterate.
* Launch and drive adoption. Coordinate readiness, onboarding, and handover with Product Delivery. Partner with Customer Success and Product Marketing on demos, enablement, and feedback.
* Own the outcomes. Track useful adoption, quality, time to first value, and commercial contribution. For internal tools, demonstrate time savings, improved throughput, or reduced errors.
* Make it repeatable. Reduce bespoke setup and support, build reusable workflows, and turn user learning into product improvements and roadmap input for the Head of Product.

**About the Candidate**

* Curiosity and adaptability: You learn new domains quickly and recognize when to involve specialists or engineers. You can move between industries and internal use cases while staying focused on outcomes. Experience in education, assessment, workflow automation, integrations, or AI evaluation is helpful, not required.
* Agentic building: You use AI tools to build working solutions, inspect outputs critically, troubleshoot failures, and improve them. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you enjoy making things work.
* Ownership and judgment: You can show useful things you have built and shipped, and explain your decisions and results. You may be early in your career; demonstrated ownership matters more than years in a PM title. Personal, academic, internal, and customer projects all count.

Spring Education Group is seeking a CRO & Web Product Manager to own search engine optimization (SEO) execution, conversion rate optimization (CRO), technical web delivery, and directory data quality across Spring’s ecosystem of 200+ sites.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**Job Title:** Technical Product Manager

**Location:** Remote

**Company:** BrandRank.AI

**Duration:** Full Time

**Reports to:** Chief Product/Operations Officer

**About BrandRank.AI**

BrandRank.AI is an AI brand intelligence platform. We measure how AI answer engines such as Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Claude, Perplexity, Grok and Meta AI describe, rank and recommend brands, and we show brands where they are visible, where they are vulnerable, and what to fix first. Our customers include some of the largest consumer brands in the world. We are a small but growing team engaged in exciting work on a new frontier of brand building.

**The Role**

You will report to the Chief Product/Operations Officer and sit alongside the engineering team. You will translate the voice of the customer into product requirements and turn those requirements into working application solutions. You will own the connective tissue between what we build and what the rest of the company says about it, communicating product capabilities to the Sales team, the Marketing team and the customer in plain language. This is a hands-on role at an early-stage company. You will write the spec and help the engineers work through trade-offs to reach product-market fit.

**What You Will Do**

* **Partner with engineering.** Act as the day-to-day product counterpart to our engineering leads. Define requirements, scope features, write Linear specs, and keep the backlog honest.
* **Own product communications.** Write release notes, platform change documentation, and internal product updates. Set the cadence and keep it.
* **Run the roadmap.** Maintain the product roadmap with engineering. Translate technical initiatives such as data-pipeline changes, answer-engine coverage expansion and scoring-method updates into roadmap items with clear customer value.
* **Translate for the business.** Explain metric definitions, scoring logic and platform behavior to Sales, Customer Success and Marketing in plain language. Make sure what we tell customers matches what the product does.
* **Close the feedback loop.** Collect product feedback from the team and customers, track what is and is not on the roadmap, and report back on where each item stands.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 3+ years of product management experience on technical products: APIs, data platforms, AI/ML products or core infrastructure.
* **A technical foundation.** A degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience. You can read a schema, follow a pipeline diagram and ask engineers good questions.
* **Fluency with LLMs.** Hands-on experience with LLM-based products, including how they are prompted, evaluated and integrated into applications.
* **Strong technical writing.** You have a track record of release notes, documentation and internal updates that people actually read.
* **Fluency in agile delivery and modern engineering workflows.** Linear or Jira, sprints, and working directly with engineers every day.
* **Comfort with ambiguity and small-team pace.** You would rather own the outcome than wait for a process.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with search, or ranking and scoring systems.
* Experience working with large consumer brands or enterprise customers.
* Exposure to AI answer engines and how they source, cite and rank content.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Innovative Environment:** Be part of a cutting-edge startup that is revolutionizing brand strategy through AI-driven insights.
* **High-Impact Ownership:** Work directly with engineering and company leadership, with meaningful responsibility for how the product is defined, prioritized and communicated.
* **Small-Team Pace:** Join an early-stage environment where decisions move quickly, ownership is visible and everyone contributes to shipping.
* **Customer Proximity:** Work on product decisions that directly affect leading consumer brands and enterprise customers.

Pay: $100,000.00 - $125,000.00 per year

Education:

##### **This is OUR story... and YOUR next chapter**

At HCA Healthcare, our Digital Transformation and Innovation (DT&I) team is redefining what’s possible inpatient care. By leveraging the power of artificial intelligence, automation, and digital technologies, DT&I is helping drive meaningful improvements in clinical outcomes, reduce manual workload, and expand the reach of our care teams. The Product Owner – Physician Ambient Clinical Documentation serves as the accountable owner of product vision, MVP definition, requirements, adoption, and measurable outcomes for Physician Ambient Clinical Documentation. This role owns product OKRs, value delivery, execution health, and business alignment, and serves as the decision authority on scope, priority, and trade-offs to ensure solutions are delivered with speed, quality, safety, and measurable clinical and operational impact.

This role leads the cross-functional product pod responsible for designing, implementing, scaling, and continuously improving ambient clinical documentation capabilities that support physicians and other eligible documenting providers. jobs.title: Product Owner- Fire and Mapping
jobs.desc:
**About Overwatch Imaging**  
Founded in 2016 in Hood River, Oregon, Overwatch Imaging builds AI-enabled Smart Sensors and Automated Sensor Operator (ASO) software for time-critical airborne imagery intelligence.  
Wildfire is our core market. The U.S. Forest Service, CAL FIRE and agencies from France to Australia fly our sensors to map fires overnight and deliver intel to incident command by morning.

  

**About the Role**  
The Product Owner – Fire & Mapping reports to the Lead Product Owner and leads a dedicated, cross-functional Fire & Mapping product team. Expanding the civil market is the main focus, achieved through product development for wildfire, commercial services and inspection and product sustainment for existing customers. You will partner closely with the Fire & Mapping Product Director: the Director sets product vision and market strategy, and you turn it into the backlog and delivery. The role has two goals:  

* **Drive growth through the product.** Define and deliver the new features based on market and current customer need, expanding the product along new market verticals, such as tactical fire response, etc.
* **Make the product work for existing customers.** Support current fire customers from a technical and functional perspective, so our products perform reliably in their missions.

**Focus Areas**  

* Fire mapping and intelligence (our core)
* Tactical fire response and initial attack
* Commercial infrastructure inspection
* Broader mapping: disaster response, damage assessment and other wide-area mapping missions
* Manned and unmanned aviation platforms

**What You'll Do**  

* Be the technical and functional product contact for existing fire customers, and work issues through with engineering and support.
* Turn customer feedback and the Director's strategy into new features, including for tactical fire response.
* Write epics, user stories and acceptance criteria in JIRA.
* Own a prioritized backlog that balances fixes, customer needs and new features.
* Run sprint ceremonies and keep delivery on track.
* Plan releases in sync with the fire season and support release notes, training and documentation.

**What Success Looks Like**  

* Products work reliably for existing customers, and issues are resolved quickly.
* New features ship that customers ask for and that open new fire and mapping markets.
* Engineering has clear requirements and a steady, predictable cadence.
* Releases ship on time for fire season.

**What You'll Bring**  

* 3+ years as a Product Owner, Product Manager or Business Analyst.
* Experience supporting customers on technical products while exploring and delivering new features.
* Strong writing skills, especially user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Experience with complex or hardware-enabled software.
* A practical agile mindset and comfort with ambiguity.

**A strong plus:**  

* Wildfire, emergency management or fire agency experience
* Airborne imaging, remote sensing or GIS background
* Aviation or aerospace experience
* Agile certification (CSPO, CSM, SAFe) and JIRA/Confluence

**Location**  
Full-time and on-site in Hood River, Oregon. At this point, no remote candidates will be considered. Up to 20% travel, including customer and field visits.

**What We Offer**  

* Fully covered medical and dental premiums for you and your family, plus an HSA
* Equity/stock options
* 401K with up to 4% employer match
* Generous PTO and 10 company holidays
* Late Start Wednesdays for focus time
* Startup pace, real impact and an open-door leadership team

*All applicants must be authorized to work on a permanent basis in the United States.*

**Build a brilliant future with Hiscox**

**Product Owner** (Hiscox Inc., Atlanta, GA)

  

* Translate strategic objectives into actionable technological development tasks and priorities for agile delivery teams.
* Define and manage product backlogs aligned to business goals and user needs.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, technology teams and end users to gather requirements and validate solutions.
* Prioritize features and enhancements based on value, effort and impact.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to deliver end-to-end solutions across the insurance lifecycle from quote, bind and issuance to service and claims.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager (Marketing Technology), Remote
jobs.desc:
As a Technical Product Manager you will be a key member of the team that designs solutions to support Aledade’s Growth (marketing and sales) team in their mission to enroll and engage new Aledade clients. The Technical Product Manager works alongside business owners, data analysts, and developers to define project goals, scope solutions, execute and roll out solutions. They are the interface between strategic business owners and development and ensure that Aledade creates a high-quality product with the ability to scale.

In this role, you will lead product discovery, definition and execution for the platforms that drive Aledade's top-of-funnel marketing engine. You will work closely with our Growth partners and end users to uncover business needs, frame problems and opportunities, and turn them into clear product requirements, user stories, and measurable success criteria. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll connect business strategy to technical delivery so that Aledade's martech investments produce high-quality, scalable products and measurable business outcomes.

### **Primary Duties:**

* Partner with business owners to cultivate a shared vision for the problem space, constraints, priorities and ideal end state, and be able to articulate and advocate for this perspective.
* Ongoing optimization of live user workflows and capabilities including monitoring of key metrics & user feedback
* Work with internal teams and end users to develop a deep understanding of requirements, perform thoughtful solution design, use data to test hypotheses, and support teams throughout execution.
* Write detailed user stories for new features, capturing detailed descriptions of business rationale, requirements, and success criteria that are defined by measurable outcomes.
* Develop short- and long-term roadmaps that deliver maximum value with minimum risk and assume ongoing iteration.

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of product management experience in marketing technology, technology-enabled services industry, or a SaaS product.
* Experience using data and primary research to inform solution design and build internal business understanding.
* Experience with and understanding of the software development lifecycle and software development methodologies. Preferably experience with Agile / Scrum teams.
* Product development experience in the context of the development of a healthcare technology product.

### **Preferred Knowledge, Skills and/or Abilities:**

* Strong product-oriented martech domain expertise, with a clear understanding of how marketing and sales platforms, data and processes work together to drive pipeline and revenue outcomes.
* Broad knowledge of the martech landscape (e.g. CDP, DAM, CMS, Marketing automation, etc.), including how unified data enables personalization and agentic marketing.
* Experience identifying and deploying high-impact AI and agentic marketing use cases that drive pipeline growth and operational efficiency.
* Experience working on or owning platforms in the marketing technology space (eg Hubspot, Salesforce, Seismic, Gong, ZoomInfo, Chili Piper, etc).
* Knowledge of Salesforce CRM capabilities and constraints, including its standard objects, data model and processes.
* Familiarity with customer data platforms (CDPs), identity resolution and consent and preference management. Working knowledge of SQL.
* Track record of delivering practical martech solutions that improve marketing and sales effectiveness, from process and data improvements to new platform capabilities and integrations.
* Comfortable working in ambiguity and with competing stakeholder needs, bringing structure to complex problems and driving alignment on the right solution.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills with an emphasis on problem-solving and building subject matter expertise.

Sitting for prolonged periods of time. Extensive use of computers and keyboard. Occasional walkin

jobs.title: Product Manager, Billing & Collections
jobs.desc:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

**Best Life**

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

**Product Manager, Billing & Collections**

**ABC Fitness · Product · Remote-first**

**Billing and collections sit at the center of gym operators' revenue, retention, and customer trust.** This role owns the product strategy and roadmap for billing, subscriptions, payments, and collections across ABC Fitness, turning complex payment workflows into reliable, intelligent experiences for operators and their members.

**What you'll do:**

* Own the long-term vision, strategy, and multi-quarter roadmap for Billing & Collections; make clear trade-offs across customer value, revenue, risk, and engineering complexity.
* Build deep customer and market understanding, using operator feedback, competitive insight, and product data to identify the highest-impact problems and opportunities.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Customer Success, and GTM to shape and launch reliable billing experiences.
* Drive improvements across subscriptions, recurring payments, invoicing, dunning, notifications, payment recovery, and automation - including AI where it can materially improve outcomes.
* Define the product metrics that matter, use experimentation and analytics to guide decisions, and measure impact on payment success, involuntary churn, recovery, adoption, and cost efficiency.

**Who you are:**

* 10+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning complex products from strategy through launch.
* Experience in payments, billing, fintech, SaaS subscriptions, commerce, or a closely related domain.
* Strong customer empathy, business judgment, and analytical skills; you turn ambiguous problems into clear product bets and measurable outcomes.
* An effective cross-functional leader who can align technical and non-technical stakeholders, navigate competing priorities, and maintain momentum through complexity.
* An excellent communicator who writes clearly, frames trade-offs precisely, and can influence executives, engineers, and customer-facing teams.
* **Especially valuable:** Hands-on experience with subscription billing, dunning or payment recovery, payment routing, risk/fraud, API-based platforms, or data/AI-powered product capabilities.

**How we measure success:**

* Billing-related involuntary churn decreases and payment recovery improves.
* Customers see more reliable, intuitive billing and collections experiences, reflected in product adoption and customer feedback.
* Roadmap investments produce measurable revenue, efficiency, or risk-reduction outcomes.
* Products launch with clear success metrics and strong cross-functional execution.

**Why ABC Fitness:**

ABC Fitness is a global fitness management platform serving members in 100+ countries. Our Commerce platform supports significant payment volume for fitness businesses, giving this role meaningful scale and direct impact on operator revenue and member experiences.

*ABC Fitness is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.*

jobs.title: Product Manager - Peaksware
jobs.desc:
**Who We Are**

Peaksware is the investment company that owns and operates industry-leading brands MakeMusic, Alfred Music, and formerly TrainingPeaks and TrainHeroic. Our software platforms maximize the potential of expert instructors to reach and impact the lives of the world’s committed performers. We operate at the intersection of technology, finance, and human performance, and we acquire businesses to own and operate them for the long term, not to flip them.

Position Summary

We are hiring a Product Manager to accelerate product development across Peaksware, starting inside Music Brands and expanding to the businesses we acquire next.

For the first twelve months, you will own high-priority special projects inside Music Brands, working monthly on-site with our product and engineering team in Boulder to move important work faster than it would otherwise go. Over the following twelve to eighteen months, the role evolves: you become the product manager we place into newly acquired businesses, arriving early, diagnosing what the product needs, and setting the agenda. This role demands two distinct muscles: the patience to dive deep into technical and domain edge-cases, and the versatility to context-switch across multiple projects and products without missing a beat. You will range across a multi-brand ecosystem rather than staying in a single lane, and you are genuinely energized by dropping into an unfamiliar business, diagnosing what it needs, and driving immediate impact.

Key Responsibilities  
Accelerate Music Brands and Financial Analysis (First 12 Months)

* Own High-Impact Platform Initiatives across our Music Platforms: Drive high-priority product initiatives inside Music Brands from definition through launch, in partnership with the Boulder product and engineering team.
* Modernize Core Content Infrastructure for Music Brands: Dive deep into the details of asset production, content ingestion pipelines, metadata structures, and licensing workflows to build scalable, reliable systems.
* Investigate Before You Build: Use customer research, product data, and first-principles reasoning to establish what is actually worth building, rather than working from the existing roadmap by default.
* Earn Engineering’s Trust: Work closely enough with engineers and designers that they want you in the room: clear specs, fast decisions, real understanding of the constraints.
* Ship and Measure: Define what success looks like before launch, then track whether it happened and act on the answer. Partner closely with our Boulder-based engineering and product teams. Win credibility through clear technical specs, deep domain comprehension, and fast, well-reasoned decisions
* Accelerate Financial Analysis through AI-enabled automation and productization.

Product Leadership in Acquired Businesses (12–18 Months Out)

* Identify High-ROI AI Opportunities: Evaluate where AI creates real economic value across our businesses, then drive those opportunities through to shipped, measured outcomes. Build and defend a clear view of where AI changes unit economics and where it is merely noise.
* Step into New Businesses and Diagnose Quickly: Serve as the product manager we place into newly acquired companies. Assess an unfamiliar product, its users, its team, and its economics quickly, then form a clear view on what to fix, what to build, and what to stop. Work with the Head of Product to set product direction during the window when it matters most. We invest for the long run, so make the decisions that compound over years rather than the ones that look good in the first quarter.
* Develop Shared Infrastructure Across the Portfolio: Help build the platform layer every brand draws on such as: shared content infrastructure, data pipelines, and AI capabilities that no single business would justify building alone. Form a view on what should be centralised and what stays brand-specific.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead
jobs.desc:
**About us**

Shorthand exists to empower creative teams to produce and publish beautiful, transformative content radically faster. We’ve begun our journey by creating an easy-to-use platform for one of the most creatively and technically demanding use cases on the web — immersive feature stories — and we’re proud to count many of the world’s best known and most discerning publishers, brands, not-for-profits, and universities as loyal customers.

Shorthand is a growing, investor-backed company with customers on every continent (except Antarctica!), and there’s never been a more exciting time to join our band of geeks with art and heart.

We’re looking for a **Product Marketing Lead** to join our team on the US West Coast on a fully remote basis. The role comes with a high level of responsibility and autonomy and is a fantastic opportunity to join an ambitious but down-to-earth team making an outsized positive impact in the digital publishing space.

**What you’ll be doing**

You’ll own Shorthand’s story: who it’s for and how we talk about it. You’ll shape our positioning with the CEO and VP of Growth & Marketing, give Sales the narratives and proof to close deals, lead our launches, and write copy that has a point of view. We’re looking for someone who believes a product should stand out, and who’s experienced in crafting a distinctive narrative that cuts through.

You’ll be our sole product marketer, joining a small, fast-paced Growth & Marketing team that already covers content, demand gen, community, and design. This is a senior but hands-on role, with real influence over how Shorthand is seen, sold, and built.

Anyone can sign up and start building stories in Shorthand. Most of our business comes to us inbound, and our sales team works each deal from first conversation to signed contract. Your job is to make sure every step tells the same clear, compelling story.

You’ll know it’s working when Sales reaches for your materials first and we see stronger conversion and shorter sales cycles. Bonus points when people can tell a piece of Shorthand marketing is ours before they see the logo.

You’ll report to the VP of Growth & Marketing and partner with the CEO, Head of Sales, and Product team. Much of the team you’ll work with is in Australia and New Zealand, and our Head of Sales is in California. We collaborate async-first, and live calls with the ANZ team usually fall in your afternoon (Australia’s morning).

**In this role, you will:**

* Shape Shorthand’s positioning, segmentation, and core value propositions with the CEO and our Marketing, Sales, and Product leaders, giving Shorthand a distinctive voice and point of view
* Develop a deep understanding of our buyers, users, market, and competitors, and turn it into tools the whole company uses
* Build messaging frameworks, use cases, and proof points that support a sales-led motion, from first touch through to expansion
* Work with customers to learn how they measure the value of Shorthand, and turn that evidence into reusable proof
* Make Sales more confident and effective, with sharper deal narratives, objection handling, competitive positioning, and supporting decks and one-pagers
* Make sure people who sign up to try Shorthand understand its value quickly, and help turn that early interest into sales conversations
* Lead product and feature launches end-to-end — strategy and KPIs, the narrative, and coordinating execution across the company
* Bring customer, market, and competitive perspective to decisions on pricing and packaging

jobs.title: Integration Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**Company Description**

Redzone, the Connected Workforce business unit within QAD | Redzone, helps manufacturers make more products for less while greatly improving the employee experience. While there is a lot of hype around digital transformation, the factory of the future, and Industry 4.0, the focus has been on the equipment and technology – not the people. *At Redzone, we are all about the people, what we call “the connected workforce.”*

We make frontline teams more engaged and more productive so their lives improve while contributing to positive business outcomes. We do this by combining exceptional software and world-class coaching, giving our customers an average productivity increase of 26% in 90 days. Redzone brings together Production, Maintenance, and Quality teams, improving the communications between those teams to resolve issues and increase output. Decision-making happens on the shop floor by the people doing the work, in real time, for immediate impact and a better overall employee experience.

With an AI powered platform, nearly 2000 plants and over 500,000 users, Redzone is changing the way people work – one plant at a time.

 **Job Description**

Under the leadership of the VP of Product Management, the **Integration Product Manager** is responsible for defining, refining, and delivering enterprise products that help manufacturers connect Redzone with third-party systems (ERP, MES, and OT/IoT platforms), optimizing data flow, system connectivity and frontline execution across the plant floor.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role at the center of Redzone’s growth strategy. You will define how Redzone connects seamlessly into the broader manufacturing tech ecosystem—unlocking data from ERP, MES, HRIS, and OT systems to deliver seamless workflows and real-time connectivity for the frontline.

You will own the vision and execution for integrating with enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, Ignition, GE Proficy, Workday, Kronos, and others. If you’ve spent your career bridging factory floors with enterprise systems and creating seamless data flow across manufacturing environments, we want to talk to you. The Integration Product Manager will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to drive day-to-day product strategy, execution, prioritization, and customer engagement across integration.

*This position is Full-Time, Exempt, and Remote, with a requirement to travel up to 40% of the time.*

**Responsibilities**

* Gains a thorough understanding of customer integration needs and uses that knowledge to help deliver enterprise products that provide an unparalleled connected experience.
* Translates business goals, system requirements, and end-user needs into an actionable integration product strategy.
* Identifies goals, metrics, and analytics to determine the business and operational value of integrations.
* Continually makes recommendations and refinements to integration capabilities based on customer learnings and technical feedback.
* Identifies pros, cons, issues, obstacles, technical dependencies, and value associated with integration features and API enhancements.
* Collaborates with key stakeholders across Redzone, including executives, customers, Redzone Coaching, Sales, Solutions, and Engineering teams.
* Supports Redzone’s annual product strategy cadence of ideating and bringing the next big thing to life in order to increase plant performance and connect frontline workers in manufacturing.
* Facilitates the prioritization and definition of new integration capabilities, system connectors, and product enhancements.
* Supports the development of user stories, technical specs, data mapping, and integration requirements.
* Provides feedback to the design team and to Software Engineers during sprint retrospectives and architecture reviews.
* Closely partners with the Solutions Consultant team and supports technical integration discussions during peak sales times.
* Acts as the Integration subjec

**Company Description**

VERSANT (Nasdaq: VSNT) is an industry-changing media and entertainment business and home to trusted brands that shape culture, inform audiences, and build lasting connections. It operates across four core markets: political news and opinion, business news and personal finance, golf, and sports and genre entertainment. These markets are served through a powerful portfolio of iconic and innovative brands, including CNBC, MS NOW, USA Network, Golf Channel, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, and Versant's sports division USA Sports, along with complementary digital assets including Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow and GolfPass.

 **Job Description**

As a **Product Owner, Supply Chain & Procurement (Business Solutions – Corporate Core Finance)**, you will own the vision, roadmap, and prioritized backlog for SAP S/4HANA capabilities that support procurement, inventory, and related finance processes. You will work closely with business stakeholders, SAP functional teams, engineers, QA, data teams, and delivery partners to deliver scalable, user-centered solutions across procure-to-pay and connected order-to-cash workflows.

This role combines strong product ownership with a working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Materials Management, Sales and Distribution, and Finance/Controlling integrations. You will focus on improving business outcomes such as purchasing compliance, process efficiency, invoice automation, spend visibility, inventory accuracy, financial controls, and user experience.

**Drive Product Outcomes**

* Own, maintain, and prioritize the product backlog for supply chain, procurement, and related finance capabilities.
* Define the customer and business problems to solve, desired outcomes, and success measures—not only the features to deliver.
* Translate business objectives into prioritized epics, user stories, process flows, acceptance criteria, and incremental release plans.
* Balance customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, risk, compliance needs, and delivery timelines.
* Break large initiatives into smaller releases that enable continuous delivery, learning, and measurable improvement.
* Define and monitor key performance indicators for adoption, process efficiency, procurement compliance, spend visibility, inventory accuracy, and user satisfaction.

**Lead Discovery and Process Design**

* Lead discovery and requirements-gathering sessions with procurement, supply chain, finance, warehouse, sales, customer service, and IT stakeholders.
* Understand current-state workflows, pain points, and control requirements needs across procure-to-pay and connected order-to-cash processes.
* Facilitate future-state process design, identify gaps and dependencies, document decisions, and build alignment on scope and priorities.
* Use stakeholder feedback, operational data, and system insights to validate assumptions before significant investment.
* Identify opportunities to improve workflows through SAP capabilities, process simplification, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions.
* Maintain a strong understanding of core procurement, inventory, finance, and cross-functional business processes.

**Enable Strong Delivery**

* Partner with SAP functional consultants, engineers, QA, integration teams, data teams, and business process owners to refine solutions and remove ambiguity.
* Define requirements for integrations among SAP S/4HANA MM, SD, FI/CO, warehouse operations, tax, payment, logistics, customer, supplier, and third-party systems.
* Validate end-to-end business and accounting impacts across requisition-to-payment, inventory, sales-order-to-billing, and financial reporting processes.
* Participate in and lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos, retrospectives, and other Agile delivery ceremonies.
* Prioritize defects, enhancements, and change requests based on business impact, urgency, risk, compliance, and roadmap value.

jobs.desc:
*Mulligan Funding is a San Diego based fintech lender to the Small and Medium Sized Business market. We are building a deeply researched and first-of-it’s-kind, Agentic AI complete funnel automation strategy. Mulligan has decades of deep credit underwriting and analytics expertise, combined with rich data from almost a million applications and billions of dollars funded via a wide loan size of $10k to $10 million. We are a mission-driven company, focused on solving the SMB market’s access to the fast and affordable capital they need to thrive by re-inventing how credit risk is measured, priced, and negotiated. We combine a generational-technology with unwavering integrity and a human touch.*

We are replacing legacy small business lending with fast, intelligent, AI-driven decisioning. Backed by 18 years of proprietary credit data, analytics expertise, and insights from almost a million applications and billions in funded loans ($10k to $10M), we possess an institutional foundation competitors simply can't match.  
  
We’ve already moved past the experimental phase: production-grade AI agents are actively running in our credit and underwriting workflows today, driving clear results in speed, consistency, and decision quality. Now, we are expanding this AI-first approach across Sales, Customer Lifecycle, Finance, and Capital Markets—and we need builders who want to own the outcomes at the center of this work.  
  
We are hiring an AI Product Manager to embed directly inside one of our core AI initiatives. In this hands-on role, you will lead discovery and design, work shoulder-to-shoulder with business teams, and manage execution alongside specialist engineering partners. We need someone who thrives in ambiguous environments, owns their results end-to-end, and can take a messy problem and turn it into a clear design. On day one, you will sit with functional experts, map out their daily workflows, and redesign them from scratch using modern AI tools.  
  
Reporting to the Chief Credit Officer, you will operate with high day-to-day autonomy inside your pod. This position is ideal for an early-career product manager looking to build deep AI expertise fast, take real ownership of production outcomes, and grow alongside our expanding team.

### **Current State Discovery & Process Intelligence**

* **Deep-Dive SME Discovery:** Lead structured discovery sessions with functional Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to map the current process in full — every step, decision point, pain point, exception case, volume estimate, and cycle time. The goal is to understand how the process actually works, not how it is documented.
* **Metric Baselining:** Quantify the current state — cycle times, error rates, manual touchpoints, cost of failure — to create the measurement foundation against which post-deployment impact will be assessed.
* **Edge Case Extraction:** Surface the process edge cases, informal workarounds, and undocumented exceptions that SMEs carry in their heads but rarely write down. These are often where AI creates the most value — and where designs fail if not addressed.
* **Hypothesis Testing:** Work with the AI Product Director to test design hypotheses during discovery — some will be confirmed by the process reality, some will need to be revised. Discovery should challenge assumptions, not confirm them.

* **0-to-1 Reimagining:** Translate current state intelligence into an AI transformation design brief that reimagines the process from scratch — not an AI-assisted version of the status quo. The question to answer is: if we were designing this process from scratch with AI available, what would it look like? Vision and ability to think outside of the box is mandatory

Day to day, you'll serve as DENT's first Scrum Product Owner, turning that strategy into clear priorities for engineering.

**Two Paths Into This Role**

* Industry Expert: You know energy metering, building automation or electrical equipment inside and out, and you're ready to move into product. We'll coach you on product management and Scrum.
* Product Management Pro: You've owned the strategy and roadmap for a technical B2B product, ideally as a Scrum Product Owner. You haven't worked in our industry, but you learn fast. We'll get you up to speed on our products and customers.

Either way, we'll pay for your Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) training or a similar certification. Where you land in the pay range depends on the path you come from and the experience you bring. Someone who walks both paths may justify a salary above the posted range.

* Decisive: You make the call with the information you have, and you can explain why.
* Customer-Focused: You'd rather pick up the phone than guess. You're comfortable on customer calls, building relationships with key accounts and asking for honest feedback.
* Market-Minded: You follow customers, competitors and market trends, and turn what you see into product decisions.
* Technically Curious: You can hold your own with engineers on hardware, firmware and software.
* Clear Communicator: Your requirements and business cases are easy to read and act on.
* Builder: You enjoy building out a function, not just running one.

* Owning product strategy and the roadmap across meters, current transformers, software and cloud, aligned with our growth strategy
* Working closely with sales to understand customer needs, wins and losses, and where the market is heading
* Running market and competitive analysis to keep our product portfolio competitive, including the standards and certifications that shape it
* Getting in front of customers: joining sales calls, building relationships with key accounts and OEM partners, and reaching out for feedback
* Building business cases, making value-based product decisions and giving input on pricing

* Partnering with our Marketing Manager on launches, positioning and sales training

Requirements

* 2+ years in product management or Scrum Product Owner work on a technical B2B product, or in a technical role in energy metering, building automation, HVAC/controls or electrical equipment
* Comfort with products that combine hardware, firmware and software
* Experience working directly with customers, sales teams or partners

* Product marketing or launch experience
* Market research, competitive analysis or product strategy experience
* Experience with OEM or private-label partners
* Cloud or SaaS products tied to connected devices

**Product Manager**

Southfield, MI (Hybrid) · Full-time · Reports to VP of Product

**Who We Are**

We believe in small businesses and the people who grow them. At Credibly, we combine data science, technology, partner relationships, and customer support to give business owners fast access to right-sized capital — from working capital loans and merchant cash advances to lines of credit.

Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Southfield, Michigan, with offices in New York and Arizona, Credibly has provided access to more than $3 billion in capital to over 65,000 small businesses nationwide.

**The Opportunity**

The Product Manager will drive product planning and execution across Credibly's lending platform: the experiences our merchants and broker partners use to apply and get funded, the internal tools our sales, underwriting, funding, and servicing teams rely on every day, and the data and integrations that connect it all.

You will connect customer needs, business goals, and technical feasibility; decide what to build and why; and lead cross-functional teams through discovery, delivery, and launch. You will use data to measure what works, and you will look for practical ways that automation and AI can make our products faster, smarter, and easier to use.

**What You Will Do:**

* **Own outcomes.** Define the goals and KPIs for your product areas (conversion, time-to-fund, operational efficiency, partner and merchant satisfaction) and use them to guide priorities and measure success.
* **Lead the product lifecycle.** Take initiatives from ideation and discovery through requirements, design, testing, launch, and iteration.

* **Partner with engineering and design.** Work closely with engineering, design, and data teams to shape solutions that are usable, technically sound, and secure.

* **Find opportunities for automation and AI.** Identify manual work and decision points where automation, integrations, or AI can create value, and work with technical teams to deliver them responsibly.

* Stay current on the alternative lending and fintech landscape, competitor offerings, and emerging technology.

jobs.desc:
**Who You Are**

You are a highly analytical professional that operates at the interface of Product Management and Data Science.. You understand that a model's value depends only on how well it solves a real customer problem. You can translate a use case into a clear prediction target, define what constitutes a true positive, and reason through the tradeoffs between missed risk and unnecessary alerts. You are comfortable discussing precision, recall, and ROC analysis with data scientists, and explaining what those metrics mean to customers.

You are drawn to the intersection of product strategy and applied machine learning. You know how to turn customer needs into model requirements, evaluate whether an improvement matters in practice, and prioritize new capabilities alongside improvements to existing models. You are rigorous and analytical, but you move with urgency and make practical decisions with imperfect information.

You are collaborative by nature and have achieved success as a team player. You thrive by setting ambitious goals and tracking progress until they are met. You feel strongly about being mission-driven in your work, and above all else you are innately curious and motivated to learn new things.

**Who We Are**

Quantifind is the Risk Intelligence company. We help some of the world's biggest banks identify money laundering and fraud. Quantifind also works with government agencies, using the same platform, to uncover criminal networks and support national security. Unlike other players in this space, Quantifind delivers results in a software-as-a-service (SaaS) model with consumer-grade user experiences.

Quantifind's Graphyte platform uncovers signals of risk across disparate and unstructured text sources using artificial intelligence and natural language processing techniques. In financial crimes risk management, Quantifind's solution combines internal financial institution data with public domain data to assess risk in the context of Know Your Customer (KYC), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Fraud Risk Management, and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) processes.

Our customers need to understand the intelligence they rely on: what our models assess, how their performance is measured, and where their limitations lie. The Core Models product area connects the development of our models to those customer needs and the workflows they support.

To help you succeed, we provide a supportive environment that fosters collaboration between teams and team members, where learning and professional growth are considered a key part of your success, and of ours. We offer a flexible work environment with a family-friendly work-life balance.

**What A Great Candidate Looks Like:**

* BS or MS in computer science, statistics, mathematics, engineering, or a related technical field, or bring equivalent practical experience.
* 2+ years of product management, data science, and/or data analytics experience working with software powered by machine learning models or with significant model-driven capabilities.
* You have a strong working command of classifier performance metrics, including precision, recall, false-positive and false-negative rates, and ROC analysis and can interpret evaluation results, explain threshold tradeoffs, and connect those tradeoffs to customer outcomes.
* You can turn an ambiguous customer problem into a well-defined model use case, prediction target, and measurable acceptance criteria.
* You understand how label quality, class imbalance, and the representativeness of evaluation data affect conclusions about model performance.
* You are comfortable partnering closely with Data Science and Engineering, distinguishing product decisions from modeling implementation choices while contributing meaningfully to both discussions.
* You communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical audiences and can explain model capabilities and limitations without overstating what the evidence supports.
* You understand agile software

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Product Managers work closely with product leadership, UI/UX, Business Analysis, Development, Quality Assurance, Sales, Legal, Account Management, and other stakeholders to deliver improvements that solve meaningful customer problems and support business goals. Success requires sound judgment, attention to detail, clear communication, and the ability to move work forward with appropriate independence while seeking alignment and escalating risks when needed.

**Responsibilities**

* Engage with customers, end users, and internal stakeholders to understand business needs, evaluate workflows, and identify product opportunities

* Evaluate customer requests and business opportunities, recommend priorities, and communicate trade-offs among customer value, business impact, effort, and risk

* Contribute to product roadmap planning and manage priorities, scope, and deliverables in alignment with product leadership

* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements, including workflows, business rules, and acceptance criteria

* Collaborate with stakeholders to evaluate solutions, refine requirements, resolve open questions, and ensure proposed solutions meet business needs

* Guide product functionality from discovery through development, testing, release, and post-release evaluation, maintaining clear ownership of product decisions, requirements, and outcomes throughout the lifecycle

* Proactively manage and communicate progress, decisions, dependencies, and risks, providing recommendations and escalating issues when appropriate

* Partner with stakeholders to communicate product value, expected business benefits, features, and functionality for customer education and sales enablement

* Monitor product adoption, customer feedback, and business outcomes to identify opportunities for continuous improvement

**Skills and Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in software product management, business analysis, or a related product role, with demonstrated responsibility for defining and delivering software functionality

* Knowledge of residential mortgage processes, capital markets, or mortgage underwriting/origination and the ability to understand business rules, data, and customer workflows

* Experience developing and communicating detailed software requirements and translating complex business needs into clear direction for technical and non-technical audiences

* Demonstrated ability to investigate problems, evaluate alternatives, and make well-supported recommendations

* Working knowledge of Agile or other iterative software development practices, including backlog management and experience using product and delivery tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Aha!

* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders, with sound judgment regarding when to involve them in decisions and discussions

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities and maintain follow-through across multiple initiatives

* Ability to work independently, take ownership, and recognize when alignment or escalation is needed

jobs.title: Product Manager - Payment Processing
jobs.desc:
Shift4 (NYSE: FOUR) is boldly redefining commerce by simplifying complex payments ecosystems across the world. As the leader in commerce-enabling technology, Shift4 powers billions of transactions annually for hundreds of thousands of businesses in virtually every industry. For more information, visit www.shift4.com.

SHift4 is expanding globally and hiring a key Payment Processing Product Manager, Lead – North America owns the product strategy and delivery for the core transaction processing domain in North America, spanning Clearing, Settlement, and Exceptions/Dispute Management.

  

This role is central to the company's move away from legacy, homegrown processing infrastructure toward a modern, modular processing platform, and requires close, ongoing engagement with the third-party processors and networks the business relies on today as that transition unfolds. Reporting into the Global Payment Delivery leadership, this individual translates architectural direction into a concrete, sequenced product roadmap, working across engineering, operations, finance, and external processing partners to ensure the platform is reliable, compliant, and positioned for eventual platform independence.

**Responsibilitie**s

  

* Own the product roadmap for Clearing, Settlement, and Exceptions/Dispute Management within the North America processing stack, ensuring alignment with the broader global processing architecture and platform-independence strategy.
* Serve as the primary product point of contact with existing third-party processing and network partners, managing day-to-day requirements, escalations, and roadmap dependencies while planning for eventual consolidation onto the target processing platform.
* Translate high-level architectural direction (e.g., separating switching/auth, clearing, and settlement into modular, replaceable components) into detailed product requirements, phased migration plans, and measurable delivery milestones.
* Partner with Engineering to scope build-vs-buy decisions for processing capabilities not fully covered by external platform partners (e.g., residuals, billing nuances, reconciliation, reporting), and own the resulting internal product backlog.
* Work closely with Finance, Risk, Operations, and Compliance to ensure clearing, settlement, and exception-handling flows meet regulatory, funding, and reconciliation requirements across card networks and payment types.
* Define and track success metrics for processing reliability, settlement accuracy, exception resolution time, and partner performance, and report progress to senior product and executive stakeholders.
* Document and maintain the logical data model and interface contracts between the processing domain and adjacent systems (onboarding/merchant data, gateway, billing), ensuring consistency in naming conventions and identifiers as legacy systems are decomposed.
* Support internal and external certification efforts (e.g., network/scheme certifications) tied to new clearing and settlement capabilities.
* Act as a bridge between regional (North America) needs and the global Payment Architecture function, surfacing local requirements for peer review and ensuring North America is represented in global processing standards.

**Qualifications**

  

* 7+ years of experience in a product management role within payments processing, acquiring or a related financial technology domain.
* Working knowledge of transaction lifecycle mechanics, specifically clearing, settlement, and dispute/exception processes across card networks.
* Experience managing relationships with external processing or network partners, including roadmap negotiation and issue escalation.
* Demonstrated ability to translate architectural or technical direction into an executable, sequenced product roadmap.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working alongside Finance, Risk, Operations, and Engineering.
* Comfort working with structured data and system interfa

jobs.desc:
**Location:** This is a remote role where candidates must **currently** reside in one of the following states: Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Tennessee, Texas, or Virginia.  
  
**Employment type:** Full-time  
  
**Work Authorization:** Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship  
  
  
  
  
**About Tivly**  
Tivly is one of the largest marketplaces for commercial insurance in the United States, connecting business owners looking to protect their businesses with insurance carriers that fit their needs. Since 2009, Tivly has established a network of over 200 trusted carriers, agents, and brokers serving a wide range of businesses.  
  
**About the Role**  
The Product Manager owns the strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for a core area of the company’s platform, as well as the stakeholder relationships that shape it. The role aligns priorities across multiple teams into one clear, sequenced plan, sets the standard for what “ready for engineering” means, and makes sure the work being built is the work that matters most. It operates with a high degree of autonomy. It is the primary point of accountability for stakeholder alignment across engineering, client services, sales, marketing, and operations, and it drives cross-team decisions to documented outcomes.  
  
**What You'll Do**

**Stakeholder Management & Outcomes**

* Own stakeholder management for the product area: identify key stakeholders, set expectations, manage communication cadence, and be the single point of accountability for alignment. What You'll Do
* Gather priorities from engineering, client services, sales, marketing, operations, and leadership and reconcile them into one shared, sequenced roadmap
* Surface conflicting priorities early, put the tradeoffs in front of the right decision-makers, and drive them to a documented resolution
* Run regular alignment touchpoints (roadmap reviews, priority check-ins, stakeholder updates) so changes in direction are communicated before they become surprises.
* Manage cross-team dependencies and external partners so that every open item has a named owner, a next step, and a follow-up cadence.
* Escalate with a clear recommendation when a decision belongs above the team.
* Own the product strategy and roadmap aligned to company objectives.
* Lead discovery with client services, sales, and business stakeholders to identify the underlying problems behind requests and validate opportunities before committing to work.

**Requirements & Specification**

* Translate business ideas into clear technical requirements — most requests arrive as a business problem, not a deliverable, and it's in this role to determine what's actually needed and who else needs to weigh in.
* Own backlog health so work arrives at planning well-defined, right-sized, and sequenced against the roadmap.
* Write and maintain requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases precise enough that engineering can build without re-litigating scope.
* Partner with engineering on feasibility and technical approach early, and make scope decisions when tradeoffs arise mid-delivery while keeping stakeholders informed of the impact.

**Process & Standards**

* Define and evolve how intake, refinement, sprint planning, and stakeholder acceptance work for the team, adjusting as team size, cadence, and product needs change.
* Partner with engineering to maintain accurate documentation and decision records so past decisions remain traceable.
* Identify recurring friction in how work moves between teams and drive fixes rather than workarounds.

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, CRM, lead generation, or insurance/fintech.
* Proven experience owning stakeholder management and aligning priorities across multiple teams with competing goals.
* Track record of owning a product area’s roadmap and delivering measurable business outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability

With a customer-first mindset and an intentional focus on building strong teams, we’ve been able to uphold our legacy of financial stability while investing in new, innovative technologies that support the needs of our customers. Our high-performance culture focused on operational excellence thrives thanks to remarkable people united by compassion and a customer-first commitment. Are you ready to make a difference?

At the Standard, Agile Product Owner job family is a discipline focused on the execution of product strategy and vision. The Product Owner family defines and prioritizes product features, aligns business goals with customer needs, and collaborates with cross-functional teams to deliver high-value solutions in an Agile environment. They advocate for the end user, monitor key performance metrics, and drive collaboration across teams to deliver high-quality, timely solutions. Product Owners balance strategic thinking with tactical execution, leveraging data and feedback to continuously improve the product and ensure project success.

**Product Manager**

  

**Job Description:**

Thomson Reuters is seeking a dynamic Product Manager to drive the development and commercialization of innovative analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with customer needs and strategic business objectives.

  

The Product Manager owns the vision, direction, and priorities for a larger, more complex, or strategic product or group of products, managing the full product lifecycle from strategic planning through to tactical execution. They understand the needs of the customers the product is designed to serve in depth, communicate those needs crisply across the organization, and work with design and engineering to translate them into clear priorities, compelling roadmaps, and high-impact solutions. They reason across the full system understanding how decisions in their area impact adjacent products, teams, and the end-to-end customer experience and bring the right people into the room to make trade-offs visible.

  

They confidently shape product direction with a clear view of commercial impact, balancing short-term delivery with long-term system health and customer trust, and maintain a sharp sense of focus on the right problems, the right customers, and the right investments, treating scope creep and the impulse to build for everyone as the strategic risks they are. The balance between tactical execution and strategic vision is critical at this level, as is the ability to coordinate across multiple functions simultaneously and to lead in building AI-enabled products and experiences with depth and credibility. * Lead the entire product lifecycle from ideation through launch and post-launch optimization, focusing on analytical solutions.

CEO has several Product Management roles with differing functional scopes, but with shared underlying responsibilities.

The Product Manager (Digital Workplace) owns the suite of digital tools that connect, empower, and support staff across all sites. This includes user devices, enterprise collaboration tools, project management/workflow automation software (e.g., Monday.com), Google Workspace, and AI assistants This role unifies employee-facing applications to maximize productivity, streamline workflows and enable CEO to scale its impact. The Product Owner will help shape and translate the vision for reimagined corporate solutions and processes in an AI-enabled and agentic future. What We Need
  
  
CORPAY is currently looking to hire a Product Manager within our North American Trucking division. This position falls under our US Vehicle Payments line of business and is located in Atlanta, GA.
  
  
Corpay's North American Trucking team operates differently than a typical large enterprise product organization. While we're part of a global company, our team runs with the speed, ownership, and accountability of a startup.
  
  
We're looking for a Product Manager who is energized by ambiguity, thrives with autonomy, and enjoys building products and businesses from the ground up. This isn't a role where you are given a roadmap, you'll define your own way, drive alignment, and own execution from concept through launch and beyond.
  
  
One day you may be interviewing customers and writing product requirements. The next you might be reviewing UI designs, developing go-to-market materials, negotiating strategic partnerships, analyzing product performance, or working with engineering to solve technical challenges. Success requires someone who is equally comfortable thinking strategically and rolling up their sleeves to execute.
  
If you're looking for a role with clearly defined boundaries, this probably isn't it. If you're excited by ownership, variety, and building products that make a measurable impact, we'd love to meet you.
  
  
You will report directly to the VP of Connected Vehicle Products and regularly collaborate with the team and other departments.
  
  
How We Work
  
  
As a Product Manager, you will be expected to work in an office environment. CORPAY will set you up for success by providing:
  

* Assigned workspace in the Buckhead Atlanta office.
* Company-issued equipment + remote access

Role Responsibilities
  
  
**The responsibilities of the role will include:**  

* Owning outcomes, not just features. Take full ownership of products and initiatives from idea through launch and ongoing optimization, ensuring they deliver measurable customer and business value.
* Driving product strategy and execution. Identify opportunities through customer research, market insights, data analysis, and internal collaboration, then translate those opportunities into actionable roadmaps and product plans.
* Leading product development. Define requirements, write epics and user stories, prioritize backlogs, make trade-off decisions, and partner closely with engineering to deliver high-quality solutions across both modern platforms and legacy systems.
* Being the voice of the customer. Develop a deep understanding of carriers, drivers, fleet operators, and internal users to ensure we're solving meaningful problems with intuitive, scalable solutions.
* Shaping the user experience. Collaborate with UX and engineering to review designs, simplify workflows, and create exceptional customer experiences across web, mobile, and internal applications.
* Bringing products to market. Partner with Sales, Marketing, Operations, Customer Success, and Training to develop positioning, launch plans, enablement materials, and adoption strategies that maximize product success.
* Using data to drive decisions. Define success metrics, monitor product performance, and continuously iterate based on customer feedback, analytics, and business results.
* Leading through influence. Build alignment across Engineering, Operations, Sales, Credit, Risk, Finance, and executive leadership to move initiatives forward in a highly collaborative environment.
* Wearing multiple hats. This role extends well beyond traditional product management. On any given day, you may be writing product requirements, reviewing UI designs, developing marketing content, supporting customer conversations, negotiating partnerships, or solving operational challenges. We value people who embrace variety and are willing to jump in wherever needed.

Qualifications & Skills
  
  

* 4–7 years of product management experience or equivalent experience leading cross-functi

jobs.desc:
Habitat Health empowers older adults to experience more good days in their homes and communities. Through the Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE), we provide comprehensive medical care along with support for daily needs such as meals, transportation, and in‑home assistance. We deliver coordinated clinical and social care in our centers and directly in participants' homes, creating a fully integrated experience that brings peace of mind and a true sense of belonging. As we expand our scalable, affordable PACE model to meet the growing and complex needs of aging populations, our mission‑driven care teams continue to help participants live well on their own terms.

Habitat Health is supported by leading healthcare organizations and investors including New Enterprise Associates, Kaiser Permanente, and Town Hall Ventures. We are entering a period of significant growth and are looking for exceptional teammates to help us scale a better model of care for older adults. To learn more, visit www.habitathealth.com.

**Location**: Remote; requiring regular travel for onsite go-lives, department rounding and other support activities as needed.

**Role Scope**

Habitat Health is looking for a Product Manager to own strategy, roadmap, and delivery outcomes across our clinical and business applications portfolio — including EHR, CRM, Call Platform, Risk Suspecting, and ancillary clinical applications.

This role would be accountable for knowing the problem space deeply, deciding what gets built and in what order, and proving that what shipped actually worked. You'll run discovery with clinical, growth, and operational stakeholders, define clear requirements and success metrics, prioritize a backlog against a real prioritization framework, and partner with technical and vendor teams to deliver against it. You'll work closely with Platform, Clinical, Operations, and Growth leaders — not just to gather requirements, but to shape what the roadmap should be, defend trade-offs with data, and drive adoption once features ship.

**Primary Areas of Responsibility**  

* Own and evolve the product roadmap across the clinical and business applications portfolio, using a structured prioritization framework to balance strategic bets against operational demand
* Lead product discovery — engaging clinical and business stakeholders and end users directly to surface real workflow pain points, not just intake tickets — and translate findings into clear problem statements
* Write product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria; partner with technical and vendor delivery teams (Epic/OCHIN, Salesforce, TalkDesk, and others) to scope, sequence, and de-risk delivery
* Maintain the product backlog end to end, balancing new capabilities, enhancements, and technical debt
* Work with business stakeholders to define success metrics and KPIs for each initiative, track adoption and outcomes post-launch, and use that data to inform the next iteration of the roadmap
* Partner with PACE Center Leadership, the Office of the CMO, Population Health, Practice Operations, Finance, Strategy, Growth, and Health Plan Operations to align product direction with business strategy
* Partner with Operations leadership to drive adoption of new rollouts — closing training gaps through documentation, demos, and change management
* Coordinate with multiple vendors, escalating to leadership when vendor needs to be held accountable to scope, documentation, and delivery timelines
* Facilitate stakeholder and steering meetings, and represent the voice of the product to senior leadership
* Operate with a high degree of ownership and autonomy, exercising sound independent judgment to identify issues, evaluate options, make recommendations, and drive matters to resolution

**Qualifications**  

* Aligns with our purpose and our values, and is excited about living those out in daily practice
* 3+ years as a Product Manager or Product Owner, ideally in healthcare, health

The Wilmington Trust Institutional Services (IS) division is experiencing rapid business growth and has initiated a strategic program of continuous improvement to support the growth objectives. jobs.title: Product Manager - Network and Data Infrastructure
jobs.desc:
For more than 40 years, CXtec has helped organizations maximize the value of their IT investments. As North America’s largest secondary market network hardware provider, we deliver innovative, cost-effective IT solutions that help businesses extend the life of their technology. Today, we continue to provide creative IT lifecycle management solutions to organizations of all sizes around the world.

We are seeking an experienced Product Manager to lead and manage our portfolio of data products and solutions. This individual must bring hands-on experience in the IT data space, with a deep understanding of market dynamics, product lifecycles, and customer demands unique to data technologies and solutions.

The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with a strong blend of technical knowledge and business acumen. This role will be responsible for shaping product strategy, defining multi-year roadmaps, and acting as the product champion across internal teams. You will collaborate closely with sales, procurement, and operations to identify market opportunities, support deal strategies, and guide product and purchasing decisions.

The annual salary range for this role is $75,000-$90,000 as well as a variable compensation component. The actual salary offered will vary based on applicant’s relevant skills, education, experience, certifications and geographic location as well as other business and organizational needs.

Location: Syracuse, NY; Atlanta, GA; or Phoenix, AZ preferred. Remote opportunities may also be considered.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Identify and Evaluate Product Opportunities** – Analyze industry trends and competitive offerings to determine which OEM products should be added to the portfolio.
* **Lead Product Line Strategy & Roadmap** – Develop and execute product strategies and roadmaps for assigned product lines, evaluating industry trends, customer demand, competitive offerings, and OEM products to identify portfolio opportunities.
* **Develop Product Business Plans** – Establish plans to drive product adoption, sales growth, market positioning, and profitability, including strategies to increase demand and strengthen the company’s position in the secondary market.
* **Manage Pricing, Purchasing & Profitability** – Analyze market trends, demand, competitive pricing, inventory, and product availability to develop pricing and purchasing recommendations. Establish pricing and margin strategies and identify opportunities to improve revenue and profitability.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
At Salient, some of the most important conversations about our products happen when nobody from Salient is in the room. An integrator is advising a school district on a new security system. A sales engineer is explaining how a manufacturer can use the cameras it already owns. A customer is deciding whether a platform that looks good in a demo will hold up across dozens of sites.

We need a product marketer who can make those conversations clearer, sharper, and easier to win, even when we’re not there to help. You would be our first dedicated Product Marketing Manager, with ownership of how we position the portfolio, equip our sales team and partners, and learn from the deals we win and lose.

**Why Salient, and why this role**

Salient Systems makes CompleteView, an open video management platform for organizations managing security across many sites. In plain terms: we take the video from a customer’s cameras, record it, and put it in front of the people who need it. That might be an operator watching live, an investigator piecing together what happened last Tuesday, or an administrator making sure every camera is still online. Customers choose their cameras, and we make them all work together.

We also build the recording platforms underneath it for customers who want a system that’s ready to go. Much of this market still runs on-premise, and we’re building toward a hybrid cloud future. That combination gives us an interesting story to tell, but not one that fits neatly on a single slide.
