**About Pressed Floral**

Pressed Floral is a bespoke floral preservation company that preserves life's special moments through fine art. Serving clients nationwide, our goal is to create sentiments that will last forever.

**Summary****:**

As our Digital Product Manager, you will own the day-to-day strategy, performance, design, testing, and continued improvement of Pressed Floral’s digital experiences across our ecommerce website and internal applications. This role combines digital product ownership, UX/UI design, analytics, experimentation, SEO collaboration, and emerging technology. You will proactively identify opportunities, determine priorities, develop solutions, coordinate or implement changes, test functionality, and measure results. This role reports to the Director of Product & Client Experience and will work closely with Marketing, Client Care, Operations, Development, and external partners.

*Digital Product Strategy & Ownership*

* Own the day-to-day strategy, optimization, and performance of Pressed Floral’s customer-facing website and internal digital applications.
* Develop and maintain a prioritized digital roadmap based on company goals, user needs, analytics, feedback, and business impact.
* Proactively identify friction points, performance opportunities, and areas for improvement rather than relying solely on requested changes.
* Translate broader Product and Client Experience goals into clear digital priorities and actionable projects.
* Own digital initiatives from initial problem identification through design, implementation, testing, measurement, and iteration.
* Regularly communicate priorities, findings, recommendations, and results to the Director of Product & Client Experience.

*Website, UX & Conversion*

* Own the UX/UI experience across the Pressed Floral ecommerce website, from initial discovery through purchase.
* Monitor website and search performance using GA4, Shopify Analytics, Google Search Console, heat maps, testing platforms, client feedback, and other available data.
* Identify trends, conversion opportunities, organic search opportunities, performance changes, and areas of friction within the customer journey.
* Determine testing priorities and manage an ongoing A/B and multivariate testing roadmap.
* Develop test hypotheses, design variations, coordinate implementation, monitor performance, and interpret results.
* Design and iterate on website pages, navigation, product experiences, landing pages, and features that balance brand, usability, customer experience, conversion, and organic search.
* Evaluate and improve website structure, internal linking, page hierarchy, crawlability, indexation, and other on-page or technical SEO elements that impact site performance.
* Conduct keyword and search-intent research to identify opportunities for existing pages, new landing pages, collections, and website content.
* Implement or coordinate structured data/schema and other technical SEO optimizations where appropriate.
* Identify SEO-driven content opportunities and partner with Marketing to develop briefs, priorities, and optimization recommendations for new and existing content.
* Partner closely with Marketing on campaigns, product launches, merchandising, landing pages, and other website initiatives.
* Stay informed on ecommerce, SEO, DTC, and AI-powered search best practices, including emerging search experiences such as Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and other generative platforms.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve how Pressed Floral and its content are understood and surfaced across both traditional and AI-powered search.

*Internal Applications & Technology*

* Own the UX and continued improvement of Pressed Floral’s internal applications and digital tools.
* Work directly with internal teams to understand workflows, pain points, and opportunities for improvement.
* Translate employee and business needs into thoughtful digital workflows, features, and solutions.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
As a Product Manager for Acxiom’s data products, you will help manage and grow products built around data from Acxiom and our external data partners.  
  
A major part of this role will be understanding partner datasets and determining how they can be effectively incorporated into Acxiom products. You will work with internal teams and data partners on the technical implementation and productization of the data, from initial discovery through launch and ongoing improvements.  
  
You will own several existing partner-led data products while also helping onboard new data sources. This means learning unfamiliar datasets quickly, identifying what is valuable, defining how the data should be packaged and used, and coordinating the work required to make it available across the Acxiom ecosystem while meeting technical, privacy, and product standards.  
  
This is an individual contributor role that works closely with Data Acquisition, Engineering, Privacy, Sales, Finance, Marketing, and other product teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage a portfolio of partner-led data products, including product updates, issues, documentation, and ongoing improvements
* Understand new partner datasets, including their structure, coverage, methodology, strengths, limitations, and potential use cases.
* Define how new data should be productized, including what should be included, how it should be packaged, and how customers or internal teams will use it.
* Translate business and product needs into clear requirements and coordinate implementation across Engineering, Privacy, Data Acquisition, and other teams.
* Manage product launches, customer feedback, and ongoing enhancement, including post-launch assessment and roadmap adjustments.
* Create & communicate internal and external facing marketing communications & product collateral

**What You Will Have:**

* Bachelor's degree
* 2+ years of experience in product management or product development.
* Practical knowledge of data aggregation, modeling and audience segmentation.
* Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills.

* Strong organizational and problem-solving skills.
* **The position is not eligible for any sort of sponsorship**

**What Will Set You Apart:**

* Advanced degree or equivalent work experience.
* Advanced, proven knowledge of Acxiom products.
* Practical experience in AdTech/MarTech realms

**Primary Location City/State:**

Homebased - Conway, Arkansas

**Additional Locations (if applicable):**

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.desc:
Hygiena provides rapid microbiology diagnostic tests and solutions for mission-critical, time-sensitive processes around the world. Hygiena’s proprietary diagnostic technologies enable customers to prevent illness and save lives, comply with regulations, protect products and brands, run businesses more effectively. Solutions are sold in a wide range of industries globally, but the core focus is food safety. Headquartered in Camarillo, California and with offices around the world, we are actively looking for talented individuals to help grow the business!

At Hygiena we believe:

* In providing the highest quality products & service
* Being a leader in innovation
* Having a compelling desire to improve and win in the marketplace
* In contributing positively not only in the workplace, but in our community and environment!

With rapid growth comes opportunity. We are looking for a Product Manager (Platform) to join our team. This is a full-time, exempt, remote role, but preferably based in Southern California.

**About the Role:**

The Product Manager (Platform) is responsible for turning Hygiena's portfolio of software applications, including SureTrend, SureKleanz, SureDoc and SureLab, into one connected system that customers experience as a single product. This role owns the platform roadmap end to end: unified sign-in, cross-app navigation, shared data and combined reporting, in-app cross-sell between products, and the integrations that connect our applications to CRM, ERP and billing systems.

The Product Manager (Platform) pairs strong UI/UX judgment with a clear understanding of how accounts, data and systems fit together behind the scenes. Our applications were built separately, and this person will make them feel as if they were designed together. Working cross-functionally with Engineering, UX, the other product managers, Sales, Marketing, Finance and Customer Success, the Product Manager is measured on customer adoption, cross-app usage and cross-sell revenue, not on tickets shipped.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own and maintain the platform product roadmap and revenue objectives, prioritizing cross-app capabilities based on customer value, revenue impact, technical feasibility, and the needs of each product line.
* Define the unified customer experience across applications, including single sign-on, cross-app navigation, account and site switching, and shared settings, partnering with UX design to deliver experiences that are simple, consistent, and intuitive.
* Define the shared data model and integration requirements that let applications work together, including common customer, site, and user identities, roles and entitlements, and APIs and events, so that combined reporting and cross-app workflows are possible.
* Own in-app cross-sell between products end to end: identify moments of customer need, define prompts and offers with Marketing, route leads to account owners, and run experiments to improve conversion.
* Own integrations between the applications and Hygiena's commercial systems, including CRM, ERP (Microsoft Dynamics NAV), and billing (Stripe), so that Sales sees accurate customer and plan data and invoicing is timely and correct.
* Lead the phased separation of applications from shared legacy architecture into standalone products, planning migrations that avoid disruption to customers' daily workflows**.**
* Partner with Engineering in Azure DevOps for backlog refinement, sprint planning, and release coordination across platform workstreams.
* Collaborate with the other product managers to set cross-app standards and agree on shared roadmap priorities; communicate platform strategy to leadership and enable Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Economics, Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field required. MBA or other advanced degree a plus.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in product management for B2B SaaS sof

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager, Private Markets Integrations
jobs.desc:
**Role** **Context**

Altic is the rules-based operational network that enables private markets to operate within managed accounts at scale. It is the infrastructure layer that did not exist before. Not a platform, not a portal, not a workflow tool. The right historical reference is what NSCC and Omgeo did for equities: common standards, rules and infrastructure that allowed an entire asset class to operate at volume.

A network is only worth as much as it is connected. An alternatives trade touches a wealth platform, a trading or order management platform, a custodian, and a transfer agent or fund administrator. Today each of those connections is built bilaterally, differently, every time. That is why the industry runs at an 8 to 10 per cent not-in-good-order rate. Altic is targeting less than 0.01 per cent, and connectivity is where that is won or lost.

The connectivity itself is unglamorous and genuinely hard. Some counterparties expose modern REST APIs. Many still exchange fixed-width or delimited files over SFTP on a nightly cycle. Some sit behind decades-old platforms with a batch window and no appetite to change it. The job is not to wish that away. It is to design flows that work across all of it and still deliver a trade end to end, in good order, at volume.

**Purpose of the Role**

You will own how data moves into, through and out of the Altic network. That means consuming the interfaces our network participants already have, exposing the interfaces Altic offers back to them, and designing the flows in between so that the full lifecycle of an alternatives trade completes without manual intervention.

The counterparties in scope are wealth platforms, trading and order management platforms, custodians, and transfer agents and fund administrators. Each has a different technical reality and a different set of constraints. Your job is to build reusable connectivity rather than a series of one-off builds, so that the tenth integration of a given type is materially faster than the first.

You work against the network's rules and technical specification rather than inventing requirements from scratch. Where a rule cannot be implemented as written, you are the person who says so and works it back through.

**Key Stakeholders**

* Wealth platforms, trading and order management platforms
* Custodians, transfer agents and fund administrators
* GPs and asset managers participating in the network
* Altic Engineering and Architecture
* Altic Network Rules and Governance
* Altic Operations, Business Development and Partnerships

**Why This Role Is Different**

This role offers:

* The chance to connect network participant types that have never been connected for this asset class. There is no existing integration pattern for alternatives inside a managed account, because the flow did not exist.
* Ownership of an integration product, not an integration project. Success is a reusable interface that shortens every subsequent onboarding, rather than a delivered connection.
* Real technical heterogeneity to solve for. Modern APIs on one side, nightly flat files on the other, and a trade that has to complete across all of it.
* A specification that already exists. The rules and technical specification are being written alongside you, so you are building against something rather than guessing.
* A measurable target. Less than 0.01 per cent not-in-good-order is not a slogan, and connectivity design is most of how it gets hit.

The network is real to a network participant at exactly the point their systems connect to it. That point is yours.

**How you will provide meaningful contributions:**

**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

This role is technical, external and detail-heavy. On any given week, you might be:

* Sitting with a custodian's technology team working out which of their existing feeds can carry an alternatives position, and what has to be built if none of them can.
* Mapping a transfer agent's file layout to the network data mod

jobs.desc:
**About CodeHS**
----------------

CodeHS is a comprehensive platform helping K-12 schools teach computer science. We provide curriculum, professional development, and a full software platform. CodeHS is used by millions of students and thousands of schools and districts around the US and the world.

**Mission**
-----------

**The mission of CodeHS is to empower all students to meaningfully impact the future.** We believe that in the 21st century, coding is a foundational skill, just like reading and writing. That’s why we say: **Read, Write, Code.** Coding and computer science are essential skills for students to learn and schools to teach.

### **Location**

**Chicago — our River North office, five days a week.** Reports to Zach Galant, CTO & co-founder.

CodeHS is hybrid overall. We have people in other offices and people who work remotely, and you’ll work with them regularly. This role is in person because it depends on coming up to speed quickly — on the product, on our customers, and on how the engineering team works — and that happens faster sitting next to people. So does mentorship. We want someone who wants to work that way and is excited about getting to work in person in the office.

We’re hiring our first product manager to work inside the engineering team.

We have about fifteen engineers in small project teams that re-form each cycle, and we ship constantly. What limits our impact usually isn’t engineering capacity — it’s conviction about what to build, why, and how to communicate it to the rest of the team and our customers. We want someone who can get that conviction from teachers, districts, the market, our data, and our own team, and turn it into something engineering can act on.

This is not a people management role.

### **The role**

You own a product area end-to-end from concept to launch. Most likely a newer bet where we’re still working out the shape of it, though it could be an existing surface that needs more attention, or a few smaller ones. We’ll decide together once you’re here and have completed onboarding. Either way the goal is that you build up experience and domain expertise in that area and act like an owner.

You’ll sit with our engineering managers as a peer. You’ll run small teams of engineers with a focus area and are responsible for keeping them on track and ensuring that we build the right thing.

This is our first formal product role, so you have an opportunity to help shape what the product function can do and how it fits within engineering and the company more broadly.

### **How you work**

**You build.** When you have an idea, go make a version of it. Not production code — a working prototype you drove an AI coding agent to build. Engineers review and take it to completion.

**You write things down.** Specs, product briefs, the reasoning behind a decision. If it isn’t written down here, it doesn’t count.

**You talk to the people who use this.** Much of the work is strategy and synthesis. But when the answer is in a classroom or on a call with a district, you go. It isn’t a heavy travel role, but you will need to join calls, talk to people on the team and customers, and build an understanding beyond just reasoning through things on your own.

**You connect engineering to everyone else.** Sales, customer success, support, and curriculum all have product or tooling needs. Your job is to gather the information, synthesize it, and use that to inform what the right things are to build.

### **You should be**

**Comfortable being technical**, without necessarily having been an engineer. You can read a pull request and argue about a tradeoff without needing it translated. When an engineer raises an issue or blocker, you can ask a useful second question to move us back in the right direction.

**Fluent with AI, and adaptive to how things are changing.** You use AI to guide your thinking and move quickly, but you don’t hide behind it for judgment. You should be prototyping with coding agen

***\*PLEASE NOTE: this position is located in Charlotte, NC and requires attendance at our Southend office three days a week.\****

**Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. LendingTree and its affiliates ("LendingTree") will not provide or assume sponsorship for employment visas for this position, now or in the future.**

**The Opportunity**

Help make it easier for people to share the information they need to find financial products. As a Product Manager at LendingTree, you'll improve our internal forms platform, which powers user interaction and data capture. You'll own defined initiatives from discovery through launch, helping make forms more intuitive, connected, and personalized while contributing to the broader platform roadmap.

**How You'll Make an Impact**

* Own prioritized platform initiatives from discovery through launch, translating customer and business needs into requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Manage the backlog for your initiatives, balancing user value, effort, and dependencies in partnership with engineering and product leadership.
* Partner with design and engineering to improve mobile usability, reduce form friction, and test changes that increase completion and conversion.
* Work with technical partners on integrations with APIs, CRM systems, data pipelines, analytics, and compliance tools to improve data flow and reliability.
* Explore and test AI capabilities, including agentic workflows, with AI/ML partners to make forms more adaptive and personalized while considering privacy and user trust.
* Define success metrics, monitor results after launch, and use research, funnel analysis, and experiments to guide the next iteration.

**Who You'll Work With**

You'll work closely with engineering, design, AI/ML, analytics, and business stakeholders. You'll partner with product leadership to align your initiatives with the platform roadmap and keep teams informed about priorities, tradeoffs, dependencies, and results.

**What You'll Bring**

* 3+ years of product management experience, including work on a platform, technical product, or digital customer experience.
* Experience taking features from discovery to launch with engineering and design, including defining requirements and prioritizing a backlog.
* A working understanding of APIs, data models, workflows, and integrations, with the ability to discuss technical tradeoffs with engineers.
* An analytical approach to product decisions, including defining metrics, interpreting funnel performance, and using experiments or user feedback.
* Clear communication, strong collaboration, and the ability to organize work and surface risks in a fast-paced environment.

**What Will Help You Thrive**

* Curiosity about user problems, comfort with ambiguity, and a habit of testing assumptions and learning from feedback.
* Experience with forms, workflow tools, customer data platforms, or modernizing legacy systems.
* Familiarity with AI-powered experiences, LLMs, or agentic workflows, and interest in applying them to practical user needs.
* Experience in financial services, fintech, or another regulated industry, with attention to privacy, security, and data quality.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Users complete forms with less friction, reflected in improved completion and conversion rates.
* Your initiatives ship with clear requirements, coordinated dependencies, and measurable outcomes.
* Platform integrations support reliable data capture, and post-launch insights lead to focused improvements.

jobs.title: Junior Product Manager*in (alle Identitäten)
jobs.desc:
What to expect


Caspar Health ist führend in der digitalen Reha-Nachsorge. Wir entwickeln Lösungen, die eine moderne, datengestützte Gesundheitsversorgung ermöglichen und die Brücke zwischen Klinik und Zuhause schlagen. Unsere App bietet Patient*innen die Freiheit, ihre Nachsorge zeitlich flexibel und ortsunabhängig zu gestalten – individuell begleitet durch unser therapeutisches Team.

Als Product Manager*in (alle Identitäten) gestaltest du die digitale Transformation im deutschen Gesundheitswesen aktiv mit. Deine Arbeit hat unmittelbaren Impact, denn jedes Feature, das du entwickelst, zahlt direkt auf den Genesungsweg von Menschen ein. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Design, Engineering und Data durchläufst du alle Facetten eines modernen Produktzyklus – von der ersten Hypothese bis zum Release. Du arbeitest hands-on mit Prototypen, nutzt Experimente zum Lernen und stehst im direkten Austausch mit unseren Nutzer*innen. So erlebst du unmittelbar, welchen wertvollen Unterschied deine Arbeit für das Leben von Patient:innen und die Zukunftsfähigkeit unseres Gesundheitssystems macht.

Diese Rolle ist perfekt für dich, wenn...

  • ...du den direkten Kontakt liebst: Wöchentliche Nutzerinterviews sind für dich kein Pflichttermin, sondern deine wichtigste Inspirationsquelle

  • ...du Geschwindigkeit schätzt: Schnelles Prototyping und Shipping motivieren dich mehr als monatelange Konzeptionsphasen

  • ...du mutig entscheidest: Du fühlst dich wohl dabei, auch bei unvollständiger Datenlage die Richtung vorzugeben und durch Iteration zu lernen





Your Challenges


  • Werde zur Stimme unserer Nutzer*innen: Du führst eigenständig Interviews mit Patient*innen und sprichst regelmäßig mit Ärzt*innen und Kliniken. Du tauchst tief in ihre Lebensrealität ein, analysierst ihre Herausforderungen und übersetzt echte Gespräche in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, die den Genesungsweg spürbar verbessern

  • Gestalte die Therapie von morgen: Du formulierst Hypothesen, testest sie mit Experimenten und Prototypen – und baust gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering echte Lösungen, die in unserer App live gehen. Du begleitest Features vom ersten Problemverständnis bis zum Release und darüber hinaus

  • Wachse in die Verantwortung für deinen Squad: Gemeinsam mit Design, Tech und Medizin moderierst du den Weg von der ersten Idee bis zum Release. Du lernst, wie man Klarheit schafft und Hindernisse aus dem Weg räumt, damit ihr am Ende gemeinsam den Erfolg eurer Arbeit feiern könnt

  • Sorge für Transparenz und Vertrauen: Du kommunizierst Fortschritte und Hürden offen. Dein Ziel ist es, alle Beteiligten mitzunehmen und eine Basis zu schaffen, auf der wir unsere Produktvision Schritt für Schritt gemeinsam in die Realität umsetzen

  • Arbeite datengetrieben und zeige Impact: Du definierst Erfolgskriterien, analysierst Metriken und ziehst klare Schlüsse aus Nutzer- und Produktdaten. Deine Insights fließen direkt in Entscheidungen ein und helfen uns, Impact messbar zu machen – für Patient:innen, Kliniken und das Unternehmen

  • Präge unsere Roadmap aktiv mit: Mit deinen Nutzer-Insights und datenbasierten Lösungen beeinflusst du Prioritäten und Produktentscheidungen direkt. Du bringst Themen proaktiv ein und gestaltest gemeinsam mit dem Team, woran wir als Nächstes arbeiten

  • Übernehme Ownership für Engagement, Verständlichkeit und Fortschritt im Patient:innen-Erlebnis: Du identifizierst zentrale Paint

Lifecheq is transforming financial advice and insurance distribution across emerging markets through our cutting-edge technology platform. About Us

Our purpose is to increase economic opportunity and make better money. We’re doing that through two connected parts that together make up the Reserve project.

Economic Opportunity

UGLYCASH is a financial services app designed around the needs of people earning money on the internet: creators, remote workers, freelancers, and entrepreneurs whose banks weren’t built for how they earn.

We’re starting in Latin America. Over the last 22 months, UGLYCASH has reached $5M+ in revenue run rate and 32,000+ monthly active customers.

This is the side of the Reserve project you’ll be working on.

Better Money

What happens to that money after you earn it matters too.

Cash, money in a bank account, and payment stablecoins each work differently. We believe the money people use should do more than move from one place to another. It should also give people a better way to save and grow what they earn.

That’s why we’re continuing to improve the version of money UGLYCASH customers already use, with the long term goal of giving more people access to better options for their money.

Instagram

Youtube

**Description**

We're looking for someone early in their product career who has already found ways to make things happen.

You'll work directly with founders to explore and build new financial products. Our founders bring vision and hypotheses. You'll help turn them into products through customer understanding, evidence, experimentation, and execution.

We're hiring for the product owner you can become over the next 24 months, not the title you already have. You'll start with a focused opportunity, experienced people around you, and real responsibility. As your judgment grows, so will the size of the problems you own.

If you want to learn how new products go from an idea to something thousands of people actually use, this is the kind of seat that's hard to find.

What you could build

* Ways to earn, receive, and use money: Better payment collection, deposit experiences, and money movement for internet earners.
* Credit: New ways to make useful credit products available to more customers and markets.
* Activation and growth: Helping customers understand UGLYCASH's value and start using it.
* Products for specific customer groups: Building experiences for freelancers, online entrepreneurs, creators, and other communities with distinct financial needs.

These are examples of where the work could lead. Your first assignment will be a focused opportunity selected with the founders.

What you'll do

* Talk to customers, study their behavior, and figure out which problems are worth solving.
* Turn founder hypotheses into testable approaches and manageable first versions.
* Bring evidence that strengthens an idea or changes it.
* Use AI to research, analyze, prototype, and shorten the path from idea to useful learning.
* Work closely with engineering and design to take ideas from concept through launch.
* Measure what happens after something ships and use what you learn to make it better.
* Build the judgment to own increasingly ambitious product opportunities over time.

--------------

You'll own capabilities at the foundation of how the company moves, stores, and reasons about data: collecting analytical events in real time and batch, housing them cost-efficiently across thousands of datasets, and making them queryable at massive scale. Your focus is building paved paths, opinionated end-to-end workflows, that let teams produce trusted data outcomes without stitching together systems, filing tickets, or becoming amateur platform engineers. You'll build these paths alongside your customers, working with engineers on the technical design and with internal users, so decisions rest on real use cases and direct feedback. jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**About the role:**

We're looking for an Associate Product Manager to be Rezdy's dependable NA presence — covering the hours our Sydney/Melbourne-based PM and dev team aren't online. This is a strong fit for someone energized by operational rigor and real-time problem-solving: comfortable triaging under pressure, translating between technical and commercial audiences, and building product judgment by working closely alongside a senior PM rather than owning a roadmap from day one. Pacific timezone

**What you'll do:**

* Connect the time zones. Be the dependable daily link between North America stakeholders — support and account management teams — and the Sydney/Melbourne-based PM and dev team, flagging decisions and blockers in real time rather than letting them wait for the next overlap window.
* Be the NA distribution conduit for Commercial leads and distribution partners (Viator, GYG, etc) and Distribution Resellers
* Keep incidents moving and visible during NA hours. Triage escalations that occur in NA working hours against a defined severity framework, looping in the senior PM and dev lead when judgment calls exceed current scope, and making sure NA support and AM teams get clear, live updates rather than waiting for the next AU working day.
* Surface and track AM churn risk. Own intake of NA account-manager-flagged churn risk — capturing impact and urgency the moment it's raised — so it's framed and ready to compete fairly when the senior PM and dev lead plan the sprint.
* Answer for what's in flight. Be NA's go-to for "is this expected / is this known / what's the status" questions on Booking Manager and Distribution, working from close sync with the senior PM's roadmap and known-issues context rather than independent authority over it.
* Share release communication in NA hours. Help execute the existing release process — communication and post-release follow-up specifically during NA hours — rather than owning release planning or prioritization.
* Partner with Engineering at a working level. Build enough fluency in our data architecture to relay NA-side context accurately to engineering, without owning technical trade-off decisions.
* Put AI tools to work. Use AI tools to speed up research, troubleshooting, and day-to-day tasks — a lever for moving faster, not a replacement for judgment.

**What you'll bring:**

* 2+ years of experience in product management, product operations, or a closely related operational/customer-facing role, ideally in B2B SaaS.
* Comfort working within another PM's priorities and roadmap — bringing your own judgment and context to how that work gets executed
* Experience with incident or issue management processes, and communicating through them clearly under time pressure.
* Comfort working with legacy technology systems and the teams that maintain them — able to translate between legacy constraints and current product priorities for both engineering and commercial audiences.
* Strong written communication skills — able to adjust tone and depth for audiences ranging from support and account management teams to engineering.
* Ease operating in process-driven environments (Jira, Slack, or equivalent).
* Comfort picking up domain concepts across different product types — e.g., transactional booking flows versus distribution/channel connectivity — without needing deep expertise in both on day one.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience in the travel, tours, or activities booking software space.
* Familiarity with multi-brand or multi-product portfolios (Expedition Software operates Checkfront, Rezdy, and Regiondo).
* Prior experience in a support, account management, or customer-facing product role.

The salary range for this position is $80,000-$95,000, commensurate with years of experience, skillset, and qualifications.

Overview:

When our square shaped burgers made their first sizzle on the scene more than 50 years ago, people knew our approach wasn’t like any other. Same goes for the way we support our employees. Our culture of openness, flexibility, and inclusiveness allows everybody to flourish in their own way. If you’re looking for a career where you can be part of the action as we continue to grow our iconic brand – We got you!

The Associate Product Owner (APO) plays several key roles acting as the voice of the customer and advocating for the lifecycle of their products. In this role, you will help business owners realize the vision and align technology with key business objectives. You will drive progress on key initiatives through the execution of product roadmap(s) and management of backlog(s), and act as the link between the Product Manager and technical development teams. The APO will be on Wendy’s data management team working on enterprise data and analytics dashboard and reporting projects supporting our HR and Finance organizations. In this role, you will have the opportunity work on building out our next gen analytics and reporting applications on top of Looker and Big Query in the Google Cloud. A successful candidate in this role will demonstrate strong leadership, prioritization, and communication skills to consistently deliver outstanding results on-time and in line with established budget.

Responsibilities:

* Own sprint backlog and implementation of new product initiatives. Prioritizes product backlog working against established roadmap and coordinating dependencies with other POs. Manages portfolio of IT initiatives to ensure proper prioritization and delivery of initiatives on time and on budget.
* Responsible for development of lean business case. Incorporates this knowledge when prioritizing features for releases. Makes tradeoff decisions between scope (value in expected ROI) and schedule (higher operating expense in longer release cycles) to reflect the best interests of business owners and end users.
* As part of PI planning, decomposes feature(s) into user Stories and establishes Story acceptance criteria. Defines the definition of done.
* Facilitate relationship with the end customer and business leadership/owners, bringing the voice and priorities of the customer to the forefront. Work cross-functionally to ensure business requirements and solution capabilities are effectively matched and implemented. Develops spirit of teamwork and collaboration with clear lines of accountability for key decisions.
* Weekly tracking of incidents and service tasks to completion in partnership with service team. Shares regular feedback and follow up with business partners.
* Responsible for product introduction & review with stakeholders. Documents Story acceptance criteria into JIRA and approves/validates Stories into baseline.
* Understands business objectives and clarifies customer objectives for scrum teams.

  
Minimum Wage: USD $93,000.00/Yr. Maximum Wage: USD $158,000.00/Yr. Qualifications:

* Bachelors Degree in Technology, Business, or related field preferred or equivalent work experience will also be considered.
* 3+ years of experience working on cross-functional and diverse teams. Leadership roles or project management experience preferred.

**About TransCore**

TransCore is reinventing how people, goods, and cities move, operating at the intersection of transportation infrastructure, cloud, data, AI, and digital commerce. We are building the next-generation mobility platform that enables seamless movement, frictionless payments, and intelligent transportation experiences for agencies, operators, businesses, and consumers.

Our platforms support mission-critical mobility systems used by governments and transportation operators around the world and are enabling new business models for connected mobility, transportation payments, digital identity, and mobility services.

**Position Summary**

The Associate Product Manager (APM) is an early-career role designed for recent graduates and emerging professionals who are passionate about technology, business, engineering, transportation, and digital product development.

As an APM, you will work alongside Product Managers, Engineers, Architects, Designers, Customer Operations, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to help define, build, launch, and improve innovative mobility solutions.

This role provides exposure to the full product lifecycle, from customer discovery and market research through requirements definition, product delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate combines analytical thinking, curiosity, business acumen, and strong communication skills with a desire to learn how world-class technology products are developed and commercialized.

Through mentorship, structured development, and cross-functional exposure, APMs gain experience across product strategy, customer discovery, analytics, engineering collaboration, commercialization, and market execution. Successful APMs will have a defined career path toward Product Manager, Senior Product Manager, and broader product leadership opportunities.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.desc:
**About CodeHS**
----------------

CodeHS is a comprehensive platform helping K-12 schools teach computer science. We provide curriculum, professional development, and a full software platform. CodeHS is used by millions of students and thousands of schools and districts around the US and the world.

**Mission**
-----------

**The mission of CodeHS is to empower all students to meaningfully impact the future.** We believe that in the 21st century, coding is a foundational skill, just like reading and writing. That’s why we say: **Read, Write, Code.** Coding and computer science are essential skills for students to learn and schools to teach.

### **Location**

**Chicago — our River North office, five days a week.** Reports to Zach Galant, CTO & co-founder.

CodeHS is hybrid overall. We have people in other offices and people who work remotely, and you’ll work with them regularly. This role is in person because it depends on coming up to speed quickly — on the product, on our customers, and on how the engineering team works — and that happens faster sitting next to people. So does mentorship. We want someone who wants to work that way and is excited about getting to work in person in the office.

We are growing our product team within engineering

We have about fifteen engineers in small project teams that re-form each cycle, and we ship constantly. What limits our impact usually isn’t engineering capacity — it’s conviction about what to build, why, and how to communicate it to the rest of the team and our customers. We want someone who can get that conviction from teachers, districts, the market, our data, and our own team, and turn it into something engineering can act on.

### **The role**

This role is for someone earlier in their career who wants to learn product management by doing it.

You’ll own projects within a product area, from understanding the problem through launch and adoption. You’ll make the calls on scope, specs, and tradeoffs for your projects and work closely with the engineers building them. The bigger calls — which problems to take on, and what not to build — we’ll make together at first, and more of them become yours as you show judgment.

You’ll sit in on the conversations where we set priorities across teams, so you can see how those decisions get made.

### **How you work**

**You build.** When you have an idea, go make a version of it. Not production code — a working prototype you drove an AI coding agent to build. Engineers review and take it to completion.

**You write things down.** Specs, product briefs, the reasoning behind a decision. If it isn’t written down here, it doesn’t count.

**You talk to the people who use this.** Much of the work is strategy and synthesis. But when the answer is in a classroom or on a call with a district, you go. It isn’t a heavy travel role, but you will need to join calls, talk to people on the team and customers, and build an understanding beyond just reasoning through things on your own.

**You connect engineering to everyone else.** Sales, customer success, support, and curriculum all have product or tooling needs. Your job is to gather the information, synthesize it, and use that to inform what the right things are to build.

### **You should be**

**Early in your career, with real work behind you.** At least a year of full-time work experience, in any role. A product management internship counts too. You don’t need to have been a PM.

**Comfortable around code,** without necessarily having been an engineer. You can read a pull request and ask an engineer good questions about how something works and what it would take to change.

**Fluent with AI, and adaptive to how things are changing.** You use AI to guide your thinking and move quickly, but you don’t hide behind it for judgment. ##### **This is OUR story... and YOUR next chapter**

At HCA Healthcare, our Digital Transformation and Innovation (DT&I) team is redefining what’s possible inpatient care. By leveraging the power of artificial intelligence, automation, and digital technologies, DT&I is helping drive meaningful improvements in clinical outcomes, reduce manual workload, and expand the reach of our care teams. If you're passionate about using technology to improve human life, this is where your work truly matters

##### **What you will accomplish in this role**

Are you passionate about improving digital products, solving complex challenges, and making technology work better for the people who rely on it every day? Do you thrive at the intersection of technology, operations, and customer experience?

At HCA Healthcare, we're transforming how care teams work—and we're looking for an Associate Product Owner to help us deliver reliable, innovative technology that empowers healthcare professionals to focus on what matters most: caring for patients.

As part of our Digital Transformation & Innovation (DT&I) team, you'll play a critical role in supporting Timpani, our enterprise workforce technology platform. You'll help ensure our digital solutions remain reliable, scalable, and responsive to the evolving needs of clinicians, leaders, and operational teams across the organization.

This isn't just about maintaining technology. It's about making a meaningful impact on the daily experiences of healthcare professionals and the patients they serve.

**The Opportunity**

As our Associate Product Owner – Timpani Enterprise Support & Maintenance, you'll be at the center of product operations, continuous improvement, and cross-functional collaboration.

You'll take ownership of an enterprise support backlog, help prioritize enhancements, solve production challenges, and partner with talented teams to ensure our technology continues delivering value at scale.

You'll work closely with nursing leaders, workforce management, IT, development teams, and product leadership to turn real-world challenges into actionable solutions.

Your mission? Keep essential technology running smoothly today while helping build a stronger, more sustainable product experience for tomorrow.

**Own Product Health & Continuous Improvement**

* Help drive the reliability, stability, and performance of Timpani's enterprise capabilities.
* Identify recurring challenges, uncover improvement opportunities, and coordinate solutions that enhance the user experience.
* Support the transition of established product capabilities into a scalable, long-term support model.
* Partner with product leadership to monitor key performance indicators, identify trends, and continuously improve product health.

**Drive Priorities & Deliver Results**

* Own and manage the Enterprise Support backlog, balancing production issues, bug fixes, maintenance needs, and targeted enhancements.
* Translate business needs and user feedback into clear requirements, actionable user stories, and well-defined acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with technical teams to evaluate solutions, prioritize work, and deliver improvements that create meaningful enterprise value.
* Make thoughtful prioritization recommendations based on business impact, urgency, risk, and available capacity.

**Be the Voice of the Customer**

* Build strong relationships with frontline clinicians, nursing leaders, workforce teams, and business stakeholders.
* Advocate for the people using our technology every day, ensuring their needs inform product decisions.
* Serve as a trusted point of contact for product support needs, issue resolution, and enhancement opportunities.
* Communicate priorities, progress, and resolutions clearly across technical and nontechnical audiences.
